tei:titleStmt.tei:title: tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba
tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba

tei:div.tei:p: tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /mkha' 'gro snying phug gter byon tshe sgrub rmad/ /lcags kyi rgya mdud chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni 'chi med tshe'i sgrub skor yin la/ de la'ang tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i nang tshan/ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud ces phyi ltar na snang mtha'i ngo bo/ nang ltar na rnga sgra'i rgyal po/ gsang ba ltar na hya ghṛ wa/ don ltar na 'chi med rig 'dzin padma tshe dpag med yab yum dang gnyis su med pa tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi snying byang ches zab pa ste/ de'ang gzhung las/ 'dzam gling rgya bod sa steng du: tshe sgrub sbas pa kun gyi nang : 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud 'di: thugs kyi yang zhun min re kan: zhes gsungs pa bzhin tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud chos sde'i them byang 'god pa la/ ka) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab/ kha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ ga) tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: dbang chen hya ghṛ wa'i bla bslu bla mdos sbrags ma/ nga) tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: dbang chen hya ghṛ wa'i bla bslu bla mdos sbrags ma/ ca) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: 'chi bslu bdud dpung g.yul zlog /cha) thugs rdor gyi mdzad pa'i glud 'phyong*/ ja) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: sngon 'gro'i gsol 'debs dbang lhun gzi 'bar/ nya) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub/ ta) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: rtsa ba'i sgrub pa 'chi med rdo rje/

tha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya/ da) 'chi med tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: hya ghṛ wa'i mngon rtogs dang btsan rgod mdung dmar can gyi gsol mchod/ na) tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las khol du phyung ba'i bla 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya/ pa) tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: tshogs mchod lhun po'i sprin phung*/ pha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las byin 'bebs/ ba) tshe sgrub lcags rgya'i sman mchod/ ma) tshe sgrub lcags rgya ma'i 'dzab dmigs/ tsa) rjes chog mchod bstod/ tsha) tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam/ dza) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa/ wa) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi bskang ba 'chi med dpal gyi ljon pa/ zha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ spros med rgyun khyer snying po dril ba/ za) tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi/ bsnyen yig padma'i do shal/ 'a) tshe chog grangs gsog 'don zin/ ya) tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ bla bslu khol phyung srog gi ljon pa/ ra) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ 'chi bslu bdud dpung g.yul bzlog khrigs su bsdebs pa/ la) gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i tshe sgrub rnam bzhi bla ma zhi drag sogs spyi khyab kyi sgrub khog 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo bum bzang bcas chos nyer lnga bzhugs so/ slar smras pa/ tshe dang ye shes dpag med snang mtha' yas/ /tshe 'phrang bdud bzhi 'jigs skyob hya ghṛ/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin mtsho skyes yab yum sogs/ /tshe lha rab 'byams gcig 'dus zab sgrub phul/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/

/'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /

zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab bzhugs so: 'chi med 'ja' lus snang mtha'i sku la 'dud: de yang tshe dbang zab mo brgyud pa'i rim pa la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa gsum las: dang po ni: rtsa ba'i sgrub pa gzhung las byung ba lha'i dkyil 'khor bstod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'dod pa tsam las: dbus su bum pa lnga'am gcig: bum khri'i 'og tu tshe chang : g.yas su tshe ril: g.yon du mda' dar: rgyab tu dbang chen tshe gtor dang : rgyas 'debs kyi rgya gram: mdun du sman raka gtor tshogs: byang shar du las bum: gzhan phyi nang gi mchod pa dang : tshe gtor gang rgyas bsham: las byang gzhung bsrang la dbang chen bsnyen kha gso'am khri'am stong las mi nyung bar bzlas: tshe 'gugs thugs dam bskul zhing tshe bcud bskyil: las bum du a mṛ ta kuṇḍa la'i sngags kyi lha bdud rtsir zhu: tshogs gtor mchod pas: slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung : rgyan gdab bgegs bskrad gral du 'khod nas maṇḍal phul: slob dpon gyi tshe'i lo rgyus bshad la spro ba bskyed: me tog dang bcas gsol ba gdab: kyaiḥ dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag gtso: bla ma tshe dpag med pa mgon: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan bzhugs su gsol: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams su yin 'dod don gang : ji ltar snod dang ldan pa yis: dam tshig bka' las mi 'da' zhing : tshul bzhin sgrub pa byed spro'am: zhes dris pa'i len zhus: kyaiḥ bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing : tshul bzhin bsgrub par bdag spro bas: rdo rje tshe mchog bstsal du gsol: zhes me tog 'thor: dang po lo rgyus cung zad tsam 'di skad bshad: 'o na da lam khyed rang rnams tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab ces bya ba bskur ba yin te:

sngon 'og min snang mtha' rdo rje'i mkha' la 'khor 'das rig pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med ces bya ba: phyi ltar snang ba'i ngo bo nang ltar che mchog tshe dbang : don ltar na rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyi dgongs pa bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i klong las grol ba yin no: de yang rgyud las: 'og min gnas nas legs sprul te: snang mtha'i zer las pad 'byung pa: dpal ldan de ni padma skyes: zhes pa ltar: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyis: brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad cing : dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba'i snying byang brgyad mdzad bod yul g.ya' ma lung du tshe bsgrubs shing 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos su rnyed pa'i tshe: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la tshe chu 'dren te tshe lo brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel bab ste: mi ṭa kandhi dha ra dang : bāai rin chen mchog gnyis bsam yas su phyin: rgyal po'i spyan sngar slob dpon gyis gsungs bzhin zhus: rgyal po yang thugs rab tu mnyes te 'byon par chas: rta khal lnga bcu la gser dngul ja dar gos sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bkal te sngon du rdzongs bar byas: rgyal po dang nang blon rnams phyi la 'byon par gros byas: rta mchog ngang pa gser ldan la: chibs sga bkra shis rgyan can sgron cing rin po che'i dar sna lngas brgyan te: rgyal po chibs kyi khar phebs: blon po ye shes 'byung gis sna khrid de chas: phyi blon rnams la skyo sangs yin zhes smras: btsun mo bza' ba dmar rgyan gyis the tshom nas: ngam stag ra klu gong la 'di skad ces smras: nged kyi rgyal po mgo chung blo mang 'di: ring par 'gro ba'i rgyag ches mang bkal te: nang blon blun po mang zhig khrid byas nas: skyo sangs yin zhes phra ma'i tshig kyang smras: rgyal srid stong nas chos la 'gro srid pas: go shes blon po rnams kyis bshol ma thob: kha sang mtha' mi dge sbyong ngan pa de:

mi tra btang nas rgyal po'i snyan bslus sam: yang na rgyal khams phung ba'i chos bstan 'dra: yang na nga bzhag snying grogs btsal kyang shes: ji ltar byas kyang blo la bde ba med: rkang mgyogs gnyis la bslab kha zhib mor bris: ci thob sa ru rgyal po mi 'byon 'thad: ces smras pas blon po rnams kyis mi tra rnams la smras pa: kha sang khyed rnams chos rgyal drung du byung : yin mas 'chol ba'i kha bshad mang zhig zhus: deng sang rgyal po'i thugs blo ma zin par: thag ring 'gro ba'i lam chas mang bkal nas: mnga' thang bskyur nas mi bzhugs grab 'dug pa: mtha' mi 'khyams pos blo yogs smras 'dug gam: yang na khyed tshos rdzas ngan drangs lags sam: ci ltar byas kyang mgo bskor tshab chen 'dug: khyed tshos rdzun du ma smra zhib por smros: ngan bshad blo sna mang na rang srog phung : de bas khyed rnams khrims du mi 'gal gyis: zhes mi tra rkang mgyogs rnams la de skad smras pas: mi tra rnams kyis lan smras pas: e ma rgya gar sku 'khrungs rig 'dzin padma 'byung : bod yul mun pa'i smag rum gtibs pa la: dam chos gsal ba'i sgron me 'degs su byon: da lta g.ya' ma lung gi dben khrod bzhugs: 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos su 'grub nas kyang : tshe chu dbang po ril bu stong phrag kyang : chos rgyal khri srong sku tshe 'phrang sgrol ched: tshe chu 'dren phyir nged rnams spyan drangs btang : brgya dang bcu gcig bod bzhugs rten 'brel gsungs: khyed tshos ngan blo bsnol tshig kha ma mang : phan pa'i blo la bdud kyis bar chad mang : de bzhin blon po rnams kyang mi 'tshal lo: zhes gsungs nas mi tra rkang mgyogs rnams sngon du bros thabs su song : de nas ngam stag ra klu gong dang : btsun mo bza' ba dmar rgyan ke ru thang nag bon byang gi 'gong po rta dmar gyi sprul pa bon po nag chung dang : gnyer pa gser 'phang nag po sogs kyis khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chibs kha nas bzung ste 'di skad zhus:

rgyal po blo sna mang na rgyal srid sprang por shor ba'i skyon che: kha sang zla ba sngon ma'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin: rgya gar nas a tsa ra ngan pa tsi dug khur ba dpon g.yog gsum song zer ba kun gyis thos: nged rnams la bca' kha gzab par gyis shig zer ba mang zhig byung : mi mang 'ga' zhig shing thu bzhin yod pa rnams kyis mthong nas: a tsa ras dug pha bong byugs pas dum bu 'ga' zhig tu gas pa mthong : dug yod pa'i rtags su zon rigs dang yi ge yod pa 'dug: nged blon po rnams kyi dpral ba'i mig: khog pa'i snying : srog gi khrag: 'dzam gling kun gyi mgo 'dra ba rgyal po khyed yin la: mtha' mi'i dge sbyong ngan pas mgo bskor mkhan gyis khar brgyugs nas mig can gyis dug 'thung na: rgyal po tshe 'dir sku srog mi phangs kyang rgyal khrims gong nas zhig: blon po bar nas 'thor mi sde rnams kyis kha bshad ngan pa las mi 'ong bar 'dug pas: cis kyang mi 'byon par zhu zer nas ngam stag ra klu gong gis chibs kha nas bzung ste ma btang : rgyal po yang rmi lam shin tu legs par byung ba yin kyang snang ba'i ri mo 'di bslu brid mkhas pa dang : blon po 'di rnams kyang phan sems kyi tshig 'dra ba mang zhig byung snyam ste: the tshom skyes nas re zhig nang du log nas rim gyis btags par dgongs nas: gros te gzim chung bar ma ru log ste sngon la brdzangs pa'i chas rnams phyi bshol btang : rgyal po yang thugs blo ma bde nas nyin mtshan bsam gzhig mang du byas: de'i tshe slob dpon mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas mkhyen te: tshe chu dang tshe ril bzhag pa bum pa dang bhandha kha phyes pa'i g.ya' ma lung stod smad khyab pa'i dri bzang dang sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ri thams cad 'bir zhing sa yang g.yo ba 'ja' 'od kyi gur dpag tshad tsam yod pa'i dkyil nas lha mo tsaṇḍa lī'i sku mdangs dang ldan pa dngos su byon nas:

lung bstan pa sogs bkra shis dang ya mtshan khyad du 'phags pa mang du byung : de nas slob dpon gyis tshe chu dang tshe ril rnams dum bu brgyad bgos nas: tshe sgrub zab pa re re dang bcas te phyis ma 'ongs pa bod 'bangs skyob pa'i ched dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i chos skal du dmigs nas: sgrom dang : la cha'i bum pa: rdza yi dha ha: zangs kyi gwa'u: bswe yi li ta kaḥ rlung gi par bu sogs mi 'dra ba mang po'i nang du rim pa gsum mam bdun gyis rgya btab nas: rje 'bangs rnams la 'phrad pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar nas: bod kyi mgur lha shin tu gnyan pa re re la gnyer du gtad de: lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mi 'gyur pa'i gnas brgyad la gter du sbas: khyad par rten 'brel che ba'i yul dang mtsho sogs lung bstan pa'i gnas ni rgya gar 'phags yul gangs: sham po rdo rje gangs: ti se gangs: la phyi gangs: tsā ri gangs: sham po gangs: has po gangs: padma gangs: gze rgyal gangs: rong btsan gangs dang bcu'o: rgya gar o tra las mtsho zla ba nor bu: bal po ke ru li mtsho padma can: lnga sde bye ma gling gi mtsho chen padma bla mtsho: ti se ma pham g.yu mtsho: la phyi g.yu mtsho: tsā ri g.yu mtsho: ma kung lung g.yu mtsho: gze rgyal dung mtsho: rong btsan mtsho dmar sogs lung las grags pa dgu: de rnams rten 'brel la babs pa'i gangs ri gtan du sdod la: mtsho mo gtan du 'khyil ba rnams la: bskal pa bzang po'i 'byung ba lnga'am bcud ma nyams pa yod pa yin te: tshe sgrub dang dam rdzas rnams gter du sbos shig gsungs nas: sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam la zhugs nas nyi ma rtse shar du byon te ri lung thams cad nyul zhing gnas chen rnams la gter re re sbas: lha 'dre drag po rnams la gnyer byang gtad: dus la bab tshe chos bdag bu la sprod: ces bka' bsgos: slar slob dpon gyi drung du nyi ma phyed yul du logs:

rim gyis slob dpon 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku yin par thag chod shin tu 'gyod pa skyes te bshags pa mang du byas na rgyal chas rnams slob dpon la phul zhing tshe dbang zhus pas: sngon du rten 'brel ma 'grigs cing the tshom pas brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs rgyu yin: bcu bdun las bsring du ma thub: de bzhin du phyis 'byung gi rje 'bangs rnams kyis rten 'brel la shin tu 'grigs dgos pa yin gsungs: rim bzhin rje 'bangs nyer lnga la kha byang dang lung byang dang gsang rgya sogs legs par gtad de: lha lcam rnams kyis gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mkha' 'gro brda yi yi ger btab ste gter du sbas: sa ma ya: de lta bu'i tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba la khyed rang rnams bskal pa shin tu bzang pa yin pas: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas blo chos su 'gro ba: chos lam du 'gro ba: lam 'khrul pa byang ba: 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba'i smon lam bzang po dang khyad par du dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas yid la dran zhing 'dun pa che bar gyis shig: khyad par du bdag gi tshe dbang zab mo bskur ba la brten nas khyed rang rnams kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa dang : 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par sgoms shig: ces de nas bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa sogs?: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po sku mdog dmar po byu ru'i lhun po la nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs kyis legs par spras pa ltar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan phyogs bcur gzigs pa: dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan cing dar rnam pa lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba sku stod la lha rdzas gos kyi ga shal dang : sku smad la bde chen klum pa'i ang rag dkris pa: phyag gnyis 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa:

zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa: de'i pang du lha lcam dmar mo mdzes chags ldan zhing yab la 'khril ba'i phyag gnyis mda' dar dang tshe bum 'dzin cing : rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa: yab yum 'od kyi gong bu chen po 'khrigs pa'i klong du gzhal yas su tshe yi dbang phyug rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba'i spyi bor om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer sna lngas zhing khams na kheng bar 'phros pas: tshe lha rig 'dzin drang srong rnams spyan drangs te slob ma rnams la thim par sgoms shig: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod klong yangs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor na: lhag pa'i lha mchog rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: pad 'byung yab yum rol rtsal ngo bo mchog: mgyogs ma la sogs dbang phyug tshe bdag rnams: byin chen dbab phyir thugs dam dbyings nas spyod: sku yi gzi brjid 'od phreng kyi li li: gsung gi sgra dbyangs snyan cha 'u ru ru: thugs kyi dgongs brda ma 'gags sha ra ra: mdzes pa'i lha rdzas rgyan 'phyangs spungs se spung : ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i brda gar lings se ling : dpa' bo dpa' mo'i gar thabs shigs se shig: tshe yi las byed pho nya khyugs se khyug: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs ye re re: dam rdzas rgya mtsho bcud ldan kyi li li: dad ldan pho mo dga' bro ya la la: dbang chen pho brang zer thag sbrengs se sbreng : bdud srin dam sri tshar gcod lams se lam: dbang bzhi chu bo rgyun 'bebs na ra ra: skal ldan bu la byin chen thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub la dngos grub stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na bhrūm̐: a be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥdzaḥ de nas brtan phyir rdo rje rgya gram gyis: om̐ sa ma ya hrī dha ya tiṣṭha badzra badzra zhes brtan par bya:

de nas slob mas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ bla ma rig 'dzin dbyings nas gshegs: skal ldan mos pa'i bu la zhugs: sgo gsum phyag 'tshal dbang pos mchod: sdig bshags 'gro don chos 'khor bskor: dbang gi smin grol bstsal du gsol: de nas dam chu ngag tu sbyin: hūm̐: dam tshig rang byung dung chen snod: khams lnga'i dbang po bdud rtsis gtams: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: dam srungs badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes sbyin: de nas tshe yi bum pa thogs nas: hūm̐: dbang chen rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur: de nas bhandha thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen padma rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: gsung gi dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍā kki ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur: dkyil 'khor thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen buddha rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi snying gar bskur: thugs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur: tshe gtor bum pa thogs la:

hūm̐: dbang chen ratna rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: yon tan dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur: de nas rdo rje rgya gram thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen karma rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi gsang bar bskur: phrin las dbang mchog thob par shog: ces bskur: rigs lnga'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos: tshe lha rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ro: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: ces bskur: de nas mkha' 'gro rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: 'byung ba mnga' sgyur ḍākki dngos: mkha' 'gro lnga yi dbang bskur ro: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: ces bskur: de nas mgyogs ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi ldan pho nya'i tshogs: mgyogs ma sgo skyong dbang bskur ro: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: ces bskur: de nas bgrang phreng thogs la: hūm̐: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas sogs: bsgrub pa'i dam bca' bzung nas su: rgyun du bsnyen sgrub brtson par gyis: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ā yurdzñā na badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes bskur: de nas tshe ril thogs la: hūm̐: 'khor 'das lha mi'i bcud bsdus la: 'chi med zas mchog ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: 'dod yon longs spyod dbang thob shog: ces sbyin: de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig sna lnga'i rgyun lam nas: legs 'byung bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: de ring skal ldan khyod la blud: zag med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: ces sbyin: de nas mda' dar thogs la: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin la: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mos: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas:

skal ldan slob ma'i lus la bstim: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur thob mdzod: de nas rgya gram gyi rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badzra hoḥ zhes rgya yis gdab: dbang bsdus rdo rje'i go khrab las: bum pa gtor ma yi dam tha mi dad pa'i ngo bor bsam zhing : sku gsang thugs kyi byin rlabs gcig tu bsdus pa yin: dbang rgyas par bskur ba grub nas: hūm̐: bum pa mi dmigs chos sku'i klong : gtor ma zag med longs spyod brgyan: dkyil 'khor lha dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs dbang bzhi thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur ro: hūm̐: bum pa mi dmigs chos sku'i klong : gtor ma zag med longs spyod brgyan: dkyil 'khor lha dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs dbang mchog thob par shog: bum dbang tshe dbang la sogs dbang brgya dgongs pa'i phan phyir: bsnyen sgrub kha sbyor sogs dgos: rigs 'dus spyir: hūm̐: phrin las mnga' bdag kun gyi gtor ma ni: dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus bskyed mdzad pa: sa chu me rlung 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus la: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sku gsung thugs dbang gcig 'dus gsang sngags bstan rgyal thugs gter ro: sarba maṅga laṃ: de nas byin brlab bka' bsgo ba ni: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku thugs rje chen po: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas: lha lcam manda ra ba: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes: padma gter bdag gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma:

brgyud pa'i byin rlabs can rnams kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i dbang bskur du gsol: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu mdzod cig: tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig: 'chi ba med pa tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: ces bskur: de nas: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: sogs brjod bkra shis rab gnas bya zhing : smon lam bdun: sa ma ya: e ma yang zab tshe sgrub kyi: dbang mchog gnam lcags go khrab 'di: ma 'ongs sum cu'i yang mtha' la: gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: rgyal sras skye ba de nyid la: sprod cig bka' srung drag po rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra gter bdag gling pas sa phag lor mkha' 'gro snying phug nas gdan drangs shing padma sbas tshal nas shog ser las legs par zhal bshus so// // kha) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bzhugs so: mi 'gyur g.yung drung tshe yi lha la 'dud: e maḥ zab don man ngag 'chang ba'i bu: tshogs gnyis dpal la spyod pa'i tshe: sngon 'gro rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bstan: 'khor ba'i chos la blo log ste: yang dag nges don lam la 'jug: pha ma'i rang bzhin khams gsum 'gro: bde chen mchog la bkod pa'i sems: bskyed cing bla ma dkon mchog la: bskyed rim rnal 'byor bla ma gsal: skyabs su 'god par gsol zhing sdig sgrib sbyang : tshogs bsags sku gsum maṇḍal 'bul: don brgyud bka' bab dbang don bsre: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: chos spyod kun gyi thog ma ru: 'khor ba'i duḥkha las bskyab phyir: skyabs yul mchog rnams yid kyis bzung : mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen khri:

padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bla ma bkrag dang gzi mdangs 'bar: g.yas su sangs rgyas rgyab dam chos: g.yon du dge 'dun yi dam mdun: rang rang 'khor tshogs bka' srung bcas: nam mkha'i mtha' las rab 'das pa: mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer phrin las brdal: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kun: mos gus gdung shugs lhang nge ba: skyabs yul mchog rnams gus pas 'dud: na mo: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: sku gsum lhun grub chen por skyabs su mchi: theg chen bla med byang sems bskyed: kyai maḥ mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro: pha ma sems can snying re rje: 'di dag bde chen lam 'god phyir: tshad med bzhi yis lam sbyangs tai: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: gnas skabs mthar thug don bsgrub par: las nyon shes bya'i sgrib sbyang phyir: rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas brtsam: khams gsum sems can thams cad kun: bdag tu 'dzin med rang gsal dang : gnyis med byang chub sems bskyed blos: sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma'i sku: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru gsal: āḥ spyi bor pad dkar zla ba'i gdan: rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdo dril longs spyod rdzogs: thugs srog āḥl yig brgyas bskor: bdud rtsis sgo gsum sgrib dag gyur: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badzra satwa te no pa tiṣṭha: dṛ dho me bha wa: su to ṣyo me bha wa: su po ṣyo me bha wa: a nu rakto me bha wa: sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta: badzra mā me muñtsa: badzri bha wa ma ha sa ma ya sa twa ā: rdor sems 'od zhu dbyer med bstim: thabs kyi bsod nams tshogs la bsten: 'bras bu ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: sku gsum dbyer med maṇḍal 'bul:

om̐: dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku'i zhing : nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing : ma nges lnga ldan sprul sku'i rtsal: sku gsum zhing gi 'dod yon rnams: lhun grub thig le chen por 'bul: tshogs gnyis ye shes smin par shog: don brgyud bka' bab ma chad bar: byin rlabs 'pho ba thob pa'i phyir: zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni: hrīḥ rang nyid yi dam padma dbang gi rgyal: spyi bor 'ja' 'od thig le 'khyil ba'i klong : padma nyi zla'i steng du bla ma rje: snang mtha'i rang bzhin 'chi med padma 'byung : mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang 'dren pa'i ded dpon che: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang : rig 'dzin grub thob dam can rgya mtsho'i bskor: mtshan dpe'i sku mchog gzi brjid ya la la: tshangs dbyangs theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru: mkhyen brtse thugs rje ma 'gags sha ra ra: mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa gsum rang bzhin can: sku gsum lhun grub chen por gsol ba 'debs: zhes gsol 'debs rgyas pa skabs 'dir bya: skyabs yul lha tshogs 'od zhu gtso la thim: kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bur rtse gcig tu: mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la: rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs: smin grol thugs rgyud dbang bzhi stsol: ces brgya stong mang du bya: bla ma'i sku las ye shes lnga yi rgyun: babs pas lus gtams sgrib dag dbang bzhi stsol: bla ma 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med par: bdag gzhan rtog med chos dbyings chen por bzhag: 'jig rten chags sdang 'dzin pa'i klong : skad cig tsam yang mi gtong zhing : gzhi grol rig pa ma yi klong : bu yi rig pa 'od gsal ba'i: thol skyes thol nus ci snang ba: 'dzin med yengs 'khrul bral bar bskyang : rtsal 'gyu ma dbyings bu grol te: gdod ma'i klong du phebs par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ

rten 'brel thabs kyi bskor: 'jug pa lam 'khyer nyams myong gi: shes rab rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i chos: byang chub bla ma'i rnal 'byor bstan: las can rnams kyi sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes phag lor mkha' 'gro'i snying phug nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser nas zhal bshus so: sarba maṅga laṃ// // ga) ༈ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: dbang chen hya ghṛ wa'i bla bslu bla mdos sbrags ma bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'dud: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug 'od skur drwa ba'i sku: gzhon nu bde ba'i rnam rol rdo rje'i sgra: snyan brgyud zab pa'i lhan skyes 'dus ma byas: mthar thug snying po'i man ngag rlabs phreng 'di: gnod sbyin mi dmar khyod kyis nges par skyongs: de yi phrin las cha rkyen 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: thog mar bla mdos sbrags pa'i rim pa bstan: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: dang po tshe sgrub chen mo gzhung bzhin bsrang : bca' bzhi bya ba'i rim pa ni: mdun du gzhi dkar gtsang ma'i steng : 'bru yi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus: g.yung drung steng du bla rta bzhag: thugs dam bskul ba'i lha gtor lnga: 'bru lnga gser skyems tshang ma bsham: bla rtags bla rkang rde'u dgu: dar dmar dkar ser dril bar bya: yar gzhi bsham bkod de rnams so: mar gzhi nag po de yi khar: glud gtor changs bu lnga dang bcas: bdud bshos nag po dang bcas bsham: bla glud bsngo zhing thugs dam bskul: mtshams su rin chen zangs snod du: bla gzugs mtsho yi nang du bzhag: sbyin bdag g.yung drung steng du bzhag: mda' dar g.yab cing bla 'bod bya: bla mtsho bskor zhing rten 'brel brtag: legs rtags byung na re re'i chog: ngan na rim bzhin mkha' 'gro bskul: bla rten 'gugs 'grigs bla rkang bcas: lag tu bzhag cing tshe dbang bskur:

sngags 'chang lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: glud gtor bran la 'di skad do: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ glud gtor mi dmigs pa'i ngang las yas gzugs glud kyi gtor ma gzugs phung khams dang skye mched dbang po yongs su rdzogs shing lta bas chog mi shes pa'i rang bzhin dbang po gsal zhing yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i bza' btung 'dod rgu'i rgya mtshos khengs shing zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du bla med gyur: om̐ ā kā ro? sogs na maḥsarba ta thā ga t sogs lan gsum bya: de nas dgug pa ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: dam chos 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: bden pa'i mchog ste dkon mchog gsum gyi bka': dkon mchog bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: bden pa'i tshig gis mi grol gang yang med: yang dag don la mi sems gang yang med: snang srid sems su ma 'dus gang yang med: srid gsum thams cad bden pa'i bka' la nyon: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams: nad bdag 'byung po ma mo'i tshogs: thams cad 'dir 'dus gzugs la thim: hūm̐: nyon cig srid pa'i lha ma srin: log 'dren lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi: lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs: shar phyogs lha srin sde tshogs kun: yas glud len phyir 'dir 'dus shig: dkon mchog bka' yi bden mthu dang : sngags dang phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i yas glud 'di: sbyin bdag bla dang srog gi glud: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : dbang po rgyan chas phun sum tshogs: mi bas rin thang 'di che'o: yas stags 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho 'di: zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin: mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan che: zhe sdang lha bu bdud rnams dang :

shar phyogs dri za'i tshogs la 'bul: sbyin bdag chaiga'i bla bslu'o: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bla bslu'o: phyogs mtshams sde brgyad lag nas bla bslu'o: rgyal bsen dam sri'i lag nas bla bslu'o: gnod byed bgegs kyi lag nas bla bslu'o: yul 'dre 'byung po'i lag nas bla bslu'o: gre bo gson 'dre'i lag nas bla bslu'o: byad rbod gtad khram lag nas bla bslu'o: god 'dre bse rag lag nas bla bslu'o: rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po yi: bla tshe ma rku ma 'phrog cig: brkus pa yod na shul du tshud: 'phrog pa yod na mal du phob: tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par spel: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag: sngags 'chang bdag gi dam ma 'da': mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di khyer la: yas stags gzugs glud changs bu dang : sha khrag gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag cag yon mchod mi nor la: 'khon sems gdug pa zhi ba dang : byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na: gnas pa'i lha srin 'byung po dang : za 'dre shi gshed log 'dren bdud: sbyin bdag tshe dang srog gi glud: yas glud mchod sbyin 'di longs la: sdang sems zhags pas bcings pa khrol: bdag tu 'dzin pa ci la byed: 'dod chags dbang gis gzung ba khrol: gti mug dbang gis mnan pa khyogs: nga rgyal dbang gis bsdams pa klod: zhe sdang dbang gis gzir ba sol: chos nyid don dang bden pa la: rgyu 'bras bslu ba yod ma yin: skye 'gro sems can thams cad la: nga bdag gnyis su ma 'dzin cig: thams cad rang dang gnyis su med: 'gro drug snying rje'i yul gyur nas: sdang sems sbyor ba che la rtsub: bde sdug rang bzhin tha dad med: de bas sbyin pa'i bdag po yi: sha khrag srog dbugs ma 'phrog cig: bla tshe brkus pa shul du tshud: rang gi lus la dpe longs la: gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig: gal te bka' las 'gal gyur na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bden mthu yi:

bka' yi chad pa drag po yis: khyed rnams lus srog rdul du brlag: de bas log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: mchog gsum bden pa'i bka' ma bcag: rtsa ba gsum gyi dam ma bkral: bslu med rgyu 'bras khyad ma gsod: sngags 'chang yid bsun ma byed cig: mchog sbyin glud gtor chud ma gzon: rnal 'byor bdag gi bsrung bya la: gnod 'tshe gdug rtsub ma gtong zhig: nad rims dal yams ma 'beb cig: mchod sbyin yas glud 'di longs la: na ba sol la 'chi ba slongs: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod: nad yams dal kha dgra la sgyur: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: khyod kyi zas skal de yin no: za kha 'thung kha de ru spos: lha 'dre'i bsam pa ngan pa yang : dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du phob: byad ma rang gshed rang la zlog: om̐ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐: ghṛhṇa ghṛhṇa hūm̐: ghṛhṇa pa ya ghṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐: a na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas glud gtor shar du bskyal lo: hūm̐: nyon cig srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams: log 'dren lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi: lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: lho phyogs lha 'dre'i sde tshogs kun: yas glud len phyir 'dir 'dus shig: dkon mchog bka' yi bden mthu dang : sngags dang phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i yas glud 'di: sbyin bdag bla dang srog gi glud: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : dbang po rgyan chas phun sum tshogs: mi 'di'i rin thang 'di che'o: yas stags 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho 'di: zad med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin: mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan che: nga rgyal gshin rje'i bdud rnams dang : lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: sbyin bdag chaiga'i bla bslu'o: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bla bslu'o: phyogs mtshams sde brgyad lag nas bla bslu'o: rgyal bsen dam sri'i lag nas bla bslu'o: gnod byed bgegs kyi lag nas bla bslu'o: yul 'dre 'byung po'i lag nas bla bslu'o: gre bo gson 'dre'i lag nas bla bslu'o: byad rbod gtad khram lag nas bla bslu'o: god 'dre bse rag lag nas bla bslu'o: rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po yi: bla tshe ma rku ma 'phrog cig: brkus pa yod na shul du tshud: 'phrog pa yod na mal du phob: tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par spel: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag: sngags 'chang bdag gi dam ma 'da': mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di khyer la: yas stags gzugs glud changs bu dang : sha khrag gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag cag yon mchod mi nor la: 'khon sems gdug pa zhi ba dang : byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na: gnas pa'i lha srin 'byung po dang : za 'dre shi gshed log 'dren bdud: sbyin bdag tshe dang srog gi glud: yas glud mchod sbyin 'di longs la:

khyed rnams lus srog rdul du brlag: de bas log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: mchog gsum bden pa'i bka' ma bcag: rtsa ba gsum gyi dam ma bkral: bslu med rgyu 'bras khyad ma gsod: sngags 'chang yid bsun ma byed cig: mchog sbyin glud gtor chud ma gzon: rnal 'byor bdag gi bsrung bya la: gnod 'tshe gdug rtsub ma gtong zhig: nad rims dal yams ma 'beb cig: mchod sbyin yas glud 'di longs la: na ba sol la 'chi ba slongs: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod: nad yams dal kha dgra la sgyur: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: khyod kyi zas skal de yin no: za kha 'thung kha de ru spos: lha 'dre'i bsam pa ngan pa yang : dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du phob: byad ma rang gshed rang la zlog: om̐ sumbha ni?rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas 'og phyogs su bskyal: de nas 'gugs pa'i thugs dam bskul ba ni: dkar gtor lnga po re re bzhin phyogs bzhi dbus lnga rim bzhin gser skyems dang bcas 'bul: bla rta bla mtshor bskor zhing gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar bla rten bzung nas bla 'bod bya: dbus phyogs gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: rnga rol ldir zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas 'bod: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum: chos dbyings ye shes mthing gsal tshe dpag med: thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung la byon: thugs kyi sprul pa sngon mo nyi khri 'bum: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel phrin las myur mgyogs dus la bab: sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs mtshams khyab par bskul: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og thams cad la: steng 'og tshangs pa'i lag nas bla khug cig: bsgrub bya'i bla rten gzugs la dbyer med bstim: om̐ buddha ḍākki nī sa ma ya ā nṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

de nas shar phyogs gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: me long ye shes dkar gsal lcags kyu ma: thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung la byon: thugs kyi sprul pa dkar mo nyi khri 'bum: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel phrin las myur mgyogs dus la bab: sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs mtshams khyab par bskul: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og thams cad la: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bla khug cig: bsgrub bya'i bla rten gzugs la dbyer med bstim: om̐ badzra ḍākki nī sa mā ya āḥnṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lho phyogs gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum: mnyam nyid rin chen ser gsal zhags pa 'dzin: thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung la byon: thugs kyi sprul pa ser mo nyi khri 'bum: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel phrin las myur mgyogs dus la bab: sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs mtshams khyab par bskul: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og thams cad la: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bla khug cig: bsgrub bya'i bla rten gzugs la dbyer med bstim: om̐ ratna ḍākki nī sa ma ya āḥnṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nub phyogs gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: nub phyogs padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: sor rtogs ye shes dmar gsal lcags sgrog ma: thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung la byon: thugs kyi sprul pa dmar mo nyi khri 'bum: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel phrin las myur mgyogs dus la bab: sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs mtshams khyab par bskul: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og thams cad la:

nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas bla khug cig: bsgrub bya'i bla rten gzugs la dbyer med bstim: om̐ padma ḍākki nī sa ma ya ā nṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ byang phyogs gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: byang phyogs karma rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum: bya grub ye shes ljang gsal dril bu ma: thugs kyi sprul pa dmar mo nyi khri 'bum: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel phrin las myur mgyogs dus la bab: sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs mtshams khyab par bskul: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og thams cad la: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas bla khug cig: bsgrub bya'i bla rten gzugs la dbyer med bstim: om̐ karma ḍākki nī sa ma ya āḥnṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshe yi mgyogs ma lnga'i gtor ma gser skyems 'bul zhing bla rdel 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med tshe yi dbang phyug ma: khams lnga'i rang mdangs rigs lnga gsang ba'i yum: 'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin 'chi med stsal ba'i lha: tshe bdag dpal gyi rgyal mo mched lnga yi: sku gsung thugs sprul yon tan phrin las tshogs: pho nya yang sprul khri 'bum bye ba'i tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo phrin las dus la bab: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel myur mgyogs mthu rtsal sku shugs phyungs: khams lnga'i dwangs ma tshe yi bcud nyams pa'i: bla tshe chad mthud srog dbugs mdangs 'phrog rnams: ḍākki sde lnga'i thugs rje'i lhun byin gyis: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i lag nas bla khug cig: 'og phyogs sa bdag lag nas bla khug cig: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bla khug cig: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bla khug cig: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas bla khug cig: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas bla khug cig: shar lho ma mo'i lag nas bla khug cig: lho nub srin po'i lag nas bla khug cig: nub byang rlung lha'i lag nas bla khug cig:

byang shar dbang ldan lag nas bla khug cig: phyogs mtshams sde brgyad lag nas bla khug cig: gnod byed bgegs kyi lag nas bla khug cig: rgyal bsen 'byung po'i lag nas bla khug cig: byad rbod gtad khram lag nas bla khug cig: snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad kyi: bla tshe brkus pa rang bzhin shul du tshud: 'phrog pa yod na myur mgyogs mal du phob: drongs shig gdon bgegs lag nas tshe drongs shig: khug cig 'byung po'i lag nas bla khug cig: bla tshe nyams pa 'dir bsdus bsgrub bya yi: lus ngag yid la myur bstim bkrag phyungs shig: tshe dpal gzi brjid bsdus la mdangs spel cig: 'chi med rig 'dzin g.yung drung brtan par mdzod: rgas med bde ba'i lang tsho rgyas pa dang : mi shigs rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs: nub med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yongs khyab mdzod: bkra shis phun tshogs gong 'phel lha rgyal lo: bla rdel blang zhing rten 'brel brtag: gser skyems 'thor nas 'di skad do: hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla 'di sba'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab khung phud de khug la shog:

rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug: gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ badzra muṃ wā ra hī ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ ā yurdzñā na ṇi badzra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rten 'brel brtag cing shwa 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: ma rig nyon mongs lha yi bu: rtag par lta ba'i bla bslu'o: nga rgyal khengs sems phung po'i bdud: chad par lta ba'i bla bslu'o: nyon mongs 'dod chags srid pa'i bdud: dngos por lta ba'i bla bslu'o: phrag dog khengs sems che ba'i bdud: med par lta ba'i bla bslu'o: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi zhags kha sgyur: bla dang tshe 'di khug gyur na: lha shwa srung ba che thob shog: om̐ tshe bhrūm̐ swā hā: bdud shwa 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: tshe bdud nag po gshin rje 'dis: de ring sbyin bdag bla thongs la: 'chi bdag dus kyi pho nya zlog: 'dzin pa'i shwa rdel nag po 'dis: bla tshe yal ba ma bstan na: gshin rje'i shwa khram che thob shog: gnod byed 'byung po tshe bdud u tsa ta ya bhyo zlog: lan gsum 'gyed: gsum gyi yan shor na shor ba yin: rim gro la 'bad: yi dam lha la bstod bskul bya: de nas tshe bdud zhal phyir bsgyur la:

bra sran ram sgog glud yas sna tshogs bsags: hūm̐: gshin rje'i rgyal po bgegs kyi tshogs: lan chags sde brgyad bdag po rnams: gshin rje'i 'khor bcas gang yin pa: bgegs gtor changs bu 'dod yon khyer: tshe dang srog la ma gnod par: bsod nams dpal 'phrog ma byed cig: na 'dre shi rkyen byed pa'i bdud: 'chi bdag srog bdag bsgyur du gsol: yas stags sna tshogs rdzongs su 'debs: bla dang srog la ma gnod cig: gang ba stong par byed pa'i 'dre: ka cha chag grum rdzongs su 'debs: 'gong po bse rag ma gnas shig: sde brgyad gshin rje'i phyogs su 'phang : sbyin bdag 'di la ma chags par: gnod pa byed pa khyed cag kun: rang rang gnas su da song zhig: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin rgyal: thugs khros rdo rje 'bar ba yis: mgo lus dum bu brgya ru 'gas: 'di ru ma 'dug phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra ā yu garbha hya ghṛ wa hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed tshe bdud gshed 'khyams thams cad u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐: ghṛhṇa ghṛhṇa hūm̐: ghṛhṇa pa ya ghṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐: a na ya ho bha ga wān badzra bidyā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod nas thun brdeg yungs dkar brabs nas srung 'khor bsgom tshe yi dbang yang bskur nas tshe rten 'dzugs mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: de yang bla bslu bla mdos sbrags pa'i bca' gzhi 'di: las tshogs tshe sgrub lcags rgya'i cha lag rta mgrin nas khog phub pa'i dgos chad zab don sngags 'chang bdud 'dul kā la hūm̐ gis tshe sgrub kyi cha rkyen du bgyis pa bde thabs 'khyer bde ru bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du nyi shar 'grub sbyor rten 'brel yar ngo'i zla bar bris pa'o// // nga) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: 'chi bslu bdud dpung g.yul bzlog bzhugs so:

mi 'gyur g.yung drung tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: gang zhig rmi lam yul snang tshe gzugs ngan rtags byung na 'chi bslu cho ga brtsam: de la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis: spyi ni rmi lam lan re nges pa med: gnyis gsum btud mar byung na 'di ltar 'bad: khrag mtsho 'khrugs dang gcer bur mun bros la: dri med bshags rgyud gtsug tor dkar mo 'don: gos ngan nyi zla nub dang grogs med 'khyams: 'bum dang phyogs bcu mun sel rnga sgra 'don: me tog dmar thang sātstsha chab gtor 'bum: dbang med khrid dang bag med 'gro ba dang : me long blta na nyi khri bgres zhus 'don: nyi nub mun sros g.yas g.yon g.yang sar lhung : mthur du 'gro dang mtshon phog tshur 'phyong na: nye'u 'don mar me glud gtor brgya rtsa bya: bong bu spre'u zhon srog bslu 'bum lnga 'don: gnas khang zhig ral btson dong sngar gshe mang : lha dang srung ma'i mchod bskang brgya rtsa 'bad: mi mthun chas zhugs dug can zas ngan zos: byin ldan gnas chen bskor phyag lha khang gso: thag ring 'gro 'dod yi dam bsnyen sgrub bzung : spyod gnyis 'gur la dge 'dun bsnyen bkur bya: glo bur longs spyod brdol ba pang thag btags: tshe gzugs gtan nas ma mthong mdo sde 'don: na rag dam bskang sde brgyad spyi mdos bya: phyag mtshan med na tshogs gtor brgya rtsa 'bul: lag gnyis med na brgya bzhi stong rtsa 'bul: rkang gnyis med na gra tog bsdus pa 'don: mgo phyed med na gtsug tor rol pa bsgrag: mgo bo yongs rdzogs med na mgo lnga 'don: ro stod med na gzungs 'dus mtshan 'bum 'don: ro smad med na bskang bshags ma mdos rdzongs: lus g.yas med na gtsug tor dri med 'don: lus g.yon med na chab gtor sa snying 'don: lag g.yon med na sman lha'i cho ga 'don: rkang g.yon med na don zhags cho ga 'bad: lag g.yas med na zhi sreg mang du bya: rkang g.yas med na tshe mdo khri tshar 'don:

lhu tshigs med na gzungs sgrub mang du bya: de dag rnams ni rim gro'i bzlog pa'o: de las log pas gru gsum ro dum tsam: tshogs 'khor brgya stong bla mar maṇḍal 'bul: mdor na dngos po ci yod spang thabs bya: bya bral 'dzin med ngang nas bzlog pa'ang srid: tshe gzugs mthar ni dkar po yal ba na: klu bdud btsan mdos rgyal po skya mdos bya: de bzhin sngo skyar yal ba srung mar mchod: nag por skag bzlog spar kha bsgyur mdos bya: dmar por btsan mdos dbang phyug zor mdos bya: ser por brgya bzhi chos skyong gzhi bdag gsol: sngon por klu gtor mtsho sman dgu mdos bya: smug por khram bsgyur nag po mgo gsum bya: dud khar las sgrom nag mo skyes 'degs bya: ljang gur lang gshegs 'char kha gtsug tor 'don: dbyibs mdog ma nges grib mdos bskang bshags 'bad: khyad par dngos po gang yang 'dzin chags spang : mchod sbyin 'bad cing nyams len gtsug lag skyor: sgrub pa lhur blang bdud bzhi'i bar gcod bzlog: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa bye brag bzlog pa'i cho ga ni: dben par tshe yi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i lhor: dur khrod ro g.yam nag po che ba'i khar: mdze dme rabs chad yugs sa'i sha khrag dri: ro thal khang stong phung shul rgya lam sa: 'dre 'tshub lung gsum 'dus mdo'i sa chu dang : chu mig lkug dang rta bong dri chus sbrus: 'chi bdag gzugs ni mngon rtogs ltar du chos: gri khrag ro sol byugs pa'i snying kha ru: zur gsum du dang zla gam dug gsum dang : gling drug rigs drug sa bon bris pa bzhugs: stan nag steng du byang phyogs kha bstan bzhag: rang gi dra dri 'bru sna'i phye bsres pa'i: ngar glud dkar ser dmar ljang khra bo lngar: dar tshon bal ras sgro phod sna tshogs btsugs: rang gi gos bkon changs zan lo grangs bskor: gzhan yang dmar gtor sha dum kyu gu sogs:

brgya rtsa la sogs dgos gal che chung bstun: rdzongs 'debs lan chags 'jal ba'i 'bru sna dang : zas sna mar thud gser dngul dar zab ja: bza' btung rigs byed gang 'dzoms gshin rje'i mdun: ting lo sbar zhing sngags dang phyag rgyas brlab: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum/ rang nyid dbang chen khro bo ting 'dzin gyis: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar nag tsha: lci zhing 'thas pa 'og phyogs sa gzhir phog: shig ge gas pa'i klong nas rgya mtsho mer: de dbus 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje ni: sku mdog nag po mun ltar 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro gnyer spyan gsum mche gtsigs ral pa bcings: g.yas pas khram shing g.yon pas bsha' gri 'dzin: stag lpags sham thabs mgo phreng mi lpags gyon: skra sen ba spu lcags kyu lta bu 'bar: me rlung dud 'tshub glog dmar 'khyugs pa'i klong : snang srid lha 'dre gdon bgegs kun gyis bskor: chu glang rngam skad dir sgra 'ur chom ldir: mngon sum lta bur bka' sdod dam gnas gyur: om̐ du tri du tri sa mā ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'gugs 'dren drag po lan gsum bya: na moḥ mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bcas: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i bden pa yis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: sngon gyi lan chags 'phral gdon glo bur rkyen: pho 'dre mo gdon ma ning yul 'dre bcas: lo zla zhag skag steng du rtsub pa yi: srid pa'i gdon tshogs yas glud bdag po rnams: skad cig myur ba nyid du 'dir khug cig: badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

de nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams srung rgyas bcings: 'chi bdag 'khor bcas rnam lnga'i mchod pas mchod: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i mthu bo che: 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la: snang ba mdzes pa'i me tog dang : sha sna'i gsur chen tshim pa'i dri: rang snang gsal ba'i zhun chen sgron: khrag zhag mkhris pa'i btung ba 'khyil: sha rus spungs pa'i ro ldan zas: rkang gling dur khrod rol mo'i sgra: snang srid rngam brjid spyan gzigs bcas: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas kyang : las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: badzra ma hā sha ma sha na puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: de nas bka' bsgau bstod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi dngos: dbang chen khrag 'thung padma he ru kaḥ snang stong sku yi phyag rgya'i 'khor los khyab: grags stong gsung gi hūm̐ sgra 'gags pa med: gsal stong thugs kyi rang bzhin yongs khyab la: 'bar ba'i gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi lhun: snang srid thams cad nga yi rol rtsal te: gnyis 'dzin log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: 'bar ba'i dbyings kyi rgya las ma 'da' zhig: om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ las grub pa'i 'chi bdag stobs po che: mthing nag mun rub spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyugs: lcags kyi ral pa sprugs shing dug char 'bebs: srid gsum srog gi bdag po khyod la bstod: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs rngam pa'i nga ro yis: khams gsum g.yo 'khrugs srid gsum srog dbugs za: rdzu 'phrul 'byung ba'i 'khor los thams cad 'joms: rngam gtum drag shul can la phyag 'tshal bstod: khram shing dug gsum rigs drug mig dgu yis: skye 'gro srog chags thams cad khram la 'debs: rlung gi shugs ldan mun zhags mda' ltar 'phen: khams gsum bla srog 'chi bdag khyod la bstod: gri nag so gcig 'gro ba'i srog rtsa gcod: skra sen lcags kyus 'gro drug lus kun gtub:

ba spu'i mtshon cha rno ngar rab 'bar bas: sprul pa'i las byed dpag med 'gyed la bstod: pho nya'i tshogs rnams rngam stabs phyogs bcur rgyug: sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gnas rnams nyul: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun bas stobs chen dpal: kun gyi gshin rje 'od 'phrog khyod la bstod: khyod kyi zhe sdang cha las bdud dang srin: 'dod chags rang mdangs ma mo klu srin tshogs: gti mug las bskyed rmu sogs ma ning sde: snang srid dregs pa'i bdag po khyod la bstod: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i: 'dod yon mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di longs la: phan dge byang sems rgyud la gnas par mdzod: om̐ du tri du tri badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dam la bzhag: de nas glud kyi cho 'brang 'don: spyi ru bsngo zhing khyad par du: glud gtor 'brang bu brgya rtsa rnams: rgya chen shugs ldan 'bru gsum gyis: byin rlabs 'dod yon dpag med spel: lhag par sha khrag rang bzhin bsam: bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: gsum/ mchod pa'i yo byad 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'char kha nag po snang srid lha srin rigs drug lan chags 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: tshim par gyur cig: om̐ du tri du tri dza hūm̐ thā i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas brgya stong ci 'grub 'bul: hūm̐: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang : pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i sde: stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon tshogs rnams: srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam pa yi: mchod sbyin 'dod yon glud gtor 'di: khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams:

'dod srid chags dang zhen pa dang : dran reg mthong reg bzung ba kun: zhi dang glod cig da phrol cig: sngon gyi lan chags sha 'khon dang : bu lon 'phral gyi rkyen la sogs: gang yin ma lus 'khor bar mdzod: bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni: chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis: gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa'i: bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig: ces bsngos pas 'chi bdag 'khor bcas tshims par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum dmar nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod nams dbang thang gdul bya la bar du gcod pa thams cad rang dbang med par liṅga dgra gzugs gnyis su med par gyur: gzugs kyi phung po bza' ba sha ri khrag mtsho gtor ma glud rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zag pa med par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: lan gsum/ gtor ma sha ri khrag mtsho glud rdzas zag med 'di nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'char kha nag po snang srid lha srin gdon bgegs ma mo rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po ma ning yul 'dre lan chags glud kyi bdag po rnams la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: tshim par gyur cig: om̐ du tri du tri dza hūm̐ thā i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: rku 'phrog bcom gsum nor dbul ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: gshe skur 'chal gtam mi kha sdang ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: rdung rdeg btsog gsum zug gzer nad mang ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: bsad bcad gtub gsum tshe thung ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: bskyed rdzogs zur nyams gzugs byad ngan pa'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: ces bsngo 'khor bcas tshim par bsam: de nas snod gtsang mar rdzongs 'debs lan chags 'jal rdzas bkod: sngags drug phyag rgyas 'don bsgyur spel: om̐ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddha ྅haṃ/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ki te na maḥ sa manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni swā hā/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ gra he shwa ri prañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ kyaiḥ 'chi bdag las kyi bdag po 'khor bcas dgongs: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: tshe rabs thog ma med nas da bar gyi: lan chags bu lon stong phrag kun 'jal gyis: deng nas ma gnod ma 'tshe yas kha longs: 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa gtan nas spongs: tshe srog las kyi bskyed pa bshol thob la: lo brgya'i bar du sun khas ma sdang cig: ces brjod 'chi bdag 'khor bcas kyis: mtshon thogs hab sgra di ri bar: bu lon lan chags len par bsam: ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyis bsngo: sha khrag zas sna'i dri gsur btang : gshin rje'i drung du gzhi nag ste: 'bru nag phye sogs bre phul bzhag: gser dngul mar thud srang la btegs: dar zab gos chas grangs kyi tshad: gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang : bye ba sa ya dung phyur bshar: de ltar lan chags 'jal zin nas: 'chi bdag zhal kha phyi la bsgyur: yas glud cha bgos mdun du bzhag: dri gsur dag kyang so sor bsham: rang nyid dbang drag dpa' gdeng gis: hūm̐: nyon cig 'chi bdag las gshin dregs pa'i tshogs: khyed rnams las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan: khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog bdag chen po ste: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi 'khor dang bcas: ma lus tshim byed mchod sbyin glud gtor ni: rgya che gting zab srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam: gang 'dod ting 'dzin sngags rgyas 'dod rgur spel: lan chags kun 'khor re ba'i yas kha khengs: deng nas bdag cag rgyu 'byor yon bdag la:

gnod pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mi 'tshal yang : sngar nas gnod pa yod na khram kha phyes: bcings pa yod na 'chi bdag zhags pa phrol: bsad pa yod na bdud kyi khram kha sgyur: zos pa yod na bla tshe bde bar klod: za kha rno mtshon thams cad dgra la sgyur: lan chags stong rin gang yod 'jal zin pas: mi bslu 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag nas thar: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: 'gyur med sku gsung thugs su rgyas thob cig: dkon mchog bka' dang chos nyid bden pa'i mthus: bgegs rgyal da song rang rang gnas bskyod 'tshal: sarba bhū ta gatstsha: zhes brjod la: 'chi bdag gshin rje nyid: rgya mtshor ri rab 'gyel ba ltar: chob sgra dang bcas mtsho la thim: 'khor gyi bgegs rigs tshogs rnams kyang : rang rang 'dod pa'i yas khyer te: sa 'og sa steng ma nges par: ha sgra dir gyis byer bar bsam: gshin gzugs chu bo chen po'i gzhung : yang na lung pa'i gzhi mdor bskyal: gang yang rang gnas ma mthong gces: glud gtor brgya rtsa lo bdud dang : phyogs bzhi mtshams su gtong bar bya: gshin rje thim shul rgya mtsho'i khar: lam las gser gyi ri rab steng : dbang chen pho brang btab par dmigs: shul phyags steng du skyer phur gi: las phur gzugs shing zhag gsum bzhag: yang na sātstsha bzhag kyang rung : mthar ni srung sgo'i steng du bzhag: drag sngags sprul pa'i khro tshogs kyis: stong khams bkang ste bskrad gzir gzhom: srung 'khor bsgom zhing byin chen dbab: nad pa yin na tshe dbang bskur: rang don tshe yi bsnyen par 'bad: dbang blang shis brjod dkyil 'khor bsdu: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab: des ni 'chi bdag khar tshud kyang : lo gsum bar du 'chi ba bslu: gang zhig 'chi ltas ma phog kyang : lo zad zla smad brtsam gyur na: rim gro kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur: spyir ni lo zad nyi ldog mtshams: las kyi gshin rje'i kha lhags nas: 'jig rten stong khams thams cad nyul:

khams gsum skye 'gro khram la 'debs: de tshe rnal 'byor gang zhig gis: yi dam lha yi bskyed rim dang : chos nyid bden pa bsten gyur na: lus ngag ye shes rtsis thebs te: 'chi bdag gshin rjes ltar mi bzod: rang lus rdo rje'i sku thob 'gyur: de phyir bsnyen sgrub brtsam pa yis: zab mo'i don la yengs med bskyang : 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ las snang las kyi 'khrul pa'i rkyen: bag chags sbyong byed thugs rje'i mthus: zhi rgyas dbang drag 'dus pa yi: phrin las sbyor bas tshe bdud gzhom: de phyir zab gsang gter du rgya: las can thugs kyi sras dang sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes/ sa phag lor mkha' 'gro snying phug nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor padma sbas pa'i tshal khrom gzigs gshin rje'i gnas mdor shog ser las zhal bshus so/ /bre srang dag gi byed lugs 'di ltar ro: bre srang shing la mi bskyur gyi sngags bzlas: brer 'bru re blug la gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya'i grangs bcu mkhar du byas te glud bzhag go: 'bru rigs kun bya'o: rin po che'i rigs kun zho 'chor btegs nas gzhol: mar thud la sogs srang 'jal rigs kun de ltar bya'o: snam phrug gos dar ras kun grangs bshar byas nas gzhol: rta phyugs kyi rigs zan grangs bcad du bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i las tshogs nas bris pa'o// // ca) glud gtor changs bu brgya rtsa rnams: rgya chen shugs ldan 'bru gsum gyis: byin rlabs 'dod yon dpag med spel: dkar gsum sna tshogs brten pa'o: bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa nam mkha' mdzod du gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum mam sogs/ mchod pa'i yo byad 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'char kha nag po snang srid lha srin rigs drug lan chags 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: tshim par gyur cig: om̐ du tri du tri dza hūm̐ thā i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pa brgya stong du mas 'bul/ hūm̐: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang : pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i sde: stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon tshogs rnams: srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam pa yi: mchod sbyin 'dod yon glud gtor 'di: khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams: 'dod srid chags dang zhen pa dang : dran reg mthong reg bzung ba kun: zhi dang glod cig da phrol cig: sngon gyi lan chags sha 'khon dang : bu lon 'phral gyi rkyen la sogs: gang yin ma lus 'khor bar mdzod: bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni: chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis: gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa'i: bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig: ces bsngos pas 'chi bdag 'khor bcas tshims par bsam/ de nas mdun du gtor snod gtsang*/ rdzongs 'debs lan chags 'jal rdzas bkod/ om̐ swa bhā w sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum dmar nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod nams dbang thang gdul bya la bar du gcod pa thams cad rang dbang med par liṅga dgra gzugs gnyis su med par gyur: gzugs kyi phung po bza' ba sha ri khrag mtsho gtor ma glud rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zag pa med par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: lan gsum/ gtor ma sha ri khrag mtsho glud rdzas zag med 'di nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'char kha nag po snang srid lha srin gdon bgegs ma mo rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po ma ning yul 'dre lan chags glud kyi bdag po rnams la bsngo'o 'bul lo tshim par gyur cig:

om̐ du tri du tri dza hūm̐ thā i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: rku 'phrog bcom gsum nor dbul ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: gshe skur 'chal gtam mi kha sdang ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: rdung rdeg btsog gsum zug gzer nad mang ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: bsad bcad gtub gsum tshe thung ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: bskyed rdzogs zur nyams gzugs byad ngan pa'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: ces glud yas mdos nang du 'bul/ kyaiḥ 'chi bdag las kyi bdag po 'khor bcas dgongs: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: tshe rabs thog ma med nas da bar gyi: lan chags bu lon stong phrag kun 'jal gyis: deng nas ma gnod ma 'tshe yas kha longs: 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa gtan nas spongs: tshe srog las kyi bskyed pa bshol thob la: lo brgya'i bar du sun khas ma sdang cig: skyid grong smyon pas sbyar ba'o/ ram̐ ram̐ mig gnyis la yam̐ yam̐ rna ba gnyis la bam̐ kha la lam̐ lce la e snying gar bcug dza ma tha a su nṛ tri pre du:

cha) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: sngon 'gro'i gsol 'debs dbang lhun gzi 'bar bzhugs so: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la 'dud: tshe sgrub yang snying 'dus pa lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi sngon du 'gro ba theg pa spyi rim skyabs yul brgyud 'debs ni: e ma hoḥ 'og min rnam dag bkod pa'i pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' tshe bdag yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings rig mkha' spyod gsang ba'i pho brang nas: gtso mo tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro sde lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: mtshungs med gu ru padma yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bod yul yang rdzong shel brag gnas mchog nas: gnubs ban buddha dzñā na yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brda bzhi bka' bab lung bstan pho brang nas: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'chi med mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i snying phug nas: zab chos yang snying lcags kyi rgya mdud la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab rgya bka' gtad skyong ba'i pho brang nas: bka' skyong dam can gter gyi bdag po la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyud pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus: thugs rje'i byin rlabs gzi byin mchog g.yo ba'i: nus chen brtse ba'i dbang bzhi deng bskur nas: nam yang mi shigs rdo rje'i skur gyur te:

'od gsal 'ja' lus gzugs mchog der gnas shog: om̐ hrīḥ.ā yurdzñā na ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes sngon 'gro'i gsol 'debs rdzogs nas mi dmigs ting 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos mkha' 'gro snying phug nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ja) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub bzhugs so: chos sku snang mtha' 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: mi 'gyur g.yung drung tshe yi lha la 'dud: padma'i thugs bcud yang snying bsgrub pa'i chos: zab gsang rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs bdud rtsi'i rgyun: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin dngos grub pas: yang zab tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud bstan: mi shigs mi 'gyur brtan pa'i snying thig 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dben gnas byin chags yid 'ong gnas mchog tu: sa gzhi byin brlabs dkyil 'khor gzhi blang zhing : mtshan ldan rig mas tshe lam thig gdab bo: dbus su bhandha mtshan ldan ril bus bkang : me long sindhu ra yi dkyil 'khor bri: tshe gtor tshe bum bzhi yis bskor ba la: mda' dar la sogs 'ja' tshon sna tshogs bri: de nas phyogs bzhi dag la bum pa bzhi: sgo bzhi'i phyag mtshan bzhi yis spras pa bcas: mchod rdzas yo byad 'byor tshad bsham: sngon 'gro'i gnad bdun rdzogs nas dal sbyang ngo : de nas bde ba'i stan la bag phebs 'khod: skyabs sems ni: e ma hoḥ sku gsum klong yangs ye shes snying po'i thugs: gdod nas rang byung ka dag ji bzhin du: 'bad rtsol bral ba'i ngang nas sems bskyed do: skye 'chi du khaḥmi dmigs bag yod blos: sgyu ma'i gar tsam mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i snang tshul de bzhin skyabs su mchi: bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'bar ba dbang gi sku: dkyil 'khor bar gcod tshe yi bdud:

mchod sbyin khyer la rang sar dengs: bar du gcod pa rdul du rlog: om̐ hya ghṛ wa badzra wā ra hī gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ de nas mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'od zer glog stong drwa ba 'gyed: 'byung lnga mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: las kyi tshe bdud mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra padma tsakra hūm̐ bhrūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rlung me sa chu las: 'byung ba yongs gyur gzhal yas khang : ma bcos lhun grub zhing khams nas: chu nang zla ltar dkyil 'khor gsal: hūm̐ ā yurdzñā na bhrūm̐: lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dran rig rang snang gnyis med zla gdan du: shes rig ngo bo g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : gsal stong hrīḥlas tshe bdag yab yum ni: gu ru padma gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: tshe yi bdag po padma dbang gi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal dri med rā ga'i mdog: longs spyod rgyan ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mnyam bzhag sbyor tshul tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sems kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar bcud kyis bkang : phyed skyil pang du shes rab kun 'dus ma: dmar mo chags nyams bcu drug lang tsho ldan: rin chen rgyan ldan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: dga' bzhi dbang sdud tshe yi bcud 'dzin bsgom: phyi rol sgo ma tshe yi las mdzad ma: dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: rang mdog rgyan ldan gar stabs khro chas can: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: phyag g.yas tshe bsod bcud bsdus tshul du bsgom: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsdus nas stims: tshe yi lha tshogs gsal 'tsher gzi 'bar bsgom: 'od 'phros tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnga yab mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: tshe bdag padma yab yum dang : sgo ma mkha' 'gro tshe bdag rnams: mkha' spyod tshe yi gnas mchog nas:

gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal sdig bshags mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs: sku bzhi lhun grub mchod pa 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bde stong gar sgyur gsang ba'i yum: 'chi med bcud 'dzin yab la stob: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan lhub mdzes: lha lcam tshe yi bdag mor bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus khams lngar stim: rlung lnga'i grogs mdzad bde skyed ma: rigs bzhi tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: kun 'dus sgrub cing bsnyen pa'i lha: gzi brjid 'od klong dpal du 'bar: tshe bsod bcud bsdus lus la stims: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: gu ru tshe lha yongs rdzogs kyi: dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs la bstod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ rang gi gnas gsum du rgya mdud rgya gram g.yung drung bris pas tshe yi bar chad sel: a ma ril bur li khri rgya mtshal rnams tshe yi rten du byug: tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las byang 'di: bka' srung las kyi gza' mchog khyod la gtad: gter srung gnod sbyin khyod kyis thub par srungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gatha:

hūm̐ ka la drag po rtsal gyis sa phag lor mkha' 'gro snying phug nas gdan drangs pa'o// // nya) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: rtsa ba'i sgrub pa 'chi med rdo rje bzhugs: mi 'gyur g.yung drung 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ 'og min gnas nas legs sprul nas: snang mtha'i zer las thugs rje'i sku: dpal ldan sangs rgyas padma skyes: kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob nas: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin grub: 'dzam gling rgya bod sa steng du: tshe sgrub sbas pa kun gyi nang : 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud 'di: thugs kyi yang zhun min re kan: skal ldan las can re tsam las: kun dang thun mong ma yin pas: shin tu gsang bar spyod cig bu: sdig can rnams la nges par gsang : log lta can la a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang rgyud lung dang mthun zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas gtsang sar: yar tshes gza' skar bzang po la sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yo byad thams cad tshogs par bsham: bkra shis shing rten 'brel che ba'i gnas rnams dang : grub thob gong ma sku tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i gnas sa blang la: dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu gnas gong gi phyogs dang bstun pa legs par brtsigs shing rnam lnga dang bdud rtsi'i chag chag gdab: padma can gyi rig mar thig sna gtad la: ye thig dang sbyor thig sogs spro na tshul bzhin gdab: lte bar padma 'dab bzhi'am brgyad bcas la lha mdog gzhung ltar 'od phreng gis bskor: gru chad sgo khyams pad phreng me ri sogs spyi ltar las tshon snyoms par bkye: bsdu na pad 'dab 'od phreng tsam dang : 'bru tshom sogs rnal 'byor pa'i blo rig dang bstun: de nas bum pa dmar po mtshan ldan gu gul gyis bdug cing bgegs bskrad la: khye'u'am na chung gtsang ma mtshan ldan bkra shis skal bzang g.yang zhag ma nyams pa'i g.yu mtsho'am:

rgyun babs kyi chu blangs te bum par bskyil: lnga tshan lnga yi rdzas dang bla ma grub thob gong ma'i tshe chu'i phabs rgyun btab: dar ras dmar po'i mgul chings bya: mya ngan dang bral ba'i shing 'bras bu can gyis kha brgyan: dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig btsugs te dar dmar gyis dgab: gzung thag lnga dril btags: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su maṇa khrir bkod: de yi steng du bhandha dum bu gcig pa tshe lam bzang ba mtshan ldan gcig gi nang du srid pa pho yi bcud cong zhi: mo yi bcud brag zhun: sa bcud mu zi: chu bcud lan tshwa: me bcud man shel: rlung bcud bya rgod mkhris pa: rtsi thog bcud mar: me tog bcud sbrang rtsi: shing gi bcud bu ram: 'bru bcud chang : tshe bcud rin chen sna tshogs: bkrag mdangs kyi bcud li khri: byin rlabs kyi bcud bde gshegs byang sems kyi gdung dang ring bsrel te rtsa ba'i rdzas bcu gsum: de yi kha tshar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: grogs kyi dpung bskyed dzā ti: li shi: cu gang : ka ko la: sug smel: a ru ra: ba ru ra: skyu ru ra rnams zhib par btul zhing : 'bras zan dang dam par sbyar la: ril bu gla ba'i ril ma tsam dril: kha dog dmar por bsgyur la re re bzhin hrīḥyig re re bri: ka pā lar blugs la dar dmar gyis bcad: ratna'i me long la sindhu ras chos 'byung bsnol mar tshe sngags dang dga' 'khyil bris pas dgab: dar dmar gyi gur phub la bzhag: bkra shis tshe ring gi lag nas tshe chang tshe mda' sogs blang : snying po lngas bsgrubs pa'i tshe zan la tshe 'brang dkar dmar gyis byugs pa rin po che'i snod du blugs la bum pa'i g.yas su bzhag: g.yon du bhandha dum gsum mtshan ldan gyi nang du tshe chang bdud rtsi a mṛ ta dang sbyar ba'i mar ril brgya rtsa'am: mched lcam gyi grangs dang bstun pa'i rtags dang ldan par blugs: dar dmar gyis dgab: rgyab tu tshe nas kyi khar mda' dar dar sna lnga ldan la tshe rten bu mo yid 'ong mtshan ldan lag nas me long blangs te btags:

mdun dang zur bzhir mda' dar re: mdun du tshe gtor zlum po 'dab brgyad zas sna phud kyis bskor ba dang sman raka: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas: sku gsung thugs rten da la'i rgyan bkod spyan gzigs sogs gang 'byor mdzes shing bag dro bar bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bdag nyid rdo rje dang g.yung drung gi stan la 'dug ste: gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin zhing bka' bsgo 'byung gtor bsngos la mtshams bcad: steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rwa gur mtshon tshogs 'khrugs shing me 'od gur gyis 'byung lnga'i khams thams cad gtams pas cis kyang mi shigs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la: thog mar bdag nyid rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa kha gso ba dang : dam rdzas gzi byin bskyed phyir bsnyen pa zhag gsum bya: de nas tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad 'byung yab yum skur gnas gyur pa las byang ltar spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyi bar bya'o: de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags brjod la: om̐ swa bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: 'og min lhun grub brdal khyab chen po'i klong : rin chen padma rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: ye shes lnga yi pho brang gzhal med khang : gru bzhi sgo rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs: mi sgrib zang thal 'od klong 'khyil ba'i dbus: rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin chen khrir: padma nyi zla'i gdan la thog ma'i mgon: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: padma 'byung gnas ye shes ngo bo mchog: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag 'chi med tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rab rdzogs bde stong skyil krung gis: pang du ye shes dpag med dkar gsal 'dzum: pad phreng tshe bum 'dzin pa'i mgul nas 'khyud: skra grol rin chen padma'i rgyan drug mdzes: yab yum gnyis med nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: thugs rje rol pa ye shes sku lnga'i mdangs:

phyogs bzhir glang chen rta mchog seṅge dang : shang shang padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rdo rje rin chen sangs rgyas las kyi rigs: tshe dpag med mgon yab yum dkar gsal mthing : ljang gsal gtso bo'i chas ldan tshe bum la: rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo rgya gram mtshan: phyi rim phyogs mtshams padma 'dab brgyad la: sgeg phreng la sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad: g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: sgo bzhir tshe yi khro bo rta mchog dpal: dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu zhags pa dang : lcags sgrog dril bu tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: rigs kyi yum 'khril rang rang 'khor tshogs 'bum: gzhan yang phyi nang steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun: tshe yi rig 'dzin drang srong srung ma'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab 'od zer glog stong 'khyugs: mdor na chos dbyings zhing kun ma lus pa: 'chi med tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor zer dpung 'khrigs: kun kyang ye shes snying po mtshan dpe'i sku: thugs rje'i 'od snang nyi zla ther 'bum bzhin: 'od dang zer 'khrugs lta bas mi bzod cing : 'bar ba'i shugs kyis tshe bdud 'byung po gzhom: tshe yi sngags sgra 'brug stong lta bur ldir: sgrub la 'chi med dngos grub stsol bar bsgom: de nas rang gi thugs kar gnam lcags kyi: rgya gram lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang : srog rten nṛ yig ljang gur 'od lnga 'phros: g.yas su tshe srog mi 'gyur āḥdakar po: g.yon du brtan par byed pa'i hūm̐ mthing kaḥ gsum ka bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams stobs: ma lus skad cig sdud pa'i nus pa ldan: de las 'od zer gzung thag gnyis med 'phros: mdun bskyed thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang : hrīḥyig dmar gsal rab tu 'tsher la phog: gdung bas rgyud bskul bde stong gzi brjid g.yos: rang mdangs rtsal 'phros rigs bzhi 'khor tshogs kyi: stobs bskyed rang rang sku las 'od tshogs 'phros:

phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams tshe byin dang : nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung bcud: 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dpal srog gi rten: āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rang bzhin 'ub 'ub tu: rings par bsdus shing tshe bum mer gyis khengs: chil chil khol bas thams cad gtso bum ru: sib sib blug cing tshe 'dzab di ri ri: bdud rtsi khol zhing phyur ba bar med babs: yab yum sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun: lhan cig bdag gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug zhugs: gsang gnas yan chad dkar dmar ltem gyis gang : de yang tshe yi ngo bo bcud kyi bcud: dwangs ma'i dwangs ma thams cad 'ub kyis drangs: nṛ hūm̐ āḥl thim pas bkrag mdangs 'bar: 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros te: snod bcud khyab pas 'khor bcas tshe dpal gyi: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad 'ub 'ub bsdus: snying kha'i 'bru gsum la thim srog rtsa gang : bdag nyid bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar rdo rje'i sku: dngos su gyur te nyi zla'i gwa'u nyid: kha 'grig 'og gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi: rwa bzhi gyen langs bsnol mar rgya mdud steng : rgyas btab rwa rtser 'od zer me tshwa 'phros: rtsa gnas ba spur rta mgrin grangs med bstim: bar gcod srung zhing bdud tshogs 'byung po bsregs: rgya mdud steng du ye shes tshe dpag med: dkar gsal tshon gang 'gyur med rtag bzhugs bsgom:

rtsa bsnyen ni: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: smra bcad grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gnyis: yang na dus bsnyen zhag ni nyer gcig sgrub: dam par mtshams bcad mtshan rtags phyi nang gsal: lus bde shes pa gsal zhing bsnyen sgrub spro: rmi lam gangs ri rtse mthor 'dzegs pa dang : mchod rten sātstsha mang mthong btsan rdzong bzung : mkhar brtseg nyi zla shar dang chu bo brgal: chang dang 'o ma bdud rtsi bcud 'thung zhing : skra ring bshad dang go gyon mtshon cha thogs: rol mo 'bud dkrol chas gzab nyi zla mid: lo tog legs dang 'bru la longs spyod dang : zhal mjal lung ston bum chu khol dang 'phyur: 'od 'phros rlangs 'byung dri bzang 'thul ba dang : spos dang mar me dri bzang 'ja' rkang zug: sa g.yo ri 'bir la sogs dpag med rnams: de dag nges par tshe mchog grub pa'i rtags: de las log pa'i ngan rtog za ba rnams: rang gar byung na tshe yi sgrub par 'bad: sgrub dus bzang ngan 'dres mar byung ba rnams: sgrub pa bskyar zhing spog chog nan tan bskyed: chag sgo yod pas rtags rdzogs bar du bsgrub: bzang por gyur na the tshom med par bzlog: de ltar sgrub pa'i dbu btsugs ma thon bar: thun bzhi thun drug gsum sogs gang brtsam yang : thun mthar mdun bskyed rang nyid padma'i sku: tshe lha rigs lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo la: gsol btab mos gus gdung bas thugs dam bskul: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus stobs rtsal gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bskul: bar du bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang dbang blang : thun mtshams rgyas gdab dmigs med dbyings su bzhag: le lo rnam g.yeng tshig bar skad cig tsam: ma chod rtse gcig sgrub pa'i dam bca' bzung : de ltar dus grangs them mam rtags rdzogs nas: dbang blang dngos grub blang ba'i dus la bab: mchod bstod tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par 'bul:
