'dod pa'i don la gsol ba rtse gcig gdab: sgrub rdzas thams cad o rgyan tshe dpag med: dngos su bzhugs snyam yid ches nges shes bskyed: nam mkhas gar khyab tshe dpag med pa'i sku: che chung ma nges thib thib yom yom mer: snying po sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri: lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis bsnyen dbyangs 'ur: rig 'dzin rgya mtshos byin rlabs char chen 'bebs: lha tshogs thams cad 'od 'bar mda' dar g.yab: 'khor 'das lam gsum tshe dpal gzi brjid bsdus: bdag la bstim zhing g.yon pa'i tshe bum gyis: dbang bskur tshe bcud spyi bor thim par dmigs: e maḥ rje btsun 'gro mgon thugs rje can: pad 'byung sku lnga yab yum tshe dpag med: gnyis med gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug ma: tshe lha rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshogs: bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang : 'chi med tshe bcud bdud rtsis rab tu bkang : bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar sgrub tshad mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la da bab na: mgon po khyod kyi tshe zhag dus 'dir lags: thugs la le lo btang snyoms ma mdzad par: rdo rje'i nam langs nyi zla nam mkhar shar: rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: rig 'dzin sgrub la tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: skye 'chi med pa tshe yi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags sham bu ni: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa a yurdzñā na hrīḥm ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: om̐ badzra ratna buddha padma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ hūm̐ swā om̐ hā a bhi ṣiñtsa satwaṃ: zhes dbang blang zhing tshe chu 'thung : sgrub rdzas ril bu lnga myong zhing : tshe chang nang gi ril bu yang : tshe sgrub yin na so sor sbyin: tshe ril tshe chang kun la rol: gong ltar bcud bsdus rgya yis gdab: gtor ma btang la dal bsdu zhing : bkra shis bsngo smon rjes chog bya: de ltar bsgrub pa'i rdzas rnams kun: gzhan gyi mthong dang sbyin mi rung :

tshe chu tshe chang la sogs pa: gzhan gyi lag brgyud mi gtong bar: ril bu rgyun du bsten par bya: bdud rtsi byin rlabs tho rangs dus: tshe yi ting 'dzin dang bcas te: thog mar gsum gsum bsten par bya: de nas lnga bdun bcu gcig sogs: rim par bsten zhing khams kyi zas: bag gyis phri zhing goms par slob: mthar ni rtsam pa'i kha zas spangs: 'o chang btung ba'i rigs rnams dang : gzhan yang khams dang bstun par spyad: sgo gsum bya ba dgu phrugs btang : rtog med khyab brdal ngang nyams bskyang : thog mar ban bun phyad phyod 'byung : de nas ril bu rdzogs pa dang : rdzas kyi nus pa rtsa khams la: smin tshe rig rtsal phyogs med grol: lus kyang rtsal chen bkrag mdangs 'bar: thun mong yon tan dpag med thob: mchog gi ting 'dzin mngon du byed: dka' thub srang du ma gyur na: tho rangs lnga gsum rgyun du bsten: 'phrod pa'i zas dang spyod lam spyod: slar du yang ni lo re bzhin: bdun gsum nyer gcig sgrub dam bca': rtag tu tho rangs nyi shar khar: brgya rtsa re re nges par bzla: snum zad mar me bsnan pa'am: nad pa sman gyis gsos pa ltar: zad pa bsring zhing bri ba 'gengs: nyams pa spel lam rgyas par byed: tshe la rang dbang thob par 'gyur: mdor na rang don gzhan don dang : gdul bya phrin las 'dod pa'i don: ci ltar sgrub kyang rnal 'byor pa: sku tshe ring nas ci bsam 'grub: de bas mchog thun gang bsgrub kyang : tshe sgrub pa la nan tan 'tshal: tshul bzhin sus bsgrubs tshe mthar phyin: tshe tshad dag la dbang 'byor bas: bya byed gang brtsam rgyas bsdus dang : spang blang ji ltar 'dod bzhin chog: padma'i thugs kyi yang zhun te: brgyud 'dzin snying 'dra ma gtogs pa: kun la rlung phyogs tsam mi bsgrag: sdig can rnams la shin tu gsang : 'di ltar tshul bzhin nyams len na: tshe mthar phyin par ma gyur na: padma bdag gis 'gro ba bslus: drang don bslu tshig yin re kan:

sa ma ya: e maḥ 'chi med lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi: rtsa ba'i srog sgrub yang zhun 'di: mi zad zab mo'i gter du rgya: dus mthar nga sprul thugs kyi sras: hūm̐ nag rtsal dang 'phrad pa'i tshe: rten 'brel lung gi brda ltar phob: gsang rgya ma ral gter sgrub 'bungs: tshe dang gdul bya mthar phyin 'gyur: thog mar rang nyams ma lon par: gzhan la spel na byin rlabs g.yel: ma langs chang la chu bsrings bzhin: dngos grub bcud kyi 'bras bu yal: de bzhin phyi rabs rjes 'jug pa: bka' bab rig 'dzin sum cu gnyis: thugs kyi sras brgyad la sogs pa: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bu mchog dang : snying nas chos byed bstan la phan: sgo gsum bla ma mnyes byed la: sgrub pa'i mna' rgyas thob la byin: de dag rnams kyang snod ldan la: bka' srol ma nyams spel ba gces: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur: kha mkhas zol 'grogs g.yo sgyu can: gdams pa'i tshad nyul nyams len dred: bka' rkun drin du mi bzo bar: slob dpon gsang nas rang che 'byin: dam med rnams dang sdig chen la: byin na bka' srung chad pas brdeg: de bas 'tsho skyong shes par gyis: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa phag lor mkha' 'gro snying phug nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor padma sbas tshal du shog ser las zhal bshus so// // ta) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las: tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya bzhugs so: de nas thugs dam bskul zhing tshe 'gugs pa ni: mda' dar g.yab cing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do: hūm̐: sngon tshe ka dag chos sku'i klong : lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang : dbyings phyug lha mo tsaṇḍa lī: 'chi med rdo rje'i skur bzhengs te: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas bzhin:

deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de 'og dag snang longs sku'i zhing : rā ga ra ta'i dbang phug tu: rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje dang : mkha' 'gro lha lcam manda ras: dbang chen rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs nas: skye 'chi bgres rgud bral bar gyur: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de 'og 'gro 'dul phrin las zhing : brag dmar gnam rdzong g.ya' ma lung : slob dpon pad 'byung mtsho rgyal gyis: dus la bab pa'i thugs bskyed nas: rten 'brel rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: 'chi med lha tshogs dngos su byon: skal ldan smin grol byin gyis brlabs: rdo rje tshe srog sgrub lung bstan: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs re brtan: da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: sgrub rten dam rdzas mngon du bshams: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med rnal 'byor gyis: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog bsgrub ste: 'gro kun sgrol bar dam bca' bzhin: sku gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dus la bab: sprul pa'i 'od zer pho nya yis: stong gi 'jig rten rab 'byams gang : ye shes rdo rje'i stobs nus kyis: 'chi bdag sde brgyad 'byung po gzir: bla tshe nyams pa thams cad khug: snang srid 'byung lnga nyi zla yi: nus bcud bsdus la tshe dpal bskyed: ye shes sku lnga'i rang bzhin du: mi 'gyur mi shigs rgyas thob cig: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings ḍākki tshe 'gugs ma: mthing gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: nam mkha'i bcud bsdus sems la stims: g.yung drung tshe yi rgya mdud stsol:

hūm̐: shar phyogs mgyogs ma lcags kyu ma: dkar gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rol mtsho bdun gyi bcud bsdus la: rdo rje tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs mgyogs ma zhags pa ma: ser gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'bar: ri rab gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rin chen tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: nub phyogs mgyogs ma lcags sgrog ma: dmar gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: snang srid dkar dmar bcud bsdus la: padma tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: byang phyogs mgyogs ma dril bu ma: ljang gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rtsa rlung thig le'i bcud bsdus la: las kyi tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i mgyogs ma ni: rang rang rigs mthun dpag med 'phros: mthu stobs mnga' thang rgyas pa yi: 'dzam gling kun gyi bcud bsdus la: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog sku lnga rigs 'dus lha: 'khor 'das lam gsum tshe dpal gzi 'bar lhun: padma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: ye shes rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: dkar mo tshe bdag sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: dmar mo tshe bdag gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: sngon mo tshe bdag thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: ser mo tshe bdag yon tan dbang bzhi stsol: ljang mo tshe bdag phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: sku lnga rdo rje'i srog tu rgyas thob cig: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ ma ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe sgrub zab mo'i yang gsang snying po ni: lan bdun bzlas pas tshe yi bar chad sel: rgya chad rgya ral rgya log rgya grol pa'i: tshe dus ngan pa rgya mdud 'di yis sel: bsnyen tshad 'byor na mchog gi dngos grub thob: rab bsnyen zla gcig 'bring bsnyen zla phyed de: tha ma zhag bdun bsgrubs pas the tshom med: sa ma ya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes sa phag lor mkha' 'gro snying phug nas gdan drangs shing :

gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las bsgyur ba'o// // tha) ༈ 'chi med tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: hya ghṛ wa'i mngon rtogs dang btsan rgod mdung dmar can gyi gsol mchod bzhugs so: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha la 'dud: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug 'od sku drwa ba'i lha: gzhon nu bde ba'i rnam rol rdo rje'i sgra: snyan brgyud zag med lhan skyes 'dus ma byas: mthar thug snying po man ngag zab phreng 'di: gnod sbyin mi dmar khyod kyis legs par skyongs: de yi phrin las cha rkyen 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang gnod sbyin mdung dmar can gyi gsol mchod 'bul ba'i rim pa ni: lcags zangs bhandha gang rung gi snod du: 'bru sna ngar phye la dpal bshos g.yas gcus 'khor bzhi yis bskor ba bshams la sha khrag gis rgyan bya: sgrub pa yin na dpal gtor nor bu zlum po byas: 'khor bzhi yang 'brang rgyas rtse bsgyur ro: gzhan yang sman phud mchod rdzas yid mthun bsham: thog mar mchod gtor: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis bsang sbyang byin rlabs bya: de nas rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi bskyed rim dang bcas: hūm̐: na mo bla ma dbang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la skyabs su mchi: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i las byed phyir: mngon spyod drag po bsgrub par dam bca'o: ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ yam̐ bi shuddhe kham̐ sarba ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: de nas ting 'dzin ngang nas spyan 'dren pa ni: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: padma sūrya tsand+ra ti ra baṃ hūm̐ bhyo: zhes yongs su gyur pa las rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang phyi nang stong gsal 'ja' zer 'khrugs pa'i klong du padma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la: rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i khrod nas rta zhal ljang nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs pa:

phyag g.yas dbyug pa dang : g.yon tshe bum lcags sgrog 'dzin pa: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rgyan gyis spras pa: yum rdo rje phag mo dmar skya gri thod 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa yab yum bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir gar mo tshe'i pho nya bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang ste phyag g.yas rang mdog gi phyag mtshan dang : g.yon 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin cing rang byung ye shes 'od kyi klong du gsal ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang chen he ru ka'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ om̐ badzra tiṣṭha lhan: om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ ye shes pa spyan drangs te dam tshig pa dang dbyer ma mchis pa gcig tu gyur: hūm̐ḥ me tog dmar po dbang gi rdzas: dri zhim kun khyab dwangs ma'i sprin: snang gsal 'od kyis ma rig gzhom: mdangs ldan bdud rtsi dri yi chab: longs spyod bsod nams zhal zas bcud: sman raka gtor ma dgyes pa'i rdzas: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs rol mo'i dbyangs: blo yis blangs nas sprul pa'i tshogs: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza ye pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: snang srid kun kyang dbang drag dkyil 'khor zhing : snod bcud gzugs rnams rta mchog rol pa'i sku: sgra grags skye med hya ghṛ wa'i gdangs: ma 'dres thugs nyid gnas lugs snang mtha' yas: rol pa'i rtsal chen khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i gar: dbang chen tshe bdag lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:

tshe sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra ā yur garbha hya ghṛ wa hṛ da ya swā hā: zhes dbang chen srog sgrub kyi snying po sgrub pa 'di phyi spros bcas kyi mchod pa med kyang rung : yod kyang mi 'gal gtor ma mos na tshe rta kha sprod yin: de nas tshe dbang 'gugs pa ni: om̐: skye med chos sku'i pho brang nas: āḥ 'gags med longs sku snang mtha' yas: hūm̐: sprul sku khro rgyal dbang chen sku: trām̐: yon tan tshe yi pho nya 'gyed: hrīḥ deng 'dir phyogs bcu'i thugs rje bsdus: ha: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: ri: 'chi med dbang chen don rtogs nas: ni: snying po ka dag 'od kyi sku: sa: rang bzhin rdo rje'i srog 'khor tshugs: srog sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra dzñā na hṛ da ya hya ghṛ wa ā yur siddhi hūm̐: zhes spros bcas tshe dbang blangs kyang rung : med kyang rang bzhin ngang la dbang don rdzogs: de'i phyir rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i go rim dang bstun: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa po'i bar chad sel ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi bya ra gnyer gtad pa'i phyir: gnod sbyin mdung dmar can gyi gsol mchod ni: rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi bskyed rim dang bcas: hoḥ rang nyid dbang chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas byang phyogs mchong lding smug po'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sha yakṣa tsa dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki na: tshangs pa 'phrul gyi pho brang nas: dbang chen 'bar ba'i bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin shan pa mdung dmar can: ma thogs gnas 'dir da tshur byon: slob dpon padma'i bka' bzhin du: rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: spyan gzigs phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka nang gi mchod pa 'bul: sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ba ling sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: mthun rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: bka' dang bstan pa srung du gsol: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ghri ba shu la dhe ba yakṣa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ mi mngon lhun grub tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dbyings: rin chen du ma las grub pho brang dbus: dbang chen bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad pa'i phyir: gnod sbyin tshul 'chang btsan rgod mthu bo che: bswe khrab bswe rmog gsol nas rta dmar zhon: phyag g.yas btsan mdung g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: zhags dmar dang ni stag ral gzig shubs brgyan: 'khor du gnod sbyin bu mo nor 'dzin bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang dar 'phen ne'u le 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan 'gro ba'i bsod nams bsdus: longs spyod 'gugs phyir gar thabs mkha' la bsgyur: sprin ltar gtibs shing ma nges cha lugs 'gyed: res 'ga' lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa'i gzugs: res 'ga' gnod sbyin chen po dkor bdag gzugs: res 'ga' dgra la rbad tshe shan pa'i gzugs: khyod ni dbang chen padma'i bka' nyan mchog: tshangs pa dung thod gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal ba dang : phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe bsod longs spyod spel: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang bar chod rigs: log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kun: btsan rgod shan pa khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzod: ces sngags ni: om̐ shu la de wa tsa tri yakṣa swā hā: om̐ badzra pra mo ti ri yaksha ku mā rā dza swā hā: mchod sngags ni: sarba i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: rgyun du gtor bsngo ma chag chos skyong du: phrin las myur mgyogs shugs 'chang sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas phag lor gsang ba lung gi ḍākki'i gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so//

// da) ༈ tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las khol du phyung ba'i bla 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tsugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla tshe sba 'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab khung phud de khug la shog: rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug: gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ badzra muṃ wā ra hī ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ

ā yurdzñā na ṇi badzra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mda' dar g.yab cing mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyis phyogs bcur khyab ste: bla tshe yal ba thams cad bsdus shing : chaig la bstim par bsam: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon las khol du phyung ba'o// // na) ༈ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las: tshogs mchod lhun po'i sprin phung bzhugs so: pad 'byung tshe yi lha la 'dud: tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni: tshogs kyi yo byad phun sum tshogs par bsham: de nas tshogs chu gtsang gis bran la: om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong bhandha lcang lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du tshogs mchod ngo bo ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang gi rnal 'byor gyi: thugs las byin rlabs yi ge 'phros: snang ba'i bag chags sbyangs par gyur: tshogs rdzas zag med pū dza hoḥ de nas tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: rgyal sras drang srong brgyud par bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: cod pan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: rnga sgra dung gling 'u ru ru: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod tshogs khang mdangs dang ldan: rnal 'byor pho mo dam tshig gtsang : 'dir tshogs smon lam skal bar ldan: mchod rdzas tshogs mchod bcud mchod rgyas: bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa a be sha ya a āḥ de nas tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma rgya mtsho tshogs la rol:

yi dam rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: dam can chos skyong tshogs la rol: yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs la rol: rigs drug pha ma tshogs la rol: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: de nas tshogs phud 'buul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: phyi nang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa bshams: lha tshogs mnyes pa'i bskang rdzas 'di: 'chi med lha yi thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: tshe bdag dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi: lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang : rakta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang : sgra dbyangs rol mos thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang : spyan gzigs du mas thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bshags pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs rin po che: dug lnga ye shes ngo bo nyid: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs bral: bdag gzhan kun slong mthol lo bshags: phyin chad ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : gzugs ling dgra bo'i rten mkhar la: chos skyong pho nya'i bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed dgra sri myur du khug: badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ de nas phur bu thogs la bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen khrag 'thung thugs kyi sras:

rdo rje gzhon nu phur pa'i sku: gnam lcags rngam pa'i dbal ldan 'di: byad ma'i snying du kī la ya: nṛ tri myog thum dgra bo rbad: ces gtub cing zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: byad ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs chos nyid lto bar bskyil: ldog med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ de nas lhag ma gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan dregs pa'i tshogs: phud la mi dbang lhag sdud ma: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra 'byung po zhal du thob: utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas bskul pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos dbyings ngang las drag por bzhengs: sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: thugs dam ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min gnas mchog tu: snang mtha' ḍākki gos dkar gnyis: dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug ging sman khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og mā ra ti ka ru: pad 'byung manda ra ba gnyis: 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor phyes: 'bar ma pho nyas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og zangs mdog dpal ri ru: gdong dmar srin po 'dul mdzad cing : kha byang bka' rgya gtad pa'i tshe: chos skyong ging bzhis khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: sha za ḍākki'i pho brang nas: rtsa gsum tshe sgrub zhal phyes tshe: bstan srung dam can khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: bstan skyong ya ma bcu gnyis rnams: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ la la le le kha kha khā hi: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri lan gsum bkug ste:

rta bro ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro brdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo la rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bstan te 'bru 'thor ro: de nas dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyur cig: rtsa sngags sham bu: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ mi dmigs snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor tshe yi dal: dgongs pa zang thal chos sku'i klong du hoḥ rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs rgyal sa zin: ma bcos spros bral ngang du a la thim: a a āḥ zhes dmigs med chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngo bo skyong : de nas shis brjod ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab tu dbang ba yi: 'chi med bdud rtsis rtag tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: bsngo smon ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu sgrub pa'i mthus: dge ba rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang myur thob shog: sa ma ya: e ma yang zab snying thig las: tshe sgrub zab mo'i las rim bstan: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma la: o rgyan gter bdag gling par sprod: shan pa mdung dmar can gyis srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ྀatsha rgya: bdag 'dra u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa phag lor ḍākki'i snying phug nas gdan drangs shing : padma sbas pa'i tshal gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so// // pa) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las byin 'bebs kha skong du phul ba bzhugs so/

'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud/ byin 'bebs pa ni/ hrīḥ nub phyogs 'og min chos sku'i zhing khams nas/ /bcom ldan mgon po snang mtha' tshe dpag med/ /yum mchog gos dkar lha mo tshe yi bdag /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing khams nas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku padma tshe dpag med/ /dbyings phyug lha mo tsaṇḍa lī yum bcas/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /rnga yab dpal ri padma 'od zhing nas/ /gu ru padma sambha tshe yi bdag /mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug lha lcam manda ra/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /mā ra ti ka gsang ba'i sgrub gnas nas/ /padma kā ra mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal yum/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin rnam brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /bod yul yang rdzong sgrub gnas shel brag nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes tshe bdag mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /las can nyer lnga grub thob brgyud par bcas/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /smon lam las 'phro zab gter pho brang nas/ /gnam lcags rdo rje chos bdag las can rnams/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /bde chen 'bar ba tshe yi pho brang nas/ /bcom ldan tshe bdag yab yum sgo ma bcas/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /gtum drag me rlung 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /dbang chen rta mgrin phag mo mgyogs ma bcas/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /zab rgya rtags bdun skyong ba'i pho brang nas/ /chos skyong gter bdag tshe la dbang ba rnams/ /dkyil 'khor tshe yi rdzas la byin phob cig /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bkrag mdangs byin rlabs 'bar/ /sgrub po bdag cag bla tshe yal ba gsos/ /sgrub rten tshe mda' rgod sgro byin re che/ /sgrub rdzas 'chi med tshe ril 'phel ba dang*/ /bsgrub lha zhal mjal mchog thun dngos grub thob/ /tshe yi lha tshogs 'dir byon byin phob cig
padma ḍākki ā yur sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ

zhes byin dbab/ de ltar gzhung las byin 'bebs mi 'dug pas/ padma gsang thig nas bas kyang rung ste/ rang sems la byin 'bebs gcig dgos bsams pas byi lo'i tshes la o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi yang srid kyis bris pa'o/ maṅga laṃ// // pha) ༈ tshe sgrub lcags rgya'i sman mchod ni/ kun bzang yab yum rdor sems tshe dpag med/ /dga' rab rdo rje shrī sing bi ma la/ /pad 'byung manda ra ba mtsho rgyal la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol/ /chos rgyal gnubs chen shākya pra bha wa/ /karma las gling thugs mchog rdo rje dang*/ /rong smyon mi 'jigs rdo rje snyan grags mtshan/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags bstan rgyal 'gro 'dul phṛn las dang*/ /dkon mchog seṅge kun dga' blo gros zhabs/ /ārya dhwa dza tshe dbang 'dus pa rtsal/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol/ /tshe bdag yab yum rigs lnga yum bcas dang*/ /mgyogs ma bzhi dang bkra shis lha mo brgyad/ /rta phag yab yum rta mgrin rigs bzhi la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol/ /gar mo sgo skyong gnod sbyin mdung dmar can/ /chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la ho/ pra dzñā'i ming gis sbyar ba'o// // ba)༈ 'dzab dmigs ni/ thugs kar padma zla gdan steng*/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung ljang gsal gyi/ /lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po'i nang*/ /tshe rten āḥyig dkar po dang*/ /srog gi ngo bo nṛ ljang mtshan/ hrīḥmathar sngags phreng dmar po 'phros/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don mdzad/ /'khor 'das snod bcud dngos po kun/ /bsdus nas rang la thim pa yis/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ

zhes ngag dbang ming gis bris so// // ma) rjes chog mchod bstod ni/ om̐ gu ru de wa ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ /ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon po'i bzod par gsol/ om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs lan gsum brjod/ brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang : nad med tshe dang dpal 'byor dang : mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol: om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor ro// // tsa) tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bzhugs so/ hrīḥ tshe mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med snang mtha' yas/ /tshe 'phrang 'jig kun skyob mdzad zil gnon rtsal/ /mi shigs tshe yi bdag nyid padma 'byung*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob tshe 'dzin mtsho rgyal ma/ /'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe bdag sgo ma bzhi/ /'byung po'i tshe jag mthar byed hya ghṛ/ /zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma seṅge'i gdong*/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /rab gus gdung bas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /myur mgyogs thugs rje'i lcags kyus rtsal phyung nas/ /'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir skyes chen zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ /dge 'dun 'dus sde sku tshe ring ba dang*/

/mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar shog / ces tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bden tshig kun 'grub 'di yang rig 'dzin chen po mi 'jigs rdo rjes a chog yang dben du sbyar ba'o// // tsha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa bzhugs so/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa 'chi med mgon po tshe mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa la/ sbyor ba ni/ thog mar sgrub gnas byin ldan sogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su byi dor legs par byas la mdun stegs tshe lha'i sku rten bris 'bur sogs legs par bkram pa'i dbus su tshe gtor rta mgos brgyan pa g.yas g.yon du tshe ril tshe chang rgyab tu mda' dar mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas bshams/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la bag pheb 'khod pa'i mdun du bum pa ḍā dril 'thor nas nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar bsags la kun slong rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ skyabs yul mdun mkhar gsal la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma hoḥ 'og min rnam dag bkod pa'i pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' tshe bdag yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings rig mkha' spyod gsang ba'i pho brang nas: gtso mo tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro sde lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: mtshungs med gu ru padma yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bod yul yang rdzong shel brag gnas mchog nas: gnubs ban buddha dzñā na yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol:

phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brda bzhi bka' bab lung bstan pho brang nas: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'chi med mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i snying phug nas: zab chos yang snying lcags kyi rgya mdud la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab rgya bka' gtad skyong ba'i pho brang nas: bka' skyong dam can gter gyi bdag po la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyud pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus: thugs rje byin rlabs gzi byin mchog g.yo ba'i: nus chen brtse ba'i dbang bzhi deng bskur nas: nam yang mi shigs rdo rje'i sku gyur te: 'od zer 'ja' lus gzugs mchog der gnas shog: om̐ hrīḥ.ā yurdzñā na ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes gsol 'debs rdzogs nas mi dmigs ting 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs/ gzhung dngos la 'jug pa la'ang*/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba sngon 'gro la bdun/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ mdun mkhar bla ma tshe dpag med dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro bar mos la skyabs sems 'jug pa gcig gis bskyed pa la/ e ma hoḥ sku gsum klong yangs ye shes snying po'i thugs: gdod nas rang byung ka dag ji bzhin du: 'bad rtsol bral ba'i ngang nas sems bskyed do: skye 'chi du khaḥmi dmigs bag yod blos: sgyu ma'i gar tsam mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i snang tshul de bzhin skyabs su mchi: lan gsum dang mthar tshogs zhing rang la bstims/ dkar gtor spyi 'gros ltar song ste/ gnyis pa bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/

bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'bar ba dbang gi sku: dkyil 'khor bar gcod tshe yi bdud: mchod sbyin khyer la rang sar dengs: bar du gcod pa rdul du rlog: om̐ hya ghṛ wa badzra wā ra hī gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'od zer glog stong drwa ba 'gyed: 'byung lnga mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: las kyi tshe bdud mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra padma tsakra hūm̐ bhrūm̐: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen po'i dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta bha lingta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ drug pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: mkha' klong ye shes pho brang nas: snang mtha' sangs rgyas thog ma'i mgon: tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: brda gar rgyan cha khro lo lo: byin rlabs sprin chen thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī phaiṃ phaiṃ: a be sha ya a āḥ bdun pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: deng 'dir 'chi med tshe yi dal bzung nas: sgo gsum yal bar mi 'dor srog ltar sgrub: dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gzhung bsrangs nas: rten 'brel bskyed rdzogs zab mo mig ltar brtse: oṃ dzñā na tsakra he ru ka a yu ṣe sa ma ya satwaṃ:

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag mdun khro bor sgrub pa gsum las/ dang po la'ang drug /dang po dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rlung me sa chu las: 'byung ba yongs gyur gzhal yas khang : ma bcos lhun grub zhing khams nas: chu nang zla ltar dkyil 'khor gsal: hūm̐ ā yurdzñā na bhrūm̐: gnyis pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: dran rig rang snang gnyis med zla gdan du: shes rig ngo bo g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : gsal stong hrīḥlas tshe bdag yab yum ni: gu ru padma gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: tshe yi bdag po padma dbang gi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal dri med rā ga'i mdog: longs spyod rgyan ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mnyam bzhag sbyor tshul tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sems kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar bcud kyis bkang : phyed skyil pang du shes rab kun 'dus ma: dmar mo chags nyams bcu drug lang tsho ldan: rin chen rgyan ldan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: dga' bzhi dbang sdud tshe yi bcud 'dzin bsgom: phyi rol sgo ma tshe yi las mdzad ma: dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: rang mdog rgyan ldan gar stabs khro chas can: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: phyag g.yas tshe bsod bcud bsdus tshul du bsgom: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams nas kyang : tshe yi lha tshogs gsal 'tsher gzi 'bar bsgom: 'od 'phros tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnga yab mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: tshe bdag padma yab yum dang : sgo ma mkha' 'gro tshe bdag rnams: mkha' spyod tshe yi gnas mchog nas: gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal sdig bshags mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags:

phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs: sku bzhi lhun grub mchod pa 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bde stong gar sgyur gsang ba'i yum: 'chi med bcud 'dzin yab la stob: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan lhub mdzes: lha lcam tshe yi bdag mor bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus khams lngar stim: rlung lnga'i grogs mdzad bde skyed ma: rigs bzhi tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: kun 'dus sgrub cing bsnyen pa'i lha: gzi brjid 'od klong dpal du 'bar: tshe bsod bcud bsdus lus la stims: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: gu ru tshe lha yongs rdzogs kyi: dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs la bstod: drug pa 'dzab dmigs ni/ thugs kar padma zla gdan steng*/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung ljang gsal yi/ /lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po'i nang*/ /tshe rten āḥyig dkar po dang*/ /srog gi ngo bo nṛ ljang mtshan/ hrīḥmathar sngags phreng dmar po 'phros/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don mdzad/ /'khor 'das snod bcud dngos po kun/ /bsdus nas rang la thim pa yis/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ rtsa bsnyen ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas bzlas/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed la gnyis/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed cing bzlas pa ni/ om̐ swa bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ:

stong pa nyid du gyur: 'og min lhun grub brdal khyab chen po'i klong : rin chen padma rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: ye shes lnga yi pho brang gzhal med khang : gru bzhi sgo rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs: mi sgrib zang thal 'od klong 'khyil ba'i dbus: rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin chen khrir: padma nyi zla'i gdan la thog ma'i mgon: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: padma 'byung gnas ye shes ngo bo mchog: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag 'chi med tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rab rdzogs bde stong skyil krung gis: pang du ye shes dpag med dkar gsal 'dzum: pad phreng tshe bum 'dzin pa'i mgul nas 'khyud: skra grol rin chen padma'i rgyan drug mdzes: yab yum gnyis med nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: thugs rje rol pa ye shes sku lnga'i mdangs: phyogs bzhir glang chen rta mchog seṅge dang : shang shang padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rdo rje rin chen sangs rgyas las kyi rigs: tshe dpag med mgon yab yum dkar gsal mthing : ljang gsal gtso bo'i chas ldan tshe bum la: rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo rgya gram mtshan: phyi rim phyogs mtshams padma 'dab brgyad la: sgeg phreng la sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad: g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: sgo bzhir tshe yi khro bo rta mchog dpal: dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu zhags pa dang : lcags sgrog dril bu tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: rigs kyi yum 'khril rang rang 'khor tshogs 'bum: gzhan yang phyi nang steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun: tshe yi rig 'dzin drang srong srung ma'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab 'od zer glog stong 'khyugs: mdor na chos dbyings zhing kun ma lus pa: 'chi med tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor zer dpung 'khrigs: kun kyang ye shes snying po mtshan dpe'i sku: thugs rje'i 'od snang nyi zla ther 'bum bzhin: 'od dang zer 'khrugs lta bas mi bzod cing : 'bar ba'i shugs kyis tshe bdud 'byung po gzhom:

tshe yi sngags sgra 'brug stong lta bur ldir: sgrub la 'chi med dngos grub stsol bar bsgom: de nas rang gi thugs kar gnam lcags kyi: rgya gram lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u nang : srog rten nṛ yig ljang gur 'od lnga 'phros: g.yas su tshe srog mi 'gyur āḥdakar po: g.yon du brtan par byed pa'i hūm̐ mthing kaḥ gsum ka bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams stobs: ma lus skad cig sdud pa'i nus pa ldan: de las 'od zer gzung thag gnyis med 'phros: mdun bskyed thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang : hrīḥyig dmar gsal rab tu 'tsher la phog: gdung bas rgyud bskul bde stong gzi brjid g.yos: rang mdangs rtsal 'phros rigs bzhi 'khor tshogs kyi: stobs bskyed rang rang sku las 'od tshogs 'phros: phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams tshe byin dang : nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung bcud: 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dpal srog gi rten: āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rang bzhin 'ub 'ub tu: ring par bsdus shing tshe bum mer gyis khengs: chil chil khol bas thams cad gtso bum ru: sib sib blug cing tshe 'dzab di ri ri: bdud rtsi khol zhing phyur ba bar med babs: yab yum sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun: lhan cig bdag gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug zhugs: gsang gnas yan chad dkar dmar ltem gyis gang : de yang tshe yi ngo bo bcud kyi bcud: dwangs ma'i dwangs ma thams cad 'ub kyis drangs: nṛ hūm̐ āḥl thim pas bkrag mdangs 'bar: 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros te: snod bcud khyab pas 'khor bcas tshe dpal gyi: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad 'ub 'ub bsdus: snying kha'i 'bru gsum la thim srog rtsa gang : bdag nyid bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar rdo rje'i sku: dngos su gyur te nyi zla'i gwa'u nyid: kha 'grigs 'og gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi: rwa bzhi gyen langs bsnol mar rgya mdud du:

rgyas btab rwa rtser 'od zer me tshwa 'phros: rtsa gnas ba spur rta mgrin grangs med bstim: bar gcod srung zhing bdud tshogs 'byung po bsregs: rgya mdud steng du ye shes tshe dpag med: dkar gsal tshon gang 'gyur med rtag bzhugs bsgom:

sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnyis pa tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mdun bskyed rang nyid padma'i sku: tshe lha rigs lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo la: gsol btab mos gus gdung bas thugs dam bskul: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus stobs rtsal gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bskul: gsungs pa bzhin/ mda' dar g.yab cing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐: sngon tshe ka dag chos sku'i klong : lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang : dbyings phyug lha mo tsaṇḍa lī: 'chi med rdo rje'i skur bzhengs te: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de 'og dag snang longs sku'i zhing : rā ga ra ta'i dbang phug tu: rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje dang : mkha' 'gro lha lcam manda ras: dbang chen rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs nas: skye 'chi bgres rgud bral bar gyur: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de 'og 'gro 'dul phrin las zhing : brag dmar gnam rdzong g.ya' ma lung : slob dpon pad 'byung mtsho rgyal gyis: dus la bab pa'i thugs bskyed nas: rten 'brel rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: 'chi med lha tshogs dngos su byon: skal ldan smin grol byin gyis brlabs: rdo rje tshe srog sgrub lung bstan: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs re brtan: da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis:

sgrub rten dam rdzas dngos su bshams: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med rnal 'byor gyis: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog bsgrub ste: 'gro kun sgrol bar dam bca' bzhin: sku gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dus la bab: sprul pa'i 'od zer pho nya yis: stong gi 'jig rten rab 'byams gang : ye shes rdo rje'i stobs nus kyis: 'chi bdag sde brgyad 'byung po gzir: bla tshe nyams pa thams cad khug: snang srid 'byung lnga nyi zla yi: nus bcud bsdus la tshe dpal bskyed: ye shes sku lnga'i rang bzhin du: mi 'gyur mi shigs rgyas thob cig: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings ḍākki tshe 'gugs ma: mthing gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: nam mkha'i bcud bsdus sems la stims: g.yung drung tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs mgyogs ma lcags kyu ma: dkar gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rol mtsho bdun gyi bcud bsdus la: rdo rje tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs mgyogs ma zhags pa ma: ser gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'bar: ri rab gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rin chen tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: nub phyogs mgyogs ma lcags sgrog ma: dmar gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: snang srid dkar dmar bcud bsdus la: padma tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: byang phyogs mgyogs ma dril bu ma: ljang gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rtsa rlung thig le'i bcud bsdus la: las kyi tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i mgyogs ma ni: rang rang rigs mthun dpag med 'phros: mthu stobs mnga' thang rgyas pa yi: 'dzam gling kun gyi bcud bsdus la: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog sku lnga rigs 'dus lha: 'khor 'das lam gsum tshe dpal gzi 'bar lhun: padma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: ye shes rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: dkar mo tshe bdag sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: dmar mo tshe bdag gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol:

sngon mo tshe bdag thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: ser mo tshe bdag yon tan dbang bzhi stsol: ljang mo tshe bdag phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: sku lnga rdo rje'i srog tu rgyas thob cig: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ ma ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes lan grangs ci mang bya zhing dmigs pa bskyar/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas brjod/ gsum pa khro bor bsgrubs pa la brgyad/ skabs 'dir 'chi med tshe mchog sgrub pa la bar chad sel phyir tshe rta kha sprod bya ba gal che bas des na 'dir hya ghṛ wa'i mngon rtogs bya ba la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ hūm̐: na mo bla ma dbang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la skyabs su mchi: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i las byed phyir: mngon spyod drag po bsgrub par dam bca'o: ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ yam̐ bi shuddhe kham̐ sarba ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang mchod rdzas byin gyis rlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed cing spyan drang ba ni/ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: padma sūrya tsand+ra ti ra baṃ hūm̐ bhyo: zhes yongs su gyur pa las rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang phyi nang stong gsal 'ja' zer 'khrugs pa'i klong du padma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la: rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i khrod nas rta zhal ljang nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs pa: phyag g.yas dbyug pa dang : g.yon tshe bum lcags sgrog 'dzin pa: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rgyan gyis spras pa: yum rdo rje phag mo dmar skya gri thod 'dzin pa mgul nas 'khyud pa yab yum bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir gar mo tshe'i pho nya bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang ste phyag g.yas rang mdog gi phyag mtshan dang :

g.yon 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin cing rang byung ye shes 'od kyi klong du gsal ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang chen he ru ka'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes spyan drangs/ gsum pa dbyer med du bsre zhing phyag bya ba ni/ om̐ badzra tiṣṭha lhan: gyis rten la brten par bya/ om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ sa phyag dang brda lan byas par mos/ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ me tog dmar po dbang gi rdzas: dri zhim kun khyab dwangs ma'i sprin: snang gsal 'od kyis ma rig gzhom: mdangs ldan bdud rtsi dri yi chab: longs spyod bsod nams zhal zas bcud: sman raka gtor ma dgyes pa'i rdzas: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs rol mo'i dbyangs: blo yi blangs nas sprul pa'i tshogs: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza ye pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: snang srid kun kyang dbang drag dkyil 'khor zhing : snod bcud gzugs rnams rta mchog rol pa'i sku: sgra grags skye med hya ghṛ wa'i gdangs: ma 'dres thugs nyid gnas lugs snang mtha' yas: rol pa'i rtsal chen khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i gar: dbang chen tshe bdag lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: drug pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang gi thugs kar pad nyi gdan la thugs srog hrīḥdamar nag gi mthar/ sngags phreng rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer me tshwa lta bu 'phros/ tshe gegs log 'dren thams cad thal ba bun bun du bsregs/ 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par mos la/ tshe sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra ā yur garbha hya ghṛ wa hṛ da ya swā hā: ci nus dang*/ bdun pa tshe dbang 'gugs pa ni/

mda' dar g.yab la/ om̐: skye med chos sku'i pho brang nas: āḥ 'gags med longs sku snang mtha' yas: hūm̐: sprul sku khro rgyal dbang chen sku: trām̐: yon tan tshe yi pho nya 'gyed: hrīḥ deng 'dir phyogs bcu'i thugs rje bsdus: ha: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: ri: 'chi med dbang chen don rtogs nas: ni: snying po ka dag 'od kyi sku: sa: rang bzhin rdo rje'i srog 'khor tshugs: srog sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra dzñā na hṛ da ya hya ghṛ wa ā yur siddhi hūm̐: bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ skabs 'gar bla 'gugs spro bar mos na phud rgod dang gser skyems bshams la/ mda' dar g.yab cing bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tsugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla 'di sba'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab khung phud de khug la shog: rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug:

gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ badzra muṃ wā ra hī ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ ā yurdzñā na ṇi badzra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mda' dar g.yab cing mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyis phyogs bcur khyab ste: bla tshe yal ba thams cad bsdus shing : chaig la bstim par bsam: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig spyi ltar sbyar bas 'thus/ brgyad pa chos skyong gi gsol mchod la/ khyad par gnod sbyin mdung dmar can gyi gsol mchod ni/ rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang bcas/ hoḥ rang nyid dbang chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas byang phyogs mchong lding smug po'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sha yakṣa tsa dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki na: tshangs pa 'phrul gyi pho brang nas: dbang chen 'bar ba'i bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin shan pa mdung dmar can: ma thogs gnas 'dir da tshur byon: slob dpon padma'i bka' bzhin du: rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: spyan gzigs phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka nang gi mchod pa 'bul: sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ba ling sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: mthun rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: bka' dang bstan pa srung du gsol: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ghri ba shu la dhe ba yakṣa bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ mi mngon lhun grub tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dbyings: rin chen du ma las grub pho brang dbus: dbang chen bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad pa'i phyir: gnod sbyin tshul 'chang btsan rgod mthu bo che: bswe khrab bswe rmog gsol nas rta dmar zhon: phyag g.yas btsan mdung g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: zhags dmar dang ni stag ral gzig shubs brgyan: 'khor du gnod sbyin bu mo nor 'dzin bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang dar 'phen ne'u le 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan 'gro ba'i bsod nams bsdus: longs spyod 'gugs phyir gar thabs mkha' la bsgyur: sprin ltar gtibs shing ma nges cha lugs 'gyed: res 'ga' lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa'i gzugs: res 'ga' gnod sbyin chen po dkor bdag gzugs: res 'ga' dgra la rbad tshe shan pa'i gzugs: khyod ni dbang chen padma'i bka' nyan mchog: tshangs pa dung thod gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal ba dang : phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe bsod longs spyod spel: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang bar chod rigs: log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kun: btsan rgod shan pa khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzod: ces sngags ni: om̐ shu la de wa tsa tri yakṣa swā hā: om̐ badzra pra mo ti ri yaksha ku mā rā dza swā hā: mchod sngags ni: sarba i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol ba sogs rgyun ldan ltar bya/ skabs 'dir rang lugs bka' gter srung ma'i gsol kha spyi 'gros rgyas bsdus gang rigs 'don/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ tshogs mchod dang rjes chog go /de la tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad phun sum tshogs par bsham/ spro na na rag bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags mthar sman raka gtor ma'i bskang ba rnams song nas gtor bsngos tshig lhug mthar/

dang po la'ang bcu bzhi las/ thog mar tshogs byin rlob ni/ chu chang gis bran la/ om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong bhandha lcang lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du tshogs mchod ngo bo ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang gi rnal 'byor gyi: thugs las byin rlabs yi ge 'phros: snang ba'i bag chags sbyangs par gyur: tshogs rdzas zag med pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: rgyal sras drang srong brgyud par bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: cod pan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: rnga sgra dung gling 'u ru ru: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod tshogs khang mdangs dang ldan: rnal 'byor pho mo dam tshig gtsang : 'dir tshogs smon lam skal par ldan: mchod rdzas tshogs mchod bcud mchod rgyas: bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa a be sha ya a āḥ

gsum pa tshogs mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: yi dam rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: dam can chos skyong tshogs la rol: yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs la rol: rigs drug pa ma tshogs la rol: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: bzhi pa tshogs phud 'buul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: phyi nang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa bshams: lha tshogs mnyes pa'i bskang rdzas 'di: 'chi med lha yi thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: tshe bdag dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi: lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang : rakta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang : sgra dbyangs rol mos thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang : spyan gzigs du mas thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: drug pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs rin po che: dug lnga ye shes ngo bo nyid: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs bral: bdag gzhan kun slong mthol lo bshags: phyin chad ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ bdun pa bsgral ba ni/ tshogs tha ma la raktas bran zhing dmigs bya dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : gzugs ling dgra bo'i rten mkhar la: chos skyong pho nya'i bden pa'i mthus:

gnod byed dgra sri myur du khug: badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ de nas phur bu thogs la bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen khrag 'thung thugs kyi sras: rdo rje gzhon nu phur pa'i sku: gnam lcags rngam pa'i dbal ldan 'di: byad ma'i snying du kī la ya: nṛ tri myog thum dgra bo rbad: bdud rtsi'i bran la zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: byad ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs chos nyid lto bar bskyil: ldog med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ brgyad pa tshogs la rol ba ni/ hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: dngos grub 'byung ba'i rdzas chen mchog: rmad byung yon tan kun tshang 'di: 'dir 'dus ya mtshan gnang bar stsol: lan gdab pa la/ hoḥ gzigs shig gsang gsum bla med chos: ro gcig ting 'dzin zas mchog 'di: bzang ngan blang dor bral ba yi: rtog med ye shes a la la hoḥ dgu pa lhag zhus sngon du song nas lhag ma kha phrus bran la 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan dregs pa'i tshogs: phud la mi dbang lhag sdud ma: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra 'byung po zhal du thob: utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa bskul bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos dbyings ngang las drag por bzhengs: sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: thugs dam ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: gsol kha'i gtor 'bul phrin bcol bcas mthar dbyung*/ bcu gcig pa chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min gnas mchog tu: snang mtha' ḍākki gos dkar gnyis: dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug ging sman khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og mā ra ti ka ru: pad 'byung manda ra ba gnyis: 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor phyes: 'bar ma pho nyas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og zangs mdog dpal ri ru: gdong dmar srin po 'dul mdzad cing :

kha byang bka' rgya gtad pa'i tshe: chos skyong ging bzhis khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: sha za ḍākki'i pho brang nas: rtsa gsum tshe sgrub zhal phyes tshe: bstan srung dam can khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bcu gnyis pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: bstan skyong ya ma bcu gnyis rnams: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ la la le le kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri lan gsum bkug ste/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro brdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo la rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bstan te 'bru 'thor ro/ om̐: 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐: bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ 'grub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs shing : trām̐: brtan par gyur cig smon lam mthar phyin shog: bcu bzhi pa dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyur cig: rtsa sngags sham bur/ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: tshe rdzas rnams spyi bor blangs shing dngos grub zhu ba la/ e maḥ rje btsun 'gro mgon thugs rje can: pad 'byung sku lnga yab yum tshe dpag med: gnyis med gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug ma: tshe lha rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshogs: bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang :

'chi med tshe bcud bdud rtsis rab tu bkang : bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar sgrub tshad mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la da bab na: mgon po khyod kyi tshe zhag dus 'dir lags: thugs la le lo btang snyoms ma mdzad par: rdo rje'i nam langs nyi zla nam mkhar shar: rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: rig 'dzin sgrub la tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: skye 'chi med pa tshe yi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags sham bu ni: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa a yurdzñā na hrīḥm ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: om̐ badzra ratna buddha padma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ hūm̐ swā om̐ hā a bhi ṣiñtsa satwaṃ: zhes dbang blang zhing tshe chu 'thung : sgrub rdzas ril bu lnga myong zhing : tshe chang nang gi ril bu yang : tshe sgrub yin na so sor sbyin: tshe ril tshe chang kun la rol: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ nyams su myong bar bya'o/ gnyis pa rjes chog la lnga/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bstod par 'os pa thams cad la: zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi: lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu: mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/ /de kun mgon po'i bzod par gsol/ om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dpal 'byor dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā:

zhes me tog 'thor ro/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor tshe yi dal: dgongs pa zang thal chos sku'i klong du hoḥ rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs rgyal sa zin: ma bcos spros bral ngang du a la thim: a a āḥ zhes dmigs med chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngo bo skyong*/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ skad cig gis o rgyan tshe dpag med gsal bar gyur/ go cha'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ go bgo zhing lus srung*/ bzhi pa bsngo smon ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu sgrub pa'i mthus: dge ba rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang myur thob shog: lnga pa bkra shis brjod ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab tu dbang ba yi: 'chi med bdud rtsis rtag tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor/ tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bzhugs so/ hrīḥ tshe mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med snang mtha' yas/ /tshe 'phrang 'jigs kun skyob mdzad zil gnon rtsal/ /mi shigs tshe yi bdag nyid padma 'byung*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob tshe 'dzin mtsho rgyal ma/ /'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe bdag sgo ma bzhi/ /'byung po'i tshe jag mthar byed hya ghṛ/ /zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma seṅge'i gdong*/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /rab gus gdung bas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /myur mgyogs thugs rje lcags kyu'is rtsal phyung nas/ /'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir skyes chen zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ /dge 'dun 'dus sde sku tshe ring ba dang*/

/mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar shog / de ltar tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa zhes bya ba 'di bzhin rtsa ba'i gter gzhung le'u phran kha thor du bzhugs pa rnams dkyus gcig tu bsdebs la kha 'gengs dgos pa re gnyis rang lugs tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas bsabs te nar 'gros su bklag chog par byas pa 'di'ang gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub sde gsar bu ba rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub nyams len skabs nye bar mkho ba'i ched 'di ltar dgos zhes sgrub brtson mant+ra sogs kyis bskul ngor gnam lcags pa bstan 'dzin ming gis grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams sku tshe mi shigs snang mtha'i ngo bo ru 'tsho zhing bzhes la don gnyis phrin las kyi mdzad pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // dza) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi bskang ba 'chi med dpal gyi ljon pa bzhugs so/ hrī/ tshem̐ dang ye shes mnga' bdag padma 'byung*/ /tshem̐ yi dbang mo lha lcam manda ra/ /tshem̐ lha 'byung bzhi gnas dag lha mo bzhi/ /tshem̐ bdag rta mgrin bka' srung bskang ba'i rdzas/ /rnam̐m bkra'i meṃ toṃg 'bum bzhad lang tsho ldan/ /rnam̐m kun g.yo ba'i bduṃg spoṃs zhing kun khyab/ /rnam̐m par gsal ba'i sgroṃn meṃ nyi brgya'i gzi/ /rnam̐m dag lha chu'i driṃ chaṃb mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /rnam̐m pa kun ldan ro brgya'i zhaṃl zaṃs brdal/ /rnam̐m mang snyaṃn paṃ'i phyi mchod sna tshogs kyis/ /rnam̐m mkhyen tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam̐m smin 'chi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /kum̐n tshang rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta/ /kum̐n rtog dug lnga bsgral ba'i rakta bskyil/ /kum̐n khyab gtor tshogs sbyor sgrol gsang mchod sogs/ /kum̐n bzang mchod sprin ltar dmigs bskang rdzas kyis/

/kum̐n mkhyen tshe dpag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /kum̐n snang mi rtag skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal sol/ /snam̐ng stong zung 'jug mngon gyur snang mtha' yas/ /snam̐ng srid dag pa lha sngags dkyil 'khor gsal/ /snam̐ng srid 'dzin zhen med pa'i lta sgom gyis/ /snam̐ng mtha' tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /snam̐ng yul gzugs phung 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol/ /mam̐ dag gnod sems srog bcad sgrib gnyis byang*/ /mam̐ rig dbang gis lha sgom sngags bzlas g.yel/ /mam̐ rungs 'khrul dbang rtsa gsum dam tshig nyams/ /mam̐ tshang lhag chad nyams chag mthol zhing bshags/ /mam̐ lus 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /mim̐ 'da' chos dbyings klong shar 'chi med lha/ /mim̐ min 'khrul gzugs 'khor ba'i re dogs chod/ /mim̐ dmigs ka dag ngang la mnyam bzhag mthus/ /mim̐ 'jigs rig pa'i btsan sa zin gyur cig / ces yig brgya brjod/ lam 'dir mos pa dar rgyas ming gis bris so// // wa) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ spros med rgyun khyer snying po dril ba bzhugs so/ 'chi med mgon po o rgyan tshe dpag med/ /dbyer med khyab bdag bla ma la btud de/ /spros med rgyun khyer snying dril 'dir spro na/ /bka' yis gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs/ de yang tshe sgrub zab mos bsnyen sgrub sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor skabs/ thog mar bsham bkod 'dzoms na sgrub rten tshe gtor dang sgrub rdzas sman raka nyer spyod sogs spyi ltar 'du bya la/ rgyun khyer lta bu la ma 'dzoms kyang yid kyi sprul pas 'thus/ dngos gzhi sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po skyabs yul mdun du gsal btab la/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi dgongs pa yis: lha mo tsaṇḍa lī la thugs brgyud nas: 'chi med padma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: tshe yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs: skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/

hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro rnams tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shing : thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥtshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces tshogs zhing rang la bstims nas/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ mkha' dbyings rlung me sa chu las: 'byung lnga yum gyur gzhal yas khang : ma bcos lhun grub zhing khams nas: chu nang zla shar dkyil 'khor gsal: hūm̐ ā yurdzñā na bhrūm̐: lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: dran rig rang snang gnyis med zla gdan du: shes rig ngo bo g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : gsal stong hrīḥlas tshe bdag yab yum ni: gu ru padma gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: tshe yi bdag po padma dbang gi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal padma rā ga'i mdangs: longs spyod rgyan ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis ni: mnyam bzhag sbyor tshul tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sems kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar bcud kyis bkang : phyed skyil pang du shes rab kun 'dus ma: dmar mo chags nyams bcu drug lang tsho ldan: rin chen rgyan ldan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: dga' bzhi dbang sdud tshe yi bcud 'dzin bsgom: phyi rim sgo ma tshe yi las byed ma: dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi:

rang mdog rgyan ldan gar stabs khro chags can: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: phyag g.yas tshe bsod bcud bsdus tshul du bsgom: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams nas kyang : tshe yi lha tshogs gsal 'tsher gzi 'bar bsgom: 'od 'phros tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur:

spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnga yab mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: tshe bdag padma yab yum dang : sgo ma mkha' 'gro tshe bdag rnams: mkha' spyod tshe yi gnas mchog nas: gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal sdig bshags mchod 'bul ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs: sku bzhi lhun grub mchod pa bzhes: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza hoḥ ma hā maṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bde stong gar sgyur gsang ba'i yum: 'chi med bcud 'dzin yab la bstod: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan ldan mdzes: lha lcam tshe yi bdag mor bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus khams lngar bstim: rlung lnga'i grogs mdzad bde skyed ma: rigs bzhi tshe yi lha la bstod: dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus/ /thugs srog hrīḥdamar gsal 'tsher g.yas g.yon du/ /tshe dang srog rten aḥdakar nṛḥljang mtshan/ /hrīḥmathar sngags phreng dmar po g.yas bskor las/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /slar 'dus phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin mthu dang*/ /nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung bcud/ /'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams kun/ /āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par 'ub 'ub tu/

/rim par bsdus shing tshe bum mer gyis khengs/ /spyi bor bla ma'i ngo bo tshe dpag med/ /yab yum sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun/ /lhan cig tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun gang*/ /dwangs ma 'bru gsum la thim bkrag mdangs 'bar/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog thob dmigs/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na hrīḥ ci nus dang*/ khyad par rdzogs rim dang sbyar na rang gi dbugs tshur rngub pa dang 'khor 'das snang srid kyi tshe bcud rnams tshur bsdus thugs ka'i srog yig la thim par bsgoms shing*/ nang 'jug kho na grangs bsags pa dang sngags rnams kyang yid bzlas rkyang pa bya/ thun min rlung bum can 'byongs na de nyid gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ de ltar ma nus na'ang*/ rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum dang sbyar nas 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab par bya ba ste 'di ni tshe sgrub kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ mthar yang nyi zla'i gwa'u kha 'grigs nas/ /'bru gsum tshud pa'i rdo rje rgya gram gyi/ /rwa bzhis rgyas gdab rwa rtser me tshwa 'phros/ /rtsa gnas ba spur rta mgrin grangs med bstim/ /sngags phreng drwa bas gwa'u bcings pa yis/ /bar chod srung zhing tshe bdud bsregs par mos/ oṃ badzra āḥyur garbha hya ghṛ wa hri da ye swā hā/ de nas spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum yang*/ /ye shes bdud rtsir 'od zhu srog rten la/ /thim pa'i rgya mdud steng du tshe dpag med/ /dkar gsal tshon gang 'gyur med rtag bzhugs mos/ zhes pas rgyas gdab/ oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na hrīḥmā ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod mthar 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag skye 'chi med pa'i rig pa ni/ /gdod nas dag pa'i tshe dpag med/ /ngo shes g.yo med gdeng thob na/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku 'grub 'gyur/ /de phyir nyams len gnad 'di gces/

/spro na tshe 'gugs pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed rang nyid padma'i sku: tshe lha rigs lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo la: gsol btab mos gus gdung bas thugs dam bskul: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus stobs rtsal gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bskul: zhes pas/ rgyas na tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya bya/ bsdu na/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin la: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mo: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur 'grub mdzod: de nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badzra hoḥ thun mtshams rgyas gdab dmigs med dbyings su bzhag /rjes su dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyuracig: ces rtsa sngags bzla zhing de'i mthar/ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor tshe yi dal: dgongs pa zang thal chos sku'i klong du bsdu: rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs rgyal sa zin: ma bcos spros bral ngang du a la thim: aḥ.aḥ.āḥ zhes dmigs bral chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngo bo skyong*/ oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na hrīḥ sa slar ldang la rjes thob kyi spyod lam bskyang zhing bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i mthus: dge bcu rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang thob gyur cig: bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor:

zung 'jug tshe la rab tu gnas dbang ba'i: 'chi med bdud rtsis rab tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs pas mtha' rgyan par bya'o/ gzhan yang rdzas sman bcud len la brten nas tshe gso thabs dang*/ bsnyen tshad rtags rnams gzhung chen mo las gsal ba bzhin nyams su len no/ phan yon ni rtsa ba las rtag tu tho rangs nyi shar khar: brgya rtsa re re nges par bzla: snum zad mar me bsnan pa'am: nad pa sman gyis gsos pa ltar/ zad pa bsring zhing bri ba 'gengs: nyams pa spel lam rgyas par byed: tshe la rang dbang thob par 'gyur: mdor na rang don gzhan don dang : gdul bya phrin las 'dod pa'i don: ji ltar bsgrub cing rnal 'byor pa'i: sku tshe ring nas ci bsam 'grub: de bas mchog thun gang bsgrub kyang : tshe sgrub pa la nan tan 'tshal: tshul bzhin sus bsgrubs tshe mthar phyin: tshe tshad dag la dbang 'byor bas: bya byed gang brtsam rgyas bsdus dang : spang blang ji ltar 'dod bzhin chog: ces gsungs so/ zhes pa'ang rang slob ye shes rgyal mtshan nas 'di ltar bris zhes yang yang bskul zhing yi ge'i mthun gyur kyang mdzad par brten sgo chen sprul ming nas gter gzhung dgongs pa bzhin sbyar ba'o// // zha) ༈ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi/ bsnyen yig padma'i do shal bzhugs so/ bla ma tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ tshe sgrub zab mo'i nyams len la 'jug pa'i gang zag gis spros med nyams su len par 'dod na/ thog mar yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas su sku gsung thugs rten dang nyer spyod sogs gang 'byor bshams pa'i gong du tshe gtor bum gzugs rta mgos mtshan pa g.yas g.yon sman raka dang tshe rdzas tshe chang mda' dar sogs 'byor na 'du bya/ med kyang bsnyen rkyang gi skabs tshe gtor kho nas kyang chog par bshad/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngon du song nas/

dngos gzhi dus tshes dge ba'i thog mar bsang dang*/ sde brgyad mchod pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gzhung ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs grub na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur phyir spyi dang mthun/ srod thun gyi snga log stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod la sngon 'gro'i rim pas blo sbyangs pa'i mthar/ skad cig gis rang nyid rta mchog he ru ka yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas bgegs gtor byin rlabs dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: bdag ni 'bar bsogs kyi mthar hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang gu gul bdug thun gyis brabs la dmigs gnad dang ldan pas srung 'khor bsgom/ skabs 'dir rgyal chen sde bzhir phrin las bcol la gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ tho 'dzugs tshul spyi khyab ltar shes/ de nas phyi nang gi mtshams bcad/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa rnams grub nas tshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ dngos gzhi bskyed rim mchod bstod bar btang la/ skabs 'dir bzlas pa dngos la/ thog mar sku yi rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa nga rgyal brtan pa rnams re re bzhin gsal gdab ste/ thog mar sku yi gsal snang la sems bzung*/ de la cung zad brtan pa thob tshe rang gi snying dbus g.yung drung ljang gsal steng rdo rje rgya gram 'phred nyal gyi lte bar nyi ma 'og zla ba steng byas pa'i kha sbyor gwa'u kha bye ba'i dbus su/ srog gi yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang ldan par bskyed pa'i g.yas su tshe rten āḥdakar po/ g.yon du srog rten nṛ ljang gu gsal ba gsum ka 'od zer 'bar bar gsal gdab/ yang srog gi rig pa hrīḥmathar sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs te bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng g.yas bskor gyis drag tu 'khor ba'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod sprin lha mo grangs med 'phros phyogs dus rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus dus gcig tu khyab/

kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mchod cing mnyes par byas/ de dag gi thugs rje byin stobs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus srog yig la thim pas gzi brjid dang 'od zer mchog tu 'bar/ slar ma dag pa'i khams gsum 'gro ba rnams la spros pas 'gro drug srid pa'i las snang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa skad cig gis nyi mas ba mo bcom pa bzhin sbyang*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung sogs 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par tshur bsdus pas rang dang spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag med yab yum du gsal ba'i sku yi dbyibs dang phyag gi bum par zhugs/ bdud rtsi ma shong ba'i tshul du phyir lud pa dang*/ yab yum kyang bde ba chen por rol pa'i bde nyams 'bar zhing sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba de nyid bum pa'i bdud rtsi dang lhan cig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun na ra ra babs nas rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dwangs ma 'bru gsum la thim pas bkrag mdangs 'bar zhing 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros shing 'od kyi reg pa'i mod la phyi snod 'jig rten rab 'byams tshe yi dkyil 'khor du lam lam/ nang bcud 'gro ba mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sku ru shig shig /sgra grags ma lus tshe yi dzap sgra di ri ri sgrogs shing rtog tshogs thams cad chos nyid du thal thal/ mdor na tha mal gyi snod bcud stong ste 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog thob par bsams la yid bzlas dang*/ rlung bzlas la bslab/ de nas skyo tshe ngag gi bzlas pa la brtson par bya'o/ mthar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha 'grigs pa'i dbus su bla tshe srog gi rten yig 'bru gsum po de'i nang du tshud nas gzhom zhig bral bar gyur par bsam/
