de nas rdo rje'i ra bzhi gyen du langs te gwa'u phyi nas sgam la lcags shan gyis bsdams pa bzhin du rdo rje'i rgya yis bsdams pa'i ra rtse rnams nas me yi tshwa tshwa zi ri ri 'bar ba dang tshe bdud bar chad thams cad bsregs/ lus rtsa gnas ba spu rnams nas kyang rta mgrin grangs med pa 'phros/ rta sngags kyi phreng bas bcings pas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i mos pa dang bcas rta sngags cung zad bgrang bar bya'o/ slar spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum kyang 'od du zhu nas srog rten la thim pas rdo rje'i rgya mdud lte bar tshe dpag med dkar gsal tshon gang ba zhig 'gyur med rdo rje lta bu'i tshe mi 'gyur g.yung drung rtag brtan gzhom zhig bral bar bzhugs pa la rig pa gtad de/ las kyi sngags cung zad bzla ba dang*/ mthar dmigs pa spro bsdu dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i rgyun bskyang bar bya'o/ de ltar bsnyen pa'i tshad kyang 'bum phrag bco lnga kha skong dang bcas pa dang gzhan gnyis thun mthar ci nus bzlas shing dmigs bsal gdab/ spro bar 'dod na tshe 'gugs kyang bya'o/ mthar mchod bstod bshags pa spyi ltar bya zhing rten la bzhugs su gsol/ rjes su mi dmigs ka dag gi ngang du bsdus la slar ldang zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo la bkra shis smon lam bcas mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ bsnyen pa thems nas dbang bzhi blang zhing gtang rag tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ kha skong me yi mchod pa byas na nus pa myur/ de nas mtshams grol ba'i rjes su srog bslu dang lam 'phrang bcos pa sogs rgyab dpung dge ba'i spyod pa la'ang 'bad par bya'o/ zhes tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi bsnyen yig nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di'ang lam 'dir mos pa mi phyed dge ba'i blo can gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i ming can des rang gi nyams len la nye bar mkho ba'i ched du zin thun du bgyis pas 'gro kun tshe yi bar chad zhi zhing tshe mthar phyin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// za) tshe chog grangs gsog bya thabs ni/ tshe sgrub lcags rgya ma'i tshe chog brgya stong grangs gsog skabs thog mar bca' bzhi tshe sgrub gzhung ltar dang*/ bye brag me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas sogs mchod pa rnams grangs gang mang dang*/ nus na thun re bzhin/ mchod pa brje ba'am mchod kha gso/ thog mar spros bcas ltar gsol 'debs nas brtsam bdag mdun khro bor sgrub pa dang bcas/ kho bos chog khrigs ltar bla 'gugs kyi bar song nas/ mchod bstod bsdus tsam dang tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bcas tshar dang po grub/ de phyin gzhan rnams la sngon 'gro skyabs sems bgegs gtor sogs mi dgos/ mchod pa kha gso zhing mchod rlob nas brtsam bdag bskyed bsnyen pa khyug tsam dang bsnyen bstod mi dgos/ de ma thag rtsa sgrub la 'jug cing sgrub sngags cung zad bzlas rjes/ tshe 'gugs bya zhing mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying brjod/ ye shes lha tshogs kyis bsnyen bstod bya/ de nas khro bo rta mgrin dkyus ltar bsnyen pa khyug tsam bzlas nas tshe 'gugs kyi rjes bsnyen bstod snga ma ltar byas pas 'thus/ de ltar byas pas tshe sgrub zhi ba dang*/ khro sgrub rta mgrin gnyis la tshar gnyis re brtsi srol ltar grangs bzung zhing*/ slar sngar bzhin mchod rlob nas 'jug pas chog go /dgong mor gsol kha nas brtsam mthar dbyung*/ nyin grangs mang por gsog tshe nyin phyi ma rnams su dkar gtor mi dgos/ nyin grangs tha ma ma gtogs dngos grub len srol med/ tha ma'i skabs tshogs mchod sogs spros pa gang nus bya zhing*/ rjes kyi bya ba srog bslu sogs dge ba'i dpung bskyed par bya'o/ zhes snga 'gyur spyi srol dang mthun par rang dgon du tshe sgrub stong tshar 'don srol bzhin dgos mkho dang bstun sprul sku gsang sngags nas so// //

'a) ༈ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ bla bslu khol phyung srog gi ljon pa bzhugs so/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang tshe sgrub cha lag bla bslu bya ba'i rim pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum mo/ dang po bca' bzhi bya ba'i rim pa ni/ spyir tshe sgrub sogs bdag bskyed gang mos rang rang gzhung ltar bshams la/ mdun du gzhi dkar steng 'bru'i g.yung drung bris pa'i khar bla zangs nang mar gyi bla rta bcos pa dang*/ thugs dam bskul ba'i ched mkha' 'gro'i 'bul gtor dkar gtor lnga/ 'bru sna gser skyems bcas bsham/ mar gzhi nag po'-i khar bsgrub bya'i bla glud nam mkha'/ mda'/ 'phang*/ rgyang bu/ changs bu lnga bcas bsham/ dang po tshe sgrub chen mo gzhung bsrang la tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar bya/ de nas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyi ngang nas tshe bdud dgug pa ni/ oṃ hya ghṛ wa hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ na mo: sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: dam chos 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: bden pa'i mchog ste dkon mchog gsum gyi bka': dkon mchog bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: bden pa'i tshig gis mi grol gang yang med: yang dag don la mi sems gang yang med: snang srid sems su ma 'dus gang yang med: srid gsum thams cad bden pa'i bka' la nyon: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams: nad bdag 'byung po ma mo'i tshogs: thams cad 'dir 'dus gzugs la thim: hūm̐: nyon cig srid pa'i lha ma srin: log 'dren lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi: lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs: yas glud len phyir 'dir 'dus shig: sogs lan gsum gyi dgug /de nas glud gtor bran zhing*/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ glud gtor mi dmigs pa'i ngang las yas gzugs glud kyi gtor ma gzugs phung khams dang skye mched dbang po yongs su rdzogs shing :

lta bas chog mi shes pa'i rang bzhin dbang po gsal zhing : yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i bza' btung 'dod rgu'i rgya mtshos khengs shing : zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du bla med gyur: om̐ ā kā ro? sogs dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga t sogs lan gsum gyis spel/ hūm̐: dkon mchog bka' yi bden mthu dang : sngags dang phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i yas glud 'di: sbyin bdag bla dang srog gi glud: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : dbang po rgyan chas phun sum tshogs: mi bas rin thang 'di che'o: yas stags 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho 'di: zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin: mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan che: zhe sdang lha bu bdud rnams dang : shar phyogs dri za'i tshogs la 'bul: nga rgyal gshin rje'i bdud rnams dang : lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: nyon mongs phung po'i bdud rnams dang : nub phyogs klu bdud tshogs la 'bul: phrag dog 'chi bdag bdud rnams dang : byang phyogs gnod sbyin tshogs la 'bul: tshangs pa dga' bo khyab 'jug dang : steng 'og lha klu rnams la 'bul: sbyin bdag chaiga'i bla bslu'o: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bla bslu'o: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bla bslu'o: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas bla bslu'o: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas bla bslu'o: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i lag nas bla bslu'o: 'og phyogs klu bdud lag nas bla bslu'o: phyogs mtshams sde brgyad lag nas bla bslu'o: rgyal bsen dam sri'i lag nas bla bslu'o: gnod byed bgegs kyi lag nas bla bslu'o: yul 'dre 'byung po'i lag nas bla bslu'o: gre bo gson 'dre'i lag nas bla bslu'o: byad rbod gtad khram lag nas bla bslu'o: god 'dre bse rag lag nas bla bslu'o: rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po yi: bla tshe ma rku ma 'phrog cig:

brkus pa yod na shul du tshud: 'phrog pa yod na mal du phob: tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par spel: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag: sngags 'chang bdag gi dam ma 'da': mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di khyer la: yas stags gzugs glud changs bu dang : sha khrag gtor ma 'di longs la: bdag cag yon mchod mi nor la: 'khon sems gdug pa zhi ba dang : byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod: 'dis man grangs bsag /hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na: gnas pa'i lha srin 'byung po dang : za 'dre shi gshed log 'dren bdud: sbyin bdag tshe dang srog gi glud: yas glud mchod sbyin 'di longs la: sdang sems zhags pas bcings pa khrol: bdag tu 'dzin pa ci la byed: 'dod chags dbang gis gzung ba khrol: gti mug dbang gis mnan pa khyogs: nga rgyal dbang gis bsdams pa klod: zhe sdang dbang gis gzir ba sol: chos nyid don dang bden pa la: rgyu 'bras bslu ba yod ma yin: skye 'gro sems can thams cad la: nga bdag gnyis su ma 'dzin cig: thams cad rang dang gnyis su med: 'gro drug snying rje'i yul gyur nas: sdang sems sbyor ba che la rtsub: bde sdug rang bzhin tha dad med: de bas sbyin pa'i bdag po yi: sha khrag srog dbugs ma 'phrog cig: bla tshe brkus pa shul du tshud: rang gi lus la dpe longs la: gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig: zhes ci rigs bsags shing grangs rdzogs pa'i mthar gong dang sbrel la/ gal te bka' las 'gal gyur na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bden mthus kyi: bka' yi chad pa drag po yis: khyed rnams lus srog rdul du brlag: de bas log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: mchog gsum bden pa'i bka' ma bcag: rtsa ba gsum gyi dam ma bkral: bslu med rgyu 'bras khyad ma gsod: sngags 'chang yid bsun ma byed cig: mchog sbyin glud gtor chud ma gzon: rnal 'byor bdag gi bsrung bya la: gnod 'tshe gdug rtsub ma gtong zhig: nad rims dal yams ma 'beb cig:

mchod sbyin yas glud 'di longs la: na ba sol la 'chi ba slongs: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod: nad yams dal kha dgra la sgyur: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: khyod kyi zas skal de yin no: za kha 'thung kha de ru spos: lha 'dre'i bsam pa ngan pa yang : dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du phob: byad ma rang gshed rang la zlog: de nas ngar glud kha phyir bsgyur la mar me sbar/ bra sran ram sgog rdzongs 'debs sna tshogs btab/ hūm̐: gshin rje'i rgyal po bgegs kyi tshogs: lan chags sde brgyad bdag po rnams: gshin rje'i 'khor bcas gang yin pa: bgegs gtor changs bu 'dod yon khyer: tshe dang srog la ma gnod par: bsod nams dpal 'phrog ma byed cig: na 'dre shi rkyen byed pa'i bdud: 'chi bdag srog bdag bsgyur du gsol: yas stags sna tshogs rdzongs su 'debs: bla dang srog la ma gnod cig: gang ba stong pa byed pa'i 'dre: ka cha chag grum rdzongs su 'debs: 'gong po bse rag ma gnas shig: sde brgyad gshin rje'i phyogs su 'phang : sbyin bdag 'di la ma chags par: gnod pa byed pa khyed cag kun: rang rang gnas su da song zhig: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin rgyal: thugs khros rdo rje 'bar ba yis: mgo lus dum bu brgya ru 'gas: 'di ru ma 'dug phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra ā yu garbha hya ghṛ wa hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed tshe bdud gshed 'khyams thams cad u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐: ghṛhṇa ghṛhṇa hūm̐: ghṛhṇa pa ya ghṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐: a na ya ho bha ga wān badzra bidyā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces thun gyis brdeg /yungs dkar gyis brab nas/ lam sum mdo'am chu bo'i gzhung du bskyal/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas sbyin bdag gdan dkar ram g.yung drung bris pa'i steng du bzhag /de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ dkar gtor lnga dang gser skyems bcas btegs/

rnga rol ldir zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas 'bod/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum: chos dbyings ye shes mthing gsal tshe dpag med: shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: me long ye shes dkar gsal lcags kyu ma: lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum: mnyam nyid rin chen ser gsal zhags pa ma: nub phyogs padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: sor rtog ye shes dmar gsal lcags sgrog ma: byang phyogs karma rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum: bya grub ye shes ljang gsal dril bu ma: thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung la byon: thugs kyi sprul pa dkar ser dmar ljang mthing: re re la'ang mkha' 'gro nyi khri 'bum: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma g.yel phrin las myur mgyogs dus la bab: sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs mtshams khyab par bskul: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og thams cad la: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i lag nas bla khug cig: 'og phyogs dga' bo'i lag nas bla bslu'o: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bla khug cig: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bla khug cig: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas bla khug cig: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas bla bslu'o: bsgrub bya'i bla rten gzugs la dbyer med bstim: om̐ buddha badzra rarna padma karma ḍākki nī sa ma ya ā nṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas bla rta bla mtshor bzhag pa mchod g.yog pas mda' dar yu bas bskor/ de nas phyi log tu song la mda' dar g.yab cing bla 'bod bya/ gser skyems 'thor nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo:

g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla 'di sba'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab khung phud de khug la shog: rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug: gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ badzra muṃ wā ra hī ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ ā yurdzñā na ṇi badzra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mda' dar g.yab/ bla mtsho bskor zhing rten 'brel brtags la legs rtags byung na tshar re'i chog /ngan na lan gsum gyi bar bskyar/ bla rten g.yu sogs btag cing*/ skabs 'dir tshe dbang rgyas bsdus long khom dang bstun par bskur/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams gzhung ltar mthar dbyung ngo*/ de ltar tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi cha lag bla bslu srog gi ljon pa 'di'ang bla bslu bla mdos sbrags ma las/

gter tshig sor bzhag gi 'gres rkang rnams bsdus shing shwa rdel 'gyed brtags sogs phris nas/ go rim 'jug bde 'di bzhin spros pa dben pa'i skabs nyer mkhor dmigs te/ g.yu lo bkod btsun dgon du shing sprel zla ba 12 pa'i tshes 30nyin ngag dbang klu sgrub dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// // ya) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ 'chi bslu bdud dpung g.yul bzlog khrigs su bsdebs pa bzhugs so/ 'chi med mgon po pad 'byung la btud de/ /'chi bdag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i thabs/ /'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga khrigs bsdebs pa/ /'chi med bsgrub pa'i yan lag 'dir gsal bya/ /de'ang tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las tshogs/ 'chi bslu bdud dpung g.yul bzlog bklag chog tu spel ba la gnyis/ 'chi ba'i ltas dang bslu ba'i thabs bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni gter gzhung las ches gsal ba ltar brtags la skabs bstun rim 'gror 'bad par bya'o/ gnyis pa 'chi ba bslu thabs bshad pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni bdag bskyed tshe sgrub kyi dkyil 'khor bsham/ de'i mdun du dur khrod ro g.yam mam/ lcags slang du/ dur sa dang ro thal khang stong phung shul gyi sa dang*/ lam rgya gram dang lung gsum 'dus mdo'i sa sogs dang*/ chu mig lkug pa dang rta bong gi dri chu dang*/ lung gsum 'dre 'dus kyi chu sogs kyis sbrus pa'i 'dam spyin la/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing phyag g.yas pas khram shing mig dgu pa dang*/ g.yon pas bsha' gri 'dzin zhing chu glang nag po mig ldir zhing ngur sgra 'don pa'i steng du dor stabs kyis 'gying ba/ gri khrag dang ro sol byug pa'i dug shog gi ngos la padma 'dab drug tu/ a su nṛ tri pre du yi ge drug dgod/ de'i nang du zlum por du bskor dbus su gru gsum rtse mo gyen bstan lte bar du/

gru gsum gyi phyi rol gling gsum du/ ma 'og dang*/ dza g.yas/ tha g.yon byas pa bris te snying gar bcug /gshin rje'i mig gnyis la ram̐ ram̐/ rna ba gnyis la yam̐ yam̐/ kha la bam̐/ lce la lam̐/ snying gar e sogs shog bur bris pa bcug ste/ stan nag gi steng kha byang bstan du bzhag la drag mchod g.yon bskor du bsham/ mdun du nad pa'i dri khus sbrus pa'i zan la/ ngar glud dkar ser dmar ljang khra bo lnga la/ so so'i rang mdog ltar dar tshon dang nam mkha'/ sgro phod/ mda'/ 'phang*/ pho gdong*/ mo gdong sogs mdos chas dang*/ changs bu lo grangs dang*/ dmar gtor sha dum mthebs skyu sogs brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba dang*/ rdzongs 'debs lan chags 'jal ba'i 'bru sna dang*/ zas sna sogs dkar gsum dang*/ gser dngul sogs rin chen/ dar zab sna tshogs ci 'byor sogs tshags su tshud par bya'o/ de nas mdun rten la chab bran zhing*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas brlab pa ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum/

rang nyid dbang chen khro bo ting 'dzin gyis: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar nag tsha: lci zhing 'thas pa 'og phyogs sa gzhir phog: shig ge gas pa'i klong nas rgya mtsho mer: de dbus 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje ni: sku mdog nag po mun ltar 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro gnyer spyan gsum mche gtsigs ral pa bcings: g.yas pas khram shing g.yon pas bsha' gri 'dzin: stag lpags sham thabs mgo phreng mi lpags gyon: skra sen ba spu lcags kyu lta bu 'bar: me rlung dud 'tshub glog dmar 'khyugs pa'i klong : snang srid lha 'dre gdon bgegs kun gyis bskor: chu glang rngam skad dir sgra 'ur chom ldir: mngon sum lta bur bka' sdod dam gnas gyur: oṃ du tri du tri sa mā ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas dgug pa ni/ na moḥ mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bcas: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i bden pa yis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: sngon gyi lan chags 'phral gdon glo bur rkyen: pho 'dre mo gdon ma ning yul 'dre bcas: lo zla zhag skag steng du rtsub pa yi: srid pa'i gdon tshogs yas glud bdag po rnams: skad cig myur ba nyid du 'dir khug cig: badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams srung rgyas bcings/ de nas 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la rnam lnga'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i mthu bo che: 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la: snang ba mdzes pa'i me tog dang : sha sna'i gsur chen tshim pa'i dri: rang snang gsal ba'i zhun chen sgron: khrag zhag mkhris pa'i btung ba 'khyil: sha rus spungs pa'i ro ldan zas: rkang gling dur khrod rol mo'i sgra: snang srid rngam brjid spyan gzigs bcas: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas kyang : las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: badzra ma hā sha ma sha na puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hā:

de nas bka' bsgau zhing bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi dngos: dbang chen khrag 'thung padma he ru kaḥ snang stong sku yi phyag rgya'i 'khor los khyab: grags stong gsung gi hūm̐ sgra 'gags pa med: gsal stong thugs kyi rang bzhin yongs khyab la: 'bar ba'i gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi lhun: snang srid thams cad nga yi rol rtsal te: gnyis 'dzin log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: 'bar ba'i dbyings kyi rgya las ma 'da' zhig: om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ las grub pa'i 'chi bdag stobs po che: mthing nag mun rub spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyugs: lcags kyi ral pa sprugs shing dug char 'bebs: srid gsum srog gi bdag po khyod la bstod: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs rngam pa'i nga ro yis: khams gsum g.yo 'khrugs srid gsum srog dbugs za: rdzu 'phrul 'byung ba'i 'khor los thams cad 'joms: rngam gtum drag shul can la phyag 'tshal bstod: khram shing dug gsum rigs drug mig dgu yis: skye 'gro srog chags thams cad khram la 'debs: rlung gi shugs ldan mun zhags mda' ltar 'phen: khams gsum bla srog 'chi bdag khyod la bstod: gri nag so gcig 'gro ba'i srog rtsa gcod: skra sen lcags kyus 'gro drug lus kun gtub: ba spu'i mtshon cha rno ngar rab 'bar bas: sprul pa'i las byed dpag med 'gyed la bstod: pho nya'i tshogs rnams rngam stabs phyogs bcur rgyug: sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gnas rnams nyul: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun bas stobs chen dpal: kun gyi gshin rje 'od 'phrog khyod la bstod: khyod kyi zhe sdang cha las bdud dang srin: 'dod chags rang mdangs ma mo klu srin tshogs: gti mug las bskyed rmu sogs ma ning sde: snang srid dregs pa'i bdag po khyod la bstod: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i:

'dod yon mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di longs la: phan dge byang sems rgyud la gnas par mdzod: om̐ du tri du tri badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dam la bzhag /de nas glud rdzas dang*/ changs bu brgya rtsa rnams rim pa bzhin bshams la/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: gsum/ mchod pa'i yo byad 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'char kha nag po snang srid lha srin rigs drug lan chags 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: tshim par gyur cig: om̐ du tri du tri dza hūm̐ thā i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas sngags brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bsags bzhin/ dkar po'i rigs 'bru sman zas sna dar zab rin chen sogs mchod g.yog pas/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya'i grangs gzhal tshul byas te snod gzhan du bcad la ci rigs pa'i mtshams su 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang : pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i sde: stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon tshogs rnams: srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam pa yi: mchod sbyin 'dod yon glud gtor 'di: khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams: 'dod srid chags dang zhen pa dang : dran reg mthong reg bzung ba kun: zhi dang glod cig da phrol cig: sngon gyi lan chags sha 'khon dang : bu lon 'phral gyi rkyen la sogs: gang yin ma lus 'khor bar mdzod: bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni: chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis: gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa'i: bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig: ces bsngos pas 'chi bdag 'khor bcas tshims par bsams la 'bul/ rdzas ma rdzogs bar sngar bzhin grangs bsag go

/de nas dmar gtor dang sha dum mthebs skyu rnams bsham/ sha khrag zas sna'i gsur yang btang la/ stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum dmar nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod nams dbang thang gdul bya la bar du gcod pa thams cad rang dbang med par liṅga dgra gzugs gnyis su med par gyur: gzugs kyi phung po bza' ba sha ri khrag mtsho gtor ma glud rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zag pa med par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: lan gsum/ gtor ma sha ri khrag mtsho glud rdzas zag med 'di nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'char kha nag po snang srid lha srin gdon bgegs ma mo rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po ma ning yul 'dre lan chags glud kyi bdag po rnams la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: tshim par gyur cig: om̐ du tri du tri dza hūm̐ thā i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes sngags lan gang mang bsags/ rku 'phrog bcom gsum nor dbul ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: gshe skur 'chal gtam mi kha sdang ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: rdung rdeg btsog gsum zug gzer nad mang ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: bsad bcad gtub gsum tshe thung ba'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: bskyed rdzogs zur nyams gzugs byad ngan pa'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig: ces rdzas rnams mdos la 'bul/ kyaiḥ 'chi bdag las kyi bdag po 'khor bcas dgongs: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: tshe rabs thog ma med nas da bar gyi: lan chags bu lon stong phrag kun 'jal gyis: deng nas ma gnod ma 'tshe yas kha longs: 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa gtan nas spongs: tshe srog las kyi bskyed pa bshol thob la: lo brgya'i bar du sun khas ma sdang cig: ces brjod la sngar ltar grangs bsag /de nas mdos glud 'bul ba ni/

de nas mdun mchod rnams nang du stob la 'chi bdag zhal kha phyir bsgyur zhing*/ mdun du gdan nag gi khar ngar glud dang*/ rdzongs 'debs bkod la mar me sbar/ yas lam phye/ gser skyems sngon du 'gro/ de nas mdos chu gtsang gis bran/ sngags drug phyag rgyas sbyang spel bya/ om̐ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddha ྅haṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ki te na maḥ sa manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni swā hā/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ gra he shwa ri prañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ de nas 'chi bdag sde tshogs dang bcas pa la yas glud kyis brngan zhing*/ rang gnas su rdzongs shing bskrad pa ni/ rang nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i dpa' gdeng dang ldan pas ngang*/ hūm̐: nyon cig 'chi bdag las gshin dregs pa'i tshogs: khyed rnams las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan: khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog bdag chen po ste: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi 'khor dang bcas: ma lus tshim byed mchod sbyin glud gtor ni: rgya che gting zab srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam: gang 'dod ting 'dzin sngags rgyas 'dod rgur spel: lan chags kun 'khor re ba'i yas kha khengs: deng nas bdag cag rgyu 'byor yon bdag la: gnod pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mi 'tshal yang : sngar nas gnod pa yod na khram kha phyes: bcings pa yod na 'chi bdag zhags pa phrol: bsad pa yod na bdud kyi khram kha sgyur: zos pa yod na bla tshe bde bar klod: za kha rno mtshon thams cad dgra la sgyur: lan chags stong rin gang yod 'jal zin pas: mi bslu 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag nas thar: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul:

'gyur med sku gsung thugs su rgyas thob cig: dkon mchog bka' dang chos nyid bden pa'i mthus: bgegs rgyal da song rang rang gnas bskyod 'tshal: sarba bhū ta gatstsha: thun gyis brab cing srung 'khor bsgom mo/ /gzhung las/ zhes brjod 'chi bdag gshin rje nyid: rgya mtshor ri rab 'gyel ba ltar: chob sgra dang bcas mtsho la thim: 'khor gyi bgegs rigs tshogs rnams kyang : rang rang 'dod pa'i yas khyer te: sa 'og sa steng ma nges par: ha sgra dir gyis byer bar bsam: gsungs pa bzhin/ gshin gzugs chu bo'i gzhung ngam lung pa'i mdo sogs rang gnas ma mthong sar bskyal/ dmigs pa ni/ sa gzhi shig ger gas nas rgya mtsho mer gyis byung bas/ chob sgra dang bcas thim par bsam/ de nas thim shul rgya mtsho'i khar dbang chen gyi pho brang btab par mos la shul du skyer phur ram yang na sātstsha zhag gsum b.rabazhag /mthar sgo'i steng ngam khang thog tu bskyal/ nad pa yin na tshe dbang bskur/ rang nyid kyi ched du yin na tshe'i bsnyen par 'bad/ rjes kyi bya gzhung ltar bya'o/ phan yon ni gzhung las/ des ni 'chi bdag khar tshud kyang : lo gsum bar du 'chi ba bslu: gang zhig 'chi ltas ma phog kyang : lo zad zla smad brtsam gyur na: rim gro kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur: spyir ni lo zad nyi ldog mtshams: las kyi gshin rje'i kha lhags nas: 'jig rten stong khams thams cad nyul: khams gsum skye 'gro khram la 'debs: de tshe rnal 'byor gang zhig gis: yi dam lha yi bskyed rim dang : chos nyid bden pa bsten gyur na: lus ngag ye shes rtsis thebs te: 'chi bdag gshin rjes ltar mi bzod: rang lus rdo rje'i sku thob 'gyur: de phyir bsnyen sgrub brtsam pa yis: zab mo'i don la yengs med bskyang : 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs so/ de ltar tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las tshogs/ 'chi bslu bdud dpung g.yul bzlog khrigs su bsdebs pa 'di'ang slob dpon chen po ba su dhā ra dang 'jam dpal rdo rje gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/

rā lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa sogs/ 'jam dpal grub pa'i rig 'dzin du ma'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas/ bal yul yang le shod gsang sngags gling du rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me pho khyi'i lo/ dbo zla ba'i tshes bcu la bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal gyis bgyis pa'i/ yi ge pa ni o rgyan gsang sngags kyis bgyis pa'o// // ra) ༈ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i tshe sgrub rnam bzhi bla ma zhi drag sogs spyi khyab kyi sgrub khog 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā yurdzñā na de wa ḍākki nī ye/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun bzang rdo rje 'chang*/ /rgyal kun 'dus gzugs gu ru pad 'byung rje/ /zab brgya'i mdzod 'dzin ma gcig mtsho rgyal ma/ /skyabs mchog rtsa ba gsum gyis shis pa stsol/ /bstan 'gro zab gter chos kyis smin mdzad pa'i/ /gter chen brgya rtsa gter phran stong gi phreng*/ /lung zin skyes chen bstan 'gro'i dpal yon rnams/ /mi phyed dad pa'i spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag rtsa ba gsum/ /gang de'i rol gar legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa'i/ /ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag mchod snying nas bsngags/ /drag sngags bka' bab sangs rgyas ye shes kyi/ /yang sprul o rgyan gar dbang rtsa gsum gling*/ /kun las khyad 'phags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes/ /gang de'i zab chos 'dod don lhun grub las/ /'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa rnam bzhi bzhag /rang lugs bla ma zhi drag rtsa gsum sogs/ khyad par tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi/ /gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang yod bzhin par/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i phyag bzhes ni/ /rnying lugs so sor 'ga' zhig yod mod kyang*/ /snyigs dus 'gro mgon padma gar gyi dbang*/ /blo gros mtha' yas paṇa grub chen po yis/

/bka' gter kun gyi yang snying don bsdus nas/ /sgrub pa'i khog dbub gcig shes kun grol dang*/ /gter chen thugs sprul mi 'jigs rdo rje yis/ khog dbub bsdus pa snang gsal sgron me la/ /sor bzhag lag len khrigs su bkod pa 'di/ /skal ldan grub pa brnyes pa'i thabs zab mo/ /'chi med bdud rtsi 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang bstan/ de'ang gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams lag len che thang du bsngags shing dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu 'grub par byed pa'i thabs zab rmad du byung ba tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i lag len pra khrid gzhung so so las mang du 'byung ba'o/ /'dir rang gter rtsa gsum zhi khro spyi dang*/ tshe sgrub rnam bzhi sogs spyir 'jug cing 'khyer bde kho na'i dbang du byas te bkod pa la gsum/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba/ rjes las kyi rim pa mtha' rgyas su bya ba'o/ /dang po ni gter kha phal mo cher/ ston pa gnas dang 'khor dang dus/ /yo byad la sogs bzhir ldan pa/ /zhes 'chad pa mang yang*/ 'dir gsang sngags lam rim ltar na/ dang po sgrub pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gu ru rin po che dang grub thob sogs du mas byin gyis brlabs la/ dben pa nyams dga' zhing dam nyams sde 'khrug sogs kyi grib kyis ma gos pa'o/ /rang gter las/ dwangs shing snang ba dben pa'i gnas: phun tshogs zla gam dbang phug tu: dmar zhing dwang ba'i sa gzhi la: dal bcag thig gdab dkyil 'khor bri: zhes dang*/ gnyis pa dus ni/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi/ ra ba bzhi'i yar ngo*/ yar mar tshes bcu rnams dang ma 'dzoms na gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba la'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyal thebs gzungs ma'i gtso bor gyur pa'i ston 'khor thams cad so so'i mtshan nyid gzhung mthun dgos par gsungs kyang*/

spyi tsam du sgrub pa gang bya rgyu de nyid kyi dbang lung rdzogs par thob cing bsnyen pa las rung du byas pas bsgrub bya la the tshom med cing dad pa rtse gcig dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa po nang phan tshun dam sel gtan nas med pa zhig gal che'o/ /bzhi pa yo byad ni/ dkyil 'khor rdul tshon mi 'grub pa'i skabs su ras bris tshad ldan med thabs med cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgrub rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ rgyan rdzas la sogs pa dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad tshags su tshud par bya'o/ /lnga pa sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ yid ches rtsod bral gyi bka' ma dang*/ gter ma las byon cing dam sel gyis brgyud pa ma bslad par rgyud lung man ngag khungs btsun gyi dgongs pa dang mthun cing 'khrul pa med pa/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i las rim mo/ /dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams gyi dpung bskyed pa/ sa yi cho ga bya ba'o/ /dang po la bla ma dgongs 'dus las rim pa bcur bshad la sogs dang*/ bde 'dus bsnyen sgrub chen mo'i pra khrid ltar na bzhi/ rang rgyud sbyong ba/ chos 'khor bskor ba/ gtor ma gtong ba/ sbyin gtong bya ba gsum/ de re re la bzhi bzhir 'byung ste/ dang po ni lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir sātstsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don/ srog bslu/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya/ ngag sgrib sbyang phyir/ na raka dong sprugs dang yig brgya bzla/ yid sgrib sbyang phyir sems bskyed blang zhing bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs/ gsum ka'i phyir du phyag skor dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs skong rgya cher bya/ gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid kyi don rtogs phyir sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ bdud gzhom phyir lhor stobs po che/ rgyu 'bras go phyir nub tu lang kar gshegs pa/

bar chad zhi phyir byang du tog gzungs dang gra nga bklag /gsum pa ni/ byin rlabs 'byung phyir sri zhu/ phrin las bcol phyir yon tan/ 'byor pa 'thob phyir snying rje/ bu lon 'khor phyir lan chags kyi mgron rnams la phyi chu gtor dang mdos glud/ nang gtor ma/ gsang ba lus kyi mchod sbyin bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dngos su snang ba'i mgron bzhi la dngos 'byor ci rigs pas mnyes shing tshim par byed pa ste/ bla ma dang dge 'dun rje dpon dang yon tan can nad pa dang dbul phongs bya rigs chu gnas bu lon lan chags pa dang*/ mi mdza' ba rnams yon dang bza' btung ci 'byor btab la sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ /gnyis pa sa yi cho ga la lnga/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ dbang du bya ba/ sbyang ba bzung zhing bsrung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mtshan nyid rten 'brel lto 'phye brtag pa rnams te/ sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa snang ba mi las bslangs zin pa'i dbang du byas te/ mi snang ba las bslang ba la gnyis/ sa lha mi min yul bdag spyi la'o/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhi stegs byi dor byas par tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum mtheb ril gyis mtshan pa gnyis dang*/ gser skyems/ mtha' skor byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas brtsam chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor du bkod/ bdag bskyed la mkho ba'i phyi nang gi mchod gtor gang dgos phug logs lta bur bshams shing 'og gi skabs so sor dgos pa'i yau byad rnams kyang tshags su tshud par bya'o/ /de nas thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor ram lugs 'ga' zhig tu sku gtsor rkyang dran rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa brgya rtsa byas pas chog pa yod kyang*/ spyi khyab ltar na tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyang*/ so so'i sgrub thabs dang mthun pa'i mngon rtogs rgyun khyer lta bu nyung 'dus kyi gsal gdab la zhes pas/

hūm̐: e las rang byung gzhal yas khang : gnam lcags las grub mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus chos 'byung baṃ gyi steng : rang rig padma he ru kaḥ hya ghṛ wa dmar nag gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: sma ra dbu skra me 'od 'khrugs: rta skad hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes bgegs dpung 'joms: g.yon pa'i phur pas tshe bdud bsgral: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham brjid: rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor: 'jigs byed chen po'i sku ru gsal: drag sngags hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yis: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: rang byung ye shes lnga ru gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐: om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa kī la ya kro ti baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes nyer gcig bzla/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mthar bsdu ldang bya/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas gsal gdab cing*/ ha ha: hūm̐ hūm̐: ho ho: phaiṃ phaiṃ: de nas khro bo'i gad rgyangs sa gsum rab tu g.yo ba bsgrags par bsam/ hoḥ de ring bkra shis dus tshes bzang : rten 'brel kun gyi mgo yang legs: gnas bdag yul 'dzin phun sum 'tshogs: mi shigs pho brang sa 'dul lo: mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab: hūm̐: mdun du ri rab gling bzhi'i dbus: skyon bral padma'i lte ba zlum: sa yi lha mo bstan ma ser: bum 'dzin pus btsugs gus pa'i tshul:

'khor du sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bcas: rang mdog phyogs mthun rgyan chas gsal: thugs srog laṃ las 'od 'phros pas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang rang gdan la dgyes par bzhugs: om̐ baṃ laṃ bhū mi pa ti badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ri rab rol mtsho bcud kyi bdag: sa la gnas pa'i lha mo che: sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bran g.yog 'khor: mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rin chen gser gyi sa mchog stsol: de ring dbang chen dkyil 'khor 'debs: bdag gis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi: phrin las bya ba gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog dang : gdug pa'i sdang sems zhi gyur nas: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rogs dan dang : lo legs 'bru 'phel nad yams zhi: khyed cag sa mchog 'di phul mthus: mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur: de ltar bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul la sa gnon gyis rgyas gdab/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par bsam/ zhi rol bcas gtor ma phyir 'bul/ gnyis pa ni/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ sd+yā na ti kṣe ṭa pa la lañtsa na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang la gnas pa'i/ /sa 'dzin sde dpon bcu gnyis dang*/ /spar kha sme ba lo skor dang*/ /gza' khyim dus 'gyu zhag gi lha/ /lha klu phyogs skyong sde brgyad dang*/ /'byung ba'i sde brgyad gzhi bdag la/

/gser skyems gtor ma 'di 'bul bas/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /sa rko ri bshig brag bsgyel zhing*/ /chu rlung me 'gyed zor 'phang dang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las gang yang*/ legs nyes bya ba gang byas kyang*/ ko long spangs shing rogs dan mdzod/ /gal te phrag dog sdang gyur tshe/ /bdag nyid khyung chen khro rgyal gyis/ /ri rab bsnyil zhing rgya mtsho dkrug /klu dang sa bdag dregs pa'i rigs/ /rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ /de bas dam srungs phrin las mdzod/ /om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa ma ya ba lingta kha kha khā hi/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gātstsha/ gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ 'jam rol dang bcas gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ mchod pa rnams bsdu'o/ /gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni/ stegs kyi mdun nas slob dpon gyis dbang mchog gi phur bu bzung*/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros: phur bu la thim: de nyid dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gyur par bsams la/ hrī padma ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btab ste lan bdun bzlas pas/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar pos sa gzhi thams cad khyab/ bdag gis dbang du gyur par bsam mo/ /'dir dgongs 'dus las stobs po che/ phur pa las rdo rje gzhon nu bskyed pa sogs gzhung rnams su 'dra min dmigs bsal 'byung ba ste de ltar bya dgos so/ /bzhi pa sbyang ba la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga ser po bsams nas/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /thams cad kyi rdo rje dang bcas lag g.yas sa la reg pa'i tshul byas nas/ om̐ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sa la bsnun/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ phra mo grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phros:

'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs: zhi ba'i rigs la/ rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por gyur: ces dang*/ khro bo la/ dur khrod rol pa'i zhing khams chen por gyur: ces mos/ lnga pa bzung ba dang bsrung ba gnyis las/ dang po bgegs gtor byin brlab cing sngags kyis bsngo/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo zhing mtshams gcod/ srung 'khor bsgom/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhengs te las phur thogs la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu spros pa'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang bar gyur/ phur bu rnams stod zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu 'dril ba/ smad lcags phur me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ phur pa bsgril zhing*/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: 'og min rdo rje'i pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang gis: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rngam stabs kyis: drag sngags me yis stong khams bkang : ma rig nyon mongs sa sri btul: dbyings phyug mi 'gyur sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: che mchog khrag 'thung khro rgyal gyis: bdud po mgo gsum 'dul ba'i tshe: drag sngags rdo rje'i char chen phab: bar gyi 'jig rten sa sri btul: gsang chen rmang btang sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: klu srin sa bdag kha rlangs las: rims nad sa sri 'dul ba'i tshe: sprul pa'i bya khyung me gshog gis: klu srin ma rungs sa bdag bcom: 'og gi ma rungs sa sri btul: rlung ri rdo rje'i sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: lha 'dre ma rungs dam la btags: bod khams gling bzhi'i sa sri btul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rmang gzhi btsugs:

de ring gsang ba'i sa 'dzin no: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi 'gros stabs kyis: shar gyi sa sri dam la btags: shar phyogs zhi ba'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba shing gi srung mkhar btsugs: shar gyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi 'gros stabs kyis: lho yi sa sri dam la btags: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba me yi srung mkhar btsugs: lho yi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yon tan ma mo'i 'gros stabs kyis: nub kyi sa sri dam la btags: nub phyogs dbang gi pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba chu yi srung mkhar btsugs: nub kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i 'gros stabs kyis: byang gi sa sri dam la btags: byang phyogs drag po'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba lcags kyi srung mkhar btsugs: byang gi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yang dag khrag 'thung 'gros stabs kyis: dbus kyi sa sri dam la btags: dbus phyogs che mchog pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba rlung gi srung mkhar btsugs: dbus kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: ces phur pa 'debs shing*/ om̐ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya badzra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bighnān kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan gsum/ phur bu las 'phros pa'i khro chung dang me 'od kyis sa gzhi khengs par gyur: hūm̐: steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo phub: 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bcings: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rgya gram 'gros kyis sa bcag go /spro na 'dir stangs stabs dang bskor ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ ye shes kyi lha bsnyen pa'i rim pa/ lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa'i rim pa grub nas dngos grub len pa sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la bcu ste/

mtshams gsum rten bca' sta gon bya/ /rgyan bkod mnga' gsol brda sbyar cing*/ /sri mnan bskos gdab byin 'bebs so/ /zhes pa'i dang po phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyogs bzhir tho bzhi la rgyal chen so so'i sku'am sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs la so so'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum mdun mtheb skyu ril bus mtshan pa re dang*/ de yi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bsham: sgrub pa po rnams rol chas sogs ser sbreng gi tshul gyis sgrub khang nas thon te shar gyi tho mdun du 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlab/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas pi waṃ du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ dhriṣṭa rāṣṭā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hā:

bar gyis mchod/ om̐ dhriṣṭa rāṣṭā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung : lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: dri za 'bum dang me lhas bskor: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis shar phyogs dung sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing shar gyi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ badzra bhrūm̐ bi pa la rā dza badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ dhriṣṭa rāṣṭā ya swā hā/ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ lho yi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlab/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ral grir gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa gshin rje'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dya shabda pra tītstsha swā hā:

om̐ bi rū dha kā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: gshin rje 'bum dang grul bum bskor: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis lho phyogs gser sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing lho yi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ ārya gu li rā dza ratna rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlab/

bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas sbrul zhags su gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dya shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : ba glang spyod la dbang bsgyur tshe: klu dbang 'bum dang rlung lha bcas: mos bzhi dbang sgyur mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis nub phyogs zangs sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing nub kyi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ tsakṣu mu ta rā dza padma ātma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlab/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ne'u lar gyur:

de yongs su gyur pa las rnam thos sras ljang gu ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ om̐ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dya shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: rtsa sngags mthar/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur tshe: gnod sbyin 'bum dang dbang ldan bcas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis byang phyogs lcags sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing byang gi sgo mtshams chod: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā rā dza karma rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /gnyis pa bar mtshams la gnyis/ /dam sri mnan pa sgo byang gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gzhung las stobs chen ma hā ba la'i lto bar khro zhal nang du liṅga bri ba dang bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang spyir btang du dug shog la dam sri liṅga bya mchu can yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying khar dza tri na tri dza kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/ ya ma dam sri ya ma pa ri mā ra dza dzaḥ nan nan/ tri'u tri'u mā ra ya na ma sho dzaḥ khug nan/ zhes dang gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dus drug dang bcur rgyu ba'i nyul le dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs thams cad non cig

bskal pa stong gi bar du ma ldang zhig /om̐ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar dza khraṃ gyis bskor ba bris la/ 'grub na sgrub pa'i snga nyin ltar phur pa sogs drag po'i phrin las btang ba'i tshogs tha ma'i gdab kha dang 'brel bar 'gugs stim grangs mang byas la thun gdab ces 'di sta gon gyi nyin snga mar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i ling khrus dang 'gugs gzhug drag po byas la/ ling lteb sogs snga tshags tshud par bya dgos pa yin no/ /de'i tshul zur du shes par bya'o/ mchan gang ltar yang*/ 'dre lteb tu bcag cing tshon skud kyis bcing*/ thod ngan nam khyi thod lta bur bcug phung ras kyis dril la rtsang gis gzir ba'i mnan chas bya/ sgo drung du dong gru gsum brus pa la bkod/ de tsam mi 'grub pa'i skabs liṅga dong nang du bting*/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par skabs gang yin pa'i lha mtshan kha bsgyur la lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' gnyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum la gser skyems 'bul/ 'dir khro bo'i rigs la de'i nga rgyal bzung des 'thus/ zhi ba'i rigs la khro bo'i nga rgyal bzung dgos pas gu ru zhi ba las la artsig brjod de bla ma drag po dang thugs rje chen po la lha sngags kyis rta mgrin gsal gdab sogs 'gres sbyar la/

om̐ badzra kro dha ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ e yaṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po sa rim pa dgu'i bdag po nag la 'jigs shing srog la rngam tshul can/ 'chi bdag kha shin tu gdangs pa'i nang du na nag po yongs su gyur pa las dug gi rus sbal nag po khang sgrom gyi dbyibs can/ de'i dbus su tri nag po las dam sri pho mo mdog mi sdug cing sngo ham pa mya ngan gyi gzugs can rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i? khyad par skabs gang yin pa'i lha mtshan sbyar la lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ de nas thun brdeg cing mnan pa ni/ hūm̐: sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer nas: 'chi bdag kha tham nag po bzhengs: nad rlangs dug gzer 'phro zhing bzhengs: za byed gdug pa'i khro zhal gdongs: 'joms byed rno ba'i sgrol mche gtsigs: 'jib byed g.yo ba'i dbal lce rkyongs: snyob byed 'chi bdag lag pa rkyongs: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan dang : sgrub la bar gcod dam sri'i rigs: sgab 'dre yul 'dre rgyal 'gong dang : gson 'dre pho mo shi 'dre'i rigs: grib can la sogs gnod byed rnams: 'chi bdag gnod sbyin khyod la gtad: deng bzung bskal pa ma stong bar: ma shor zungs shig lag ma shor: gal te shor ram btang srid na: bdag nyid gtum drag he ru kas: srid gsum bshig cing stong gsum 'gul: mthu chen drag rtsal rdul du brlag:

de bas byang chub mchis kyi bar: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: om̐ tsaṇḍa he ru ka ya ma rā dza kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: dam sri 'byung po waka thaṃ spur thaṃ nan: 'og gi 'don tshig dang bstun te skyer phur sor bzhi pa gdab/ thun rdzas brab/ gu gul bdug /dur rdo la ri rab gling bzhi dang rgya gram bris pas mnan la/ hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mched lcam rnams la gnod 'tshe bskyal: rgyal khams kun tu mi dge btang : gsang sngags lam gyi sgo yang bkag: bka' 'das nam yang ma btang bas: da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab: thun tshogs gdab ste dud tshogs gtibs: gtub cing srin po'i zhal du bstab: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: zhes mthar 'bebs ring 'og tu sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum re dang sātstsha nag pos mnan/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgya: brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcu bcings te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: dpa' bo'i bro ra byas te brdungs: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: om̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs par bsams la/ mched lcam rnams srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel te las bzhi'i bro gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ bsdu na las byang so sor 'byung ba'i bro brdung hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/ /gnyis pa sgo byang phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi'i sgo gong du ra sog gam ro ras la sogs par dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum la bya khyung sde lngas bskor ba snying po 'dod gsol bris pa dang skyer phur la snying po bris te rgyab tu btags pa bkod/

dmar gtor dang mchod yon sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhandha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang bar gtor snod bhandha 'bar bar gtor rdzas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ om̐ hya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang chen rta mchog padma he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar gdeng zhing g.yon pas lcags sgrog thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyi gseb nas rta skad 'tsher bas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud cing zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril bas phung 'dre dam sri rgyal 'gong gi snying khrag gsol ba/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan cing*/ yum phag mo gri thod 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'jigs byed bya khyung rigs lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon pa/ sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan cing me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na 'gyings pa'i gnas gsum om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badzra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ hrīḥpadma kro ta hya ghṛ ba hūm̐: lan bdun/ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: sogs kyis mchod/ om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: dpal chen padma dbang gi lha: che mchog yongs 'dus gtso bo che: las kyi khro bo mi bzad pa: bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms khrag 'thung sku: dmar nag rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril srid gsum g.yo: rab 'jigs gyad kyis dor stabs tshul:

dbang sdud dmar mo gri thod 'dzin: 'jigs byed bya khyung sde lngas bskor: gser mig zangs rwa lcags sder bgrad: klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen po che: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung : dbang chen dregs pa khro chen tshogs: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bar sgo srung zhing gshegs mtshams chod: om̐ padma ta kri ta hya ghṛ wa badzra wā ra hī ga ru ṭa yakṣa badzra kro ta hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes lan gsum bzlas nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ tiṣṭha badzraḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya/ zhes phyi'i sgo srung gi gzugs cing sgrub khang sgo yi ya them la zla ba/ ma them la nyi ma/ g.yas su g.yung drung*/ g.yon du 'khor lo bris te bkod la/ hūm̐: steng phyogs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: 'og tu nyi ma'i sa gzhi bdal: g.yas su rlung gi g.yung drung la: g.yon du sa yi 'khor lo ste: 'byung ba'i kha sbyor srung ba'i gur: su yang bgrod par mi nus so: dam sri 'byung po mtshams chod cig: de nas nang sgo'i shing byang la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku sngags 'dod gsol skyer phur sngags ldan bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhandha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang ba gtor snod bhandha 'bar ba gtor rdzas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag g.yas bum pa 'khor lo g.yon rgya gram thogs pa yum gri thod 'dzin pa sbyor te bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum du om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badzra sa mā dza:

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kunḍa li hūm̐: lan bdun/ arghaṃ? sogs/ om̐ badzra kro ta a mṛ ta kunḍa li i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: khro chen 'bar ba bdud rtsi 'khyil: dpal chen las kyi he ru kaḥ sngo sangs thabs shes phyag rgya yis: bum pa 'khor lo rgya gram 'dzin: mi zad zad med bdud rtsi 'khyil: dam tshig yum chen gri thod sbyor: khro bo'i rol stabs stangs stabs brjid: ye shes dam tshig mkha' 'gros bskor: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis sgo mtshams 'di srung zhing : dngos grub phyi ru ma gtong zhig: sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi mdzad cing : las kyi rtags rgya 'di srungs shig: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha ri ni sa baṃ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ badzra rakṣa rakṣa: zhes dang tiṣṭha badzraḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /sgo byang gnyis ma 'dzom pa'am bsdu na phyi sgo'i rta mgrin kho nas chog go /sgo them gyi nang du brub khung zhig gi nang du zan ling la seng ldeng ngam skyer pa'i phur bu'i dbal la mi g.yo ba'i sngags dang*/ mgul du rgya shog la sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig ces bris te btags pas rgyas gdab/

sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod/ gsum pa gsang mtshams la gnyis/ ma traṃ bsgral ba dang*/ khro bcu'i phur gdab bo/ /dang po ni/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod med pa'i rigs phal cher la mdzad srol mi 'dug pas 'di bzhag nas 'og gi phur gdab la 'jug pas chog /'on kyang bla med yin phyir dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du lhun gyi grub pas sbyar yang 'gal ba med pas rata gling thugs gsang sogs las bshad pa ltar dang*/ khro bo'i rigs sogs dkyil 'khor dur khrod bcas pa las nges par gal che ba yin/ de yang slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i bar dag gsang 'grel dang*/ hūm̐ ka ra'i mnyam sbyor dkyil chog go /cho ga'i chings bcu gnyis kyi rtsis 'gos bsdus pa sogs phyag len rgyas bsdus mang yang gter ma'i phyogs su bka' brgyad bde 'dus nyid khungs zab cing don 'dus pas de ltar na/ dang po rang rgyud kyi ma traṃ bdag 'dzin 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i nga bdag bsgral ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ma traṃ gi gzugs brnyan mgo lho nub tu bstan pa gan rkyal du bzhag /stegs bu'i shar ngos slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs te phyag tu g.yab dar dril bu bsnams nas stong thun bshad pa'i rjes su gzhung gang yin gyi las sngags brjod la/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur par bsam/ mnyam bzhag gi rgyas/ phaṭḥ kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rig pa ma 'gags 'gyu ba las: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i ru tra byung : bag chags rim par brtsegs pa las: nga bdag nyon mongs las kyi rlung : ye shes sgrib pa'i gnod byed la: ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyu yis: shes rig lta ba'i phur bus bsnun: gtub bo gcig chod sa ma ya: gtubs shig ka dag khregs chod mtshon: nga bdag ru tra dbyings su sgrol: ma ni 'khor 'das dbang chen gzhi:

traṃ ni brdal khyab chos sku'i dal: ru ni ma bcos spros bral dbyings: tra ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg: ye grol chen po'i pho brang nas: zang thal rgya yan pho brang gsal: om̐ dharma dzñā na ma traṃ ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces bdag lus ye nas gzhal yas khang du gsal: lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bcings te/ ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ lan bdun brjod/ phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po stong gsum dang mnyam pa las kyi bsad khang de'i dbus su nad rlangs sngo dmar yam yam 'phro ba'i rnam pa can gyi nang du gnod byed mo 'dre gdon bgegs sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri'i rigs lus sngo ba ham pa red pa nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gsal bar gyur: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum dkon mchog thugs rje'i bdag: rgyal sras rig 'dzin grub thob phyag rgya sngags: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub la bar gcod tshogs: 'byung po mi min gnod byed dam sri dang : log 'dren gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus rnams: steng 'og phyogs bcu ri rab gling bzhi'i srang : ban bon lha srung skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di dag la: myur du khug cig rdo rje lcags kyu ma: chongs shig sdoms shig las byed zhags pa ma: gcun cig gzir cig mthu stobs lcags sgrog ma: myos shig gtor cig las byed ral gri ma: rang dbang med par gzugs ling 'di la khug: om̐ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes bkug /bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: sras mchog badzra kī la ya: mthing nag rab rngam tshwa tshwa 'phro: rdo rje gdeng zhing phur bu 'debs: dam sri gnod byed byad ma rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlags par byed: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral zhing*/ ma hā de ba ru tra dza dzaḥhūm̐: zhes lan bdun bzla zhing thams cad kyi lag g.yas kyi sor mo gsum sbreng ba kha ṭwāṃ gyi rgyas snying khar bsnun tshul byas la/

gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig: ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs dang bral: rnam shes tri nag por gnas pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sbyangs pas hūm̐ yig dkar por gyur bdag gi thugs kar thim nas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ stegs bu'i mthar sngar dam sri mnan pa'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin du bro brdung*/ bsdu na med kyang chog /de nas snying dbus su dur khrod ma la ya: rtsib g.yas shar bsil ba tshal: mgo lho kī la rdzogs: rtsib g.yon nub laṅka brtsegs: gsang gnas byang padma brtsegs: lag g.yon shar lho gsang chen rol: lag g.yas lho nub lhun grub gter: rkang g.yas nub byang 'jig rten brtsegs par gyur: rkang g.yon byang shar he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du gyur cing lha so so'i pho brang du gyur par bsam la/ hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi la: dbang chen pho brang gzhi ru gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yas: shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i lag pa g.yon: lho phyogs gad rgyangs dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yon: nub phyogs tshang tshing dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i rkang pa g.yas: byang phyogs rab rgyu dur khrod gsal: ru tra bsgral ba'i mtshams bzhi 'di: ha ha rgod dang bsil ba tshal: rngam pa sgra sgrogs kī la'i gnas: nang rol phyi nang rim pa bzhin: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas brgyad gsal: snying dbus dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dal: yongs rdzogs gzi brjid mdangs ldan gsal: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ātma ko3 haṃ: slob dpon shar du gnas pas bhrūm̐ dzñā na maṇḍal bhrūm̐: thugs ka nas bhrūm̐ 'phros khog pa la thim pas khog pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod brgyad rwa ba me dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur: zhes bsam/ zhi ba lta bu la/ khog pa ye shes rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen por gyur: ces bsgyur/ thams cad kyi lag g.yas phyi dang lag g.yon nang du byas pa'i khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol zhing*/

hūm̐: pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces lan bdun bzlas nas rgya bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phye bar gyur par bsams la/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'gros gar gyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ha ha ha: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod nas dkyil 'khor g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du tshud par gyur: zhes brjod la stegs bu'i dbus kyi khri'u'i khar slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du seng ldeng gi phur bu tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur zhing rtse mor me tog phreng bas bcings pa bcu bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub rnams su phur gdan bcu bkod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu spros phur bu rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las stod khro bo'i gzugs can smad phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ thams cad hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sumbha na ི'i sngags kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug pa la slob dpon gyis lag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon pas phur bu bzung la/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'jig rten kun: zhe sdang rdo rje bla na med: sku gsung thugs sprul stobs dang ldan: ta krita khrag 'thung khro rgyal bcu: 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i stangs stabs kyis: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams brlag par mdzod: dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: rang byung khro rgyal chen po bcu: log 'dren bdud bgegs mtshams gcod phyir: khro bcu'i phur pa gdab par bya: shar gyi phur bu nas brtsam g.yas su rim par/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ shar lhor/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la: gnod byed 'byung po bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho ru/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po nī la daṇḍa hūm̐: da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho nub du/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya:

gnod byed 'byung po ya mānta ka hūm̐: pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub tu/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po ārya a tsa le hūm̐: bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub byang du/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po hya ghri ba hūm̐: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang du/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang shar bcas su gdab/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po a mṛ ta kunḍa li hūm̐: tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang g.yon skor du phyin la steng gi phur bu shar gyi mdun dang*/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub kyi mdun du 'og gi phur bu/ om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: gnod byed 'byung po ma hā bā la hūm̐: spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces 'bar ba'i stangs stabs dang bcas stegs kyi phur bu shar gyi shar/ shar nas shar lho sogs rim gyis byang shar bar g.yas bskor dang*/ steng 'og gi phur bu'i shar nub tu gdab pas/ bgegs rnams kyi snying phug nas g.yo 'gul med cing 'od gsal bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'khor 'od zer srung ba'i 'khor lo 'khrigs pas phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par bsam/ zhes dang*/ las gzhung so so nas 'byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi tshig brjod cing bsrung bya srung byed thams cad las 'das pa kho na nyid kyi srung 'khor yang bya/ ma traṃ dang phur pa de dag re zhig phyogs su bsdus te rgyan bkod skabs su bkram par bya'o/ /gzhung rnying rnams las rgyal chen bzhi po so pa'i tshul dang*/ khro bcu'i mtshams phur jag pa'i skung gi tshul du bzhag pa yin par bshad cing sa chog skabs khro bcu'i phur gdab yod pa'i rigs la/ skabs der dngos su gdab cing 'dir gdab mi dgos par sngags tshig tsam brjod pa thugs dam bskul ba yin zhes smin lugs gsung rgyun du 'byung ngo*/

/bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bca' ba la/ thog mar chag chag gdab pa ni/ dung phor ram ka pā lar bdud rtsi rnam pa lngar sbyar ba'i dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la rdo rje khu tshur gyis byang shar nas g.yas bskor du khyab par khyams med par byug cing*/ hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu: rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gi byang chub sems bskyed mchog: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhi chag chag 'debs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun rgyu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: rang byung rten 'brel 'char ba'i steng : gsang ba ḍākki'i dal bcag pas: dbang chen mkha' klong yangs par gsal: om̐ sarba dharma bhū mi haṃ: zhes brjod cing zhi rol bya/ lnga pa sta gon la bzhi/ bum pa yo byad slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'o/ de'ang slob ma la dbang bskur dang 'brel na de rnams skabs dang sbyar/ ma 'brel na mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang yo byad sta gon ni nam du'ang dgos pas sgrub rdzas tshang bar bsags la thams cad kyang*/ ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu mos pas byin gyis brlabs lha sta gon ni/ gtso bo dkyil 'khor bri bar gnang ba zhu ba'i don yin pas grub na legs pa las lhag skyon du mi 'gyur bas de ltar na/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus gtso bo'i gnas su bdud rtsi dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab kyis thig le gru bzhi 'khor rnams kyi gnas su zlum po re/ de rnams su lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: btags pa brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu gtso 'khor phyed par bkod/ phyi nang gi mchod pas bstod/ las byang ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar du song nas thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ hoḥ dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs:

dkyil 'khor bzang po legs bris nas: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub las gzhung bsrang : sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod: lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis se gol gsum byas la/ lha rnams bar snang 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par bsam/ tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ /'dir yang las byang gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa mi lcogs pa lta bu la/ sgrub pa'i gzhir rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen po chaiga'i lha tshogs dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ ces gdod nas grub pa'i sems kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab la mchod bstod byas pas kyang chog go /sgrub pa'i mthar slob ma la dbang bskur ba sogs bum pa sta gon dgos pa'i rigs la bsdu bar 'dod na/ bum pa lha grangs sam rnam bum dang las bum tsam 'du bya/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pas bgegs bskrad/ bum pa chas su gzhug pa'i sngags bka' dgongs sogs nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod la nang bcud mgul chings kha rgyan ldan pa bkod/ mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis brlab/ bum pa bsang sbyang bya/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las phyi rin po che bum pa'i rnam pa la nang : gzhal yas khang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus su chaiga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mtsho rdzing dwangs par zla skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur: arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza hoḥ zhes sngags tsam gyis mchod/ phyag 'tshal shau lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gzung thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros bum pa'i lha rnams la phog: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems ye shes bcud du 'khyil bar bsam: bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags bzla/ mthar/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i mchod yon phul bas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur:

las bum ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang padmar gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bum pa bsnams pa khro bo'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ ham̐'u: 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar mos la/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzlas mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur te phrin las mdzad par

mos la/ bsdu na las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang rten lta bur so sor las lha bskyed la sngags bzlas pas byin rlabs 'od zhu dang mchod bstod bya/ dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rim pa ni/ dbang gi sa gzhi 'jam zhing lag mthil ltar mnyam bya/ thig skud dal gyi nyis 'gyur tshad tsam gyis 'debs pa'i ri mo dkar po dag tu 'dod/ sgrub pa po ni dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod: bkra shis mtshan ldan rig ma rgyan can de: shar du gnas la thig skud sne mo gtong : de nas thig skud rdo rje padmar mtshon: dang po mkha' la ye shes dal thig gdab: thig skud rig ma'i spyi bor khru gang 'degs: hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' lam du: bden gnyis 'bras bu ston pa'i phyir: rig pa rdo rje'i thig gdab bo: rang byung ye nas pho brang gsal: om̐ dharma badzra swa bhā wa hūm̐: de nas rig ma'i brang la gtad: shes rab yum gyi bha ga ru: thabs kyi kun da sbreng bar bsam: hoḥ stong nyid ye shes rgyun lam du: zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i phyir: zung 'jug bde chen thig gdab bo: sna tshogs lnga ldan lhun gyis grub: om̐ pra dzñā su khaṃ pra mo ti ri hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor dag la gdab: hūm̐: lā sye sgeg mo yid 'ong gar: dbyangs can mnyen lcug 'khril zhing ldem: bkra shis lha mo tshe 'dzin grogs: mkha' dbyings padma'i tshe dal du: kun 'byung nor bu'i thig gdab bo: om̐ bhrūm̐ dzñā na saṃ kṛ ta maṇḍal mu dra de bi dha ra hūm̐ swā hā: zhes pas cha tshad legs par gdab: lag len rdzas sogs pra khrid ltos: de nas tshon byin brlab pa ni: 'byung ba rim brtsegs mtshon pa'i phyir: dbus su ljang gu la tām̐ bri: de steng dmar po pām̐ bris la bzhag /de steng dkar po la mām̐ bris la bzhag /de steng ser po la lām̐ bris la bzhag /de steng sngon po la mūm̐ bris la bzhag hūm̐: 'byung ba rang byung bsnol brtsegs thabs:

gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rang byung rang shar de bzhin tu: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus de ltar thim: om̐ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ bhrūm̐: slar phyogs su bzhag nas/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes bris la/ hūm̐: zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod phrag dog: gti mug ma spangs dbyings su dag: ye shes lnga ru lam gyis shar: kun tu gnas gyur sa bon bhrūm̐: om̐ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe haṃ: dang po zhi rgyas dbang drag gam/ /phrin las gang du 'jug pa yi/ /sa slong dal bcag dri bzang gis: chag chag btab nas thig gdab pa: thig tshad dal gyi nyis 'gyur tshad: shes rab gzhi la thabs kyis gdab: slob dpon nub nas shar du gyu: rig ma shar nas langs te bzhengs: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gdab: gnyis pa dbus nas cha bzhi mnyam: dbus ma'i tshangs thig legs par gdab: tshangs thig bgos pa'i gnyis cha'i mtshams: g.yas g.yon bya rog rjes rnams btsal: de la gcig btab thabs shes gnyis: bzhi cha gdab pa tshad med bzhi: de nas gnyis gdab phar phyin drug: go cha dang po rnam thar brgyad: gnyis pa stong nyid bcu drug pa: gsum pa dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi: bzhi pa mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: des ni gzhung gi thig chen tshang : de nas sa bcad bgo ba ni: nub byang slob dpon dag gis gdab: shar phyogs gsang ba'i rig mas gdab: dang po phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: gnyis pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag: lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma bsal: bdun pa cha bzhi legs par gdab: brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab: de yis thig chen rtsa gnyis rdzogs: dang po cha chen lta ba la: gnyis pa padma gsum 'khor lo: bzhi pa sgo mtshams blo yis dpag: tshad ni cha chen gcig tu 'dod: chos 'khor la ni cha phran bzhi: gnyis 'das gnyis dang bzhi 'das bzhi: bskor ba klong gur ri mo 'byung : ka zur mun pa cha chung re: glang gur mun pa cha chung gsum: cha chung bzhi cha kha rgyan bskor:

mun pa'i skor tshad sgo yi mtshams: ka rgyan steng nas za ra tshags: gyen bskor sna tshogs rdo rje 'byung : padma rdo rwa cha phran re: dur khrod me ri cha chen re: rtsig pa lnga ldan cha chung gcig: 'dod snam dmar po cha chung re: pha gu ser po cha chung gcig: mun nag drwa dkar cha chung gnyis: sham bu sngon po cha chung gcig: mda' yab mchod rten cha chung gcig: ka ba phyogs mtshon ka rgyan mdzes: lcam dang rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog: rta babs sa chu me rlung bzhi: ser sngon dmar ljang cha chung re: ka gdan mdzes tshon cha chung re: chos 'khor ser po cha chung gnyis: char kheb nyi zla cha chung re: de ltar zhib tu rim par gdab: de nas tshon gyi tshom bu ni: dkyil 'khor nang dbus mu khyud gcig bskor nas: de dbus zla gam dmar po sgo gcig nang : tshe lha'i tshom bu dmar gsal blug: zla gam sgo yang dbang chen dmar: ljang sngon dkar ser dmar ljang ngo : dkar ser dmar ljang dkar dmar blug: sgo ba bzhi po phyogs mdog byed: de ltar tshe sgrub chen mo'o: tshe sgrub rnam gsum dang : bla ma zhi drag gshin rje rta mgrin sogs la lha gnas gzhung so so nas 'byung ba ltar 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /drug pa rgyan 'god pa ni/ dkyil 'khor steng khri rim gsum mam gnyis yod pa'i 'og mar rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ bdag bskyed mchod gtor logs gang bder bzhag /bka' brgyad yang dag phur pa lta bu khyad chos can yin pa'i sgrub rdzas spyi tsam du sku gzugs tsakli rgyud dam gzhung pod/ sngags byang*/ rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan shel rdo bcas sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa zhi drag so so'i sgrub pa'i gtor chen sman raka /tshe 'brang tshe ril tshe chang mda' dar myang grol sgrub pa dang 'brel na ril bu bum pa/ bye brag tu zhi drag gang yin gyi gzhung so so nas bshad pa'i sgrub rdzas khyad par can dmigs bsal du 'byung ba rnams dgod/
