zhi rgyas dbang drag dang bka' gter srung ma'i gtor ma/ dbang rdzas tshang ma dkyil 'khor rgyan rdzas sogs ci 'byor ba stegs bu'i steng du dgod/ 'di yan nyin dang po'i bya ba'o/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i bar song nas stong tshig 'bul/ dngos sta sbrel ba dang sta gon nyin gcig gi dbang du byas na gong du song ba'i 'thus so/ /slar 'dzab dbyangs bya ba'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyis dril spos 'dzin pas thog drangs rten sgrub mchod pa'i rdzas rnams thogs pa'i ser sbreng gis dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ mdun du 'khod de dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: yi dam mchod cing dngos grub blang ba dang : dam can dgyes bskang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bkod pa ni: bum pa bzang po lha yi gzhal yas khang : dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyan du che: sman raka gtor bcas rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang : gdugs dang bla bre rgyal mtshan ba dan dang : mda' dang gri dang tshon skud drwa bas 'brel: dar sham smad dkris dur khrod rdzas mchog bkram: mthun pa'i rdzas mchog dgyes pa'i dkor cha sogs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru yongs rdzogs gsal: zhes dang*/ 'bul tshig rgyas par spro na/ dang po dbus su lcags kyi mañdzi'am pa tra rim pa gsum du 'dod par bya/ padmas mtshon pa'i pa tra rim pa gsum bya/ stegs 'og mar rnam rgyal bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba mgul chings dar dmar rigs lnga me long dkyil 'khor mtshon pa thod chang kha dar gyis bcad pa/ gzung rdor sgro mdangs phyogs bzhir re re'am/ stegs bar mar dbang chen gyi chas cha lag gam bdag 'jug gi dbang rdzas mda' dar mtshan tshang bcas sgrub rten dgod/ stegs gong mar sgrub gtor rgyan bzang tsakli'am sku 'bag dar dmar gdugs bcas bsham/ gzhung las/ khye'u pha ma 'dzoms pa yi:

bkra shis sha mtshan legs pa gnyis: bum pa bre gsum shong tsam la: gu gul bdug cing bgegs bskrad nas: phrin las yi dam phyogs dag gi: chu mig mang ba'i chu sna rnams: khye'u pho yi blugs byas shing : khye'u mo yi bum pa rten: chu mig rnams su 'bru sna mchod: dri bzang skye bdun bum rdzas btab: sngags 'di bzlas shing bkram par bya: zhes dang*/ om̐ hūm̐ pū dzaḥ.a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bhrūm̐: bum pa mi dmigs chos sku'i mkha': bdud rtsi yi dam ngo bor gsal: de nas sku rten bkram zhing*/ om̐ dharma he ru ka siddhi dzaḥ hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog ngo bo nyid: gang 'dul der ston ngang du gsal: de nas gnam rgyan dang cod pan la sogs mang du bkram zhing*/ om̐ ma la dharma siddhi pra bha me gha hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs 'phan dar mkha' la bris: ngo mtshar rnam bkra bkod pa rgya cher gyur: de nas bhandha ril bu'am sman sgrub la/ om̐ ga la bāai ṣañdza āḥhūm̐: chos nyid sna tshogs rang byung ye shes rdzas: dug lnga sel ba'i dam rdzas mchog tu gsal: me long sindhu ra byugs te: chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su hūm̐ rtsibs drug la ha ri ni sa siddhi dza bri: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: me long dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: byad dang 'char sgo ma 'gags gsal: de nas dung chu dang sgro mdangs la: om̐ badzra dharma ha ri ni sa ta pra ra ṇi ta paṃ pra siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje dung dmar thabs shes tshul: ku sha sgro mdangs sku lnga gsal: de nas rigs lnga la: om̐ hrīḥswā āḥhāḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tam̐' he badzra hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo rigs kyi bdag: ye shes lnga yi ngo bor gsal: de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: dharma pa ti swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: ye shes gsal ba lam me ba: ma 'gags zang thal de bzhin gsal: de nas phreng ba thogs la: om̐ kha li ta bha la pra dzñā hūm̐:

hūm̐: gzungs sngags phreng ba skye ba'i mchog: sgra grags tshangs dbyangs de ltar gsal: snying po shog dril 'khor lo la: om̐ hrī dha ā dharma tsakra bhya hoḥ hūm̐: theg pa chen po'i ngang tshul can: spro bsdu sngags zer rnam par gsal: de nas phyag mtshan rdo rje phur pa la: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya hrīḥdha hūm̐: hūm̐: khro rgyal las kyi phyag mtshan ldan: phrin las ngo bo so sor gsal: rgyal mtshan la/ om̐ ma ṇi tshandho rasmi hoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor legs par brgyan: tog bcas lha mi'i mdzes rgyan gyur: drwa ba la: om̐ dharma dhi shi garbha hūm̐ baṃ: hūm̐: chos sku'i drwa bas ma rig gzhom: khro bo'i stag sham 'khor yug gsal: ral gri la: om̐ khaḍga bhañdza hoḥ hūm̐: shes rab ral gris nyon mongs gzhom: dkyil 'khor bar chad srung bar gsal: mda' gzhu la: om̐ dharma na ṇa pa tsa hoḥ hūm̐: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don dang ldan: bden gnyis rgyu rkyen ngang la gsal: me long la: om̐ sa ma ya a darsha hoḥ hūm̐: mdzes rgyan gsal ldan drwa ba'i gzugs: dkyil 'khor sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur gsal: cod pan la: om̐ pra bha pañtsa mu ku ṭa hoḥ hūm̐: 'od zer dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: cod pan dam tshig lnga ldan gsal: phur pa bzhi la: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya pra be sha ya phaiṃ: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rang byung rig rtsal nyid: rtog med phur pas nga bdag bsgral: nyi zla cha bzhi la: om̐ sūrya tsand+ra pra bha hoḥ hūm̐: sna tshogs snang stong ye nas dag: pho brang phyi dang nang gsal lo: kha ṭwāṃ la: om̐ kā ya tra ma tri shu la hoḥ hūm̐: dbyings nas sku gsum ngang gis rdzogs: rtse gsum sgo gsum bag chags bsal: bdud rtsi la: om̐ a mṛ ta pañtsa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ hūm̐: rang byung bdud rtsi bla med rdzas: rigs lnga yab yum ngo bor gsal: gtor ma la: om̐ bha lingta pha la hoḥ hūm̐: dam tshig dngos grub 'byung ba'i rten: bla med rdzas mchog kun 'byung gsal:

rakta la: om̐ rakta dzwa la hrīḥṭhaḥ hūm̐: dmar chen gsang ba'i rdzas mchog bcud: 'khor 'das bsgral ba'i rakta gsal: dbang po lnga la: om̐ a bhi pañtsa le hoḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i dbang po lnga: sku lnga lhun grub rdzas su gsal: phyi mchod la: om̐ badzra a haṃ pū dza sa mu dra āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon lha mo'i gar: brda rtags sbyor sgrol mchod pa gsal: tshogs rdzas la: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra hoḥ hūm̐: rnam dag bla med mchod pa'i rdzas: blang dor bral ba'i rdzas su gsal: ḍā ma ru la: om̐ ḍā ma ru la ka hoḥ hūm̐: thod pa ltag sprod las kyi rgya rtags can: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i rdzas su gsal: rdo rje la: om̐ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rtags las: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i gzung thag dam par gsal: dril bu la: hrīḥmu gu lanta ka hoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan par sgra sgrogs pa'i: grags stong rgyud bskul 'bod pa'i rdzas su gsal: gling bu la: om̐ badzra waṃ sya ni we hi: hūm̐: dbyangs snyan lha mo brda gar dgyes pa'i rdzas: bung ba bcud ltar sngags sgra'i rnam par gsal: rkang gling la: om̐ gha dhe shang kha sa hoḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor srung ba'i dam can 'bod pa'i rdzas: tser tser lhang lhang ngar ldan sgra ru gsal: rnga la: om̐ dharma shabda pañtsa hoḥ hūm̐: chos sgra lnga ldan sgrog pa'i bzang mo ste: dbyings nas rgyud bskul rang bzhin brda ru gsal: rnga lcag la: om̐ badzra muṃ mant+ra hoḥ hūm̐: rgyud bskul bde chen kun bzang rdo rje'i gzugs: bskul phyir spyod pa dgyes pa'i rdzas su gsal: zangs dung la: om̐ badzra sa ma shaṃ kha hoḥ hūm̐: sgra grags 'ber chen ba spu cher g.yo ba: thugs dam byin 'bebs nyams 'phel rdzas su gsal: cha lang la: om̐ badzra shabda ma hoḥ hūm̐: sgra chen rdzas chang bla med sbyor ba'i mdangs: chem chem g.yo zhing 'bod pa'i rdzas su gsal: bgrang phreng la: om̐ bhandha me la dha ri ta hoḥ

hūm̐: drag sngags 'dren phyir bzung ba'i 'od zer can: brda rtags tshad 'dzin snang ngor bgyis te gsal: sgo 'byed phyag cha la: om̐ badzra aṃ ku sha pā sha spho ṭa ghandhe hoḥ hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i phyag mtshan sgo ma bzhi: rang rtags ngo bo 'byed pa'i rdzas su gsal: steng sgo'i gnam rgyan la: om̐ badzra ma la he ru hūm̐: hūm̐: stong nyid nam mkha'i bde stong brdal khyab phub: steng phyogs 'gyur med de bzhin ngang gis gsal: sa rgyan nam g.yang gzhi la: om̐ bhū mi pa ti ru tsa tur hoḥ hūm̐: ye nas dbang chen sa gzhi phyal gyis khyab: g.yang gzhi gdan rigs rnams kyang de bzhin gsal: de nas gos kyi rigs la/ om̐ dharma la sha thi ka hoḥ hūm̐: phyi nang rgyan rdzogs phun sum tshogs pa'i chas: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bzung ba'i rdzas su gsal: 'thung snod bhandha gang rigs la: om̐ sa ma bhandha ka ra hoḥ hūm̐: deng nas 'dod yon sna lnga'i longs spyod sogs: sgrub pa phyi nang bral ba'i ngang la gsal: sgrub pa'i grogs la: om̐ badzra ma hā u pa ka hoḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi nang sgrub pa'i grogs kyi mchog: khol dang gzungs sogs pho nya'i rnam par gsal:

mchod pa spyi la: om̐ badzra ma hā me gha he pra tītstsha hūm̐: hūm̐: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor phyi nang la 'khod pa'i: rdzas dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs par gsal: zhes dang dkyil 'khor du dgos pa'i cha lag rnams dang : phyi nang gi yo byad gang yin yang om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsum tsam gyis byin gyis ma brlab par mi bzhag /dbyangs dang zhi rol bcas bya zhing sgrub rdzas rnams las slob sogs kyis nor 'khrul med cing bag dro lhun chags dwang ba 'dren par dgod/ dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhung gang yin pas bsgrub pa'i rdzas kyi gtso bo thod pa rnam bum myang grol bum pa sogs khri'u'i khar dgod/ gdan khri gong mar sku gsung thugs rten/ rgyab ngos su bye brag gi gtor chen rgyan spros can dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rwa'i steng khro bcu'i phur pa/ mtha' skor shar du mchod yon nas brtsam ste nyer spyod mtshams 'dzin bcas/ phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mtshams bzhi mda' dar me long can bzhi btsugs pa tshon skud kyi drwa bas sbrel/ gzhan yang zur bzhir rgyal mtshan logs bzhir 'phan dar gyi drwa phyed sogs so so'i phyag len las byung ba ltar mdzes brjid chags pa dang*/ steng na dar gyi gdugs phub/ gsham du stag gzig gi sgab dkris kyis bskor/ dkyil 'khor mdun rgyab gang bder mchod gtor kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa'i g.yon du chos gter srung ma spyi dang*/ bye brag gi gtor 'bul chad brtan rgyun bzhag rgyun gso'i chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar phyi mchod brgya rtsa sogs yod na mtha' skor stegs bu rim pa can la go rim ma 'dzur bar bkod/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin 'bul rgyu'i chos skyong gi gtor spungs chad mdo brtan ma tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mtshon phrin las la dgos pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor byang phyogs su lcags snod du nyul le'i liṅga dang las phur phur stegs bcas yungs dkar sogs thun rdzas rnams kyang 'du bya/

slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsams te nang mchod/ rdor dril/ las bum/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog snod rnams bzhag /mchod pa rnams la spyi khyab tu/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phros/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo? zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mkha' khyab tu spel bar bya'o/ /bdun pa tshogs sgrub kyi las la 'jug rung gi bya ba sgrub pa po rnams mnga' gsol zhing gnas su dgod pa ni/ las kyi rdo rje'i thod chang yar bzed nas tshig gis bstun so so la drang ba sogs lag len ltar byas la/ rgyal thebs kyis stong thun sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len gyis/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dug lnga rtsad gcod dngos grub kun 'byung gnas: ston pa'i sgron mer mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes dang rgyal tshab la: hūm̐: bla ma'i gdung 'tshob sku gsung thugs kyi sras: dam chos char 'bebs tshe dang dngos grub spel: dbang bskur phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa: rgyal tshab ston par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: yum la: gnyis med bde skyed mtshan nyid rab tu bzang : kun bzang yum du mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdo rje las par: phrin las gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad: rdo rje karmar mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: ging la: bar gcod bgegs bsgral gzugs phung lha la stob: rdo rje ging mchog mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: mtshams par: phyi nang mtshams gcod bar chad thams cad srungs: rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: spyan par: dngos grub bgegs gnyis dus dang drod tshad mkhyen: rdo rje spyan par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: dus mtshams par: phrin las skabs sbyor dus 'dzin nam tshod mkhas:

rdo rje dus mtshams mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: phyag tshang par: phud gtsang g.yos mkhas phyi nang bya byed mkhas: rdo rje phyag tshang mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: byin por: gsal dag dzap mkhas dad ldan brtson par bzhugs: gser phreng mched lcam mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdul phyags pa la: kun gyi bka' sgrub phyi yi nyul le skrod: rdul phyags skyes bur mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes so sor mnga' gsol zhing rang gral du 'khod pa las nam yang ma 'khrugs par bya'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis zhal bkod gdab pa ni: hūm̐: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon rgyal tshab gzungs ma dang : rdo rje karma ging mchog mtshams pa dang : spyan ma phyag tshang rdo rje rdul phyags pa: rdo rje gser phreng la sogs mched dang lcam: rang rang gral bzhugs bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gyis: tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas bya ba yi: byang chub sgrub la gsang ba'i lam mchog 'dir: sngon sbyangs tshogs bsags 'bras bu dus 'dir smin: da res sgrub mchog 'dir bzhugs skal pa bzang : tshe 'di blos thong sgrub la snying rus bskyed: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ngo e ma hoḥ zhi khro'i rigs sogs la de'i rjes 'brel du chas su zhugs shing rtags gdab dgos pas chas rnams las rdor sogs kyis thogs/ rgyal tshab pas stong thun sngon du 'gro ba'i dbyangs bor len tshul gyis zhi chas la: hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder gshegs dngos su gsal: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bur ldan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rab tu spras: dri mchog ngad ldan brgyan pa po: 'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes: khro chas la: hūm̐: don dam spros med sgyu ma'i khong gseng nas: ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i dbu rgyan gsol:

'khor ba ma spangs mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: skye 'chi rtsad gcod thal chen tshom bu gsol: sku gsum lhun grub thod phreng tshar gsum gsol: cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: ma rig nags sreg ye shes me dpung gsol: zhing bcu yongs sgrol dpal gyi chas bcu 'di: dbang phyug chen po'i sku la rgyan du bzhes: zhes rjes zlos dang bcas tshig dang bstun nas dpal gyi chas rnams las kyi rdo rjes rgyal tshab par rim par phul la/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs thams cad kyi gnas so sor bgo zhing brgyan pa'i tshul bya'o/ /brgyad pa brda sbyar ba ni/ brda sgo brda phyag las gzhung du yod pa'i rigs la de nyid 'dir sbyar/ rang gzhung du med pa sogs la/ hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das gdod ma nas: rnam dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing : ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin sgrib g.yogs sgo: rang rig brda yis dbye bar bya: bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brda sgo dbye/ hūm̐: khams gsum ye nas rang byung ba'i: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid: brda dang gar gyis mtshon nas kyang : gnyis su med par phyag bgyi'o: a la la hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes brda phyag 'tshal/ shin tu bsdu na gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i sgo glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas bcad pa rig pa ye shes kyi brda mjal bas lhag ge phye bar bsams la/ bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brda sgo dbye/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ci ltar shar yang rang rig las gud du med pa'i gnas lugs chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur rtogs pas/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes brda phyag 'tshal ba tsam gyis kyang grub bo/ /dgu pa bsre bsnan bya ba ni/ skabs 'dir dbang ma thob pa'i mched gsar bu rnams dkyil 'khor byang shar lta bu logs su phye/ slob dpon gyi mdun rdor dril bdud rtsi yungs thun sogs bkod nas/

las byang bdud rtsi byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ sman mchod khā hi bcas bya/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag nyid las kyi dpal chen he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ya las lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa 'phros: de las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas slob bu'i sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par gyur: par bsam zhing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra yakṣa kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla zhing yungs thun gyis brab/ las byang ltar bka' sgo bgegs bskrad brjod/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pa rol mo sogs 'cham rngam gyis bgegs bskrad gsar bu rnams kyi rgyud sbyang ba'i phyir rjes zlos byar gzhug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing sa la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba re yod par bsgom: byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rdo rje'i lce thog tu lan gsum bzhag nas/ hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang : byang chub sems dang rdo rje 'dzin: de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa: de dag la ni snying ring na: rdo rje yaksha gnod sbyin gyis: khyod kyi snying la zhugs te 'thung : snying la yang dag gnas pa'o: 'di ni sems can dmyal ba'i chu: dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed: dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub:

ces bdud rtsi byin pas slob mas kyang*/ i dante na ra kan sa ma ya yakṣa hūm̐: zhes myong la snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim nas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo/ /'dres gral bsnan pa'i rgyal tshab pas bdud rtsi g.yon skor du gsar rnying thams cad la bran zhing*/ gtso sngags dzap dbyangs lan gsum mjug tu 'jam rol dang bcas pas bdud rtsi myong nas thams cad kyis/ om̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: āḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba: rdo rje'i mi phyed gsung dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: ā sarba ta thā ga ta wākka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: zhes dang slob dpon gyis/ deng phyin chad mched gsar rnying thams cad skal pa mnyam zhing dam tshig gcig tu 'dus pa yin pas dam tshig gzhung bzhin du bsrung bar gyis shig: ces bsgo/ thams cad kyi phyag thal sbyar gyi bar me tog bzung nas: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang : dam tshig 'brel ba'i mched dang lcam dral gyis: sgrub mchog rnams su byin gyis brlabs pa yi: bka' drin rjes su dran phyir gtang rag gtong : zhes drin lan gyi me tog 'thor/ de nas rdo rje'i gral du bzhag pa ni/ mched gsar pa rnams rang rang gral du 'khod nas/ phyag thal sbyar bar me tog bzung la/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang : bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi bstan cing bsgrub pa dang : yi dam lha tshogs 'dzab bsnyen bgrang ba'i phyir:

dam tshig rdo rje'i gral du mchis par gnang : zhes brjod cing mched gsar pa rnams rang gral du 'khod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'du 'bral med pa'i gzung thag la: dam tshig srog gis bsdus pa'i mched dang lcam: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod de dam tshig gi bslab bya rgyas par bya/ de nas thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ om̐ ma hā badzra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje thugs kar gsor ba dang*/ om̐ badzra ghaṇḍe hūm̐: zhes dril bu dkrol zhing dkur brten/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: zhes thugs kar 'khyud rgya byas la dril bu dkrol ba dang*/ rol chen brgya brdung sogs/ rol mo'i sgra cher bsgrag go /bcu pa lha bstim zhing byin dbab pa ni/ rang gral nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhengs la/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon nas rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs par bsam rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: spros med rtog bral mkha' dbyings dag pa nas: skye med rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba: 'gro don rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yab yum sras 'khor bcas: stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi: sprul pa dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: zhes dang gtso 'khor sngags mthar/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhanaḥ zhes btags pa brjod/ gong du sta gon byas nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa de nyid dkyil 'khor la bstims par mos/ bsdu na spyan 'dren bskos gdab 'dir ma byas kyang chog go byin dbab pa ni/ 'brel dang byin rlabs che ba nyang gter bde 'dus las 'byung ba ltar na/ sgrub pa po rnams zhwa chos sogs gzi byin bskyed de dkyil 'khor la bskor/ dar sna'i g.yab mo sogs dang spos dud dbyangs rol bcas tshig bdun gyis sna drangs te/

hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po'i bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ gzhung gang yin gyi byin 'bebs 'dir bya: zhes mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te/ gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas/ sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de/ 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum mthar ye shes pa brtan pa'i phyir me tog 'thor ba ni/

hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: rten 'brel dam tshig rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la: brtan par bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'grub par gyur cig badzra sa ma ya: om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor zhing rgyas gdab brtan pa'i dmigs pa yang yang bya: bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon rgyun spyod sogs byas pas grub bo/ /nye bar bsnyen pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang yin te 'og nas 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa dngos la gsum/ 'dzab dgongs bzlas pas dngos grub sgrub pa de'i bar gcod bsal ba/ dus grangs rtags tshad kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phrin las dang 'brel dgos pas rtsa gsum gang sgrub kyi las gzhung nyid dang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug /'bring nyin lan gnyis mtshan lan gnyis te dus bzhi/ tha mas kyang nyin mtshan gnyis la tshar re bsrang dgos pas/ las gzhung mang nyung dang bstun la/ rab 'bring gnyis gang bder lag tu blangs te/ thun dang po la rnam 'joms nas bzung*/ theg chen dgu ldan/ gnas ri so dgu/ gsol 'debs shlau ka kha shas nas brgyud 'debs skyabs sems nas brtsam sngon 'gro rnams rgyas par btang*/ dang po dmigs bsal can ma gtogs ting 'dzin gsum gyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgoms la ye shes 'khor lor bstim zhing mchod bstod bya/ bzlas pa'i dbang bskur dzap khang phyes te gzung thag blangs la/ dzap dbyangs lan gsum/ bdag mdun dbyer med sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag mdun gnyis kyang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa gsung mi ched du bya dgos so/ /thun pa rnams kyis kyang grub na lha'i rgyun khyer lta bu'i mngon rtogs la gsal gdab la sngags rgyun blang*/ de nas bzung grol nyin tha ma'i bar sngags sgra skad cig kyang ma chad par bya/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams kyis lhag chad kha bkang zhing nus pa brtan par byas la stong tshig phul nas thun dang po grub/

gnyis pa la mchod kha gsos la brgyud 'debs nas bzung las byang 'bring po dang*/ bsdus pa gsang sgrub lta bu'i bsnyen pa yan mthar chags su btang*/ stong tshig phul/ rgyal chen kha gso zur gsal ltar bya/ nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa la/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor byang shar du slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs/ mdun du hoṃ khung nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/ las phur thun rdzas rnams dgod la rten bskyed pa ni/ e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ sogs nas lus can du gyur par bsams la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud? sogs mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ drag sngags phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab/ khyad par ging chen bcu gnyis bskul ba ni/ gser skyems dang gtor ma bsham/ gri sha'am sha chen gyis gsur btang lag tu rdo thun dang gri lpags g.yab cing*/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: ma 'di ni gnas chen bye? sogs dzwa la raṃ: zhes thun brdeg cing me zor ram me bshor btang zhing byin 'bebs byas pas thun gnyis pa grub/ thun gsum pa yang de dang mtshungs la bzlas pa stong tshig bcas grub pa dang*/ bka' gter srung ma'i gtor chog so so nas 'byung ba dang*/ tshogs mchod skong ba tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btson du 'dzin/ bskul ba chos skyong gtor 'bul dang las gzhung chad brtan rta bro bya/ tshe sgrub rang rang gzhung du yod na dang*/ med na spyir btang du 'di ltar byas pas 'thus so/ /mda' dar g.yab bzhin 'di skad do/ /tshe zan bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥlas tshe dpag med dkar po tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis bskor bar gyur/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa 'gugs bstim/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku gsum bdag nyid dbyings nas bzhengs: snang srid kun gyi tshe khug la:

deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la stsol: hūm̐: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba chu yi bcud bsdus la: mā ma kī yis tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba sa yi bcud bsdus la: sangs rgyas spyan mas tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba me yi bcud bsdus la: gos dkar mo yis tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba rlung gi bcud bsdus la: dam tshig sgrol mas tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: sems kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: 'byung ba nam mkha'i bcud bsdus la: dbyings phyug ma yis tshe stsol cig: mi 'gyur mi shigs brtan par mdzod: de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus nas bum nang du bskyil bar gyur: om̐ ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐ hūm̐: ci nus bzla/ mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya/ nongs bshags dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum gsum brjod/ brtan bzhugs rang rang gzhung las gsal ba'am/ spyi ltar du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol: khyad par du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du rdul tshon yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du mchan/ de srid du brtan par bzhugs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol: om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes 'bru 'thor/ shis brjod bcas grub nas mun rub tsam du nyul le bskrad nas byin 'bebs dzap dbyangs lan gsum bcas grol lo/

/mtshan thun gsum por 'don 'grig nyin thun gnyis pa dang mtshungs la thun mjug so sor nyul le bskrad gzir dang*/ byin 'bebs ma chad par bya'o/ /'byor mkhos can gyi spros pa rgyas par byed na nyams chag bskang ba'i phyir dong sprugs skong ba'i cho ga 'chi med kyi dngos grub spel ba'i phyir tshe chog go /bar chad bsal ba'i phyir rdo rje mtshams pa rnams zur du bzhag nas so so'i rang gzhung las 'byung ba'am/ spyi tsam du rdor sems bla ma longs sku tshe dpag med rnam bzhi/ gu ru drag po gshin rje sogs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten te so so'i phrin las bya ba ni gzhung don dang 'brel ba gal che'o/ /rgyud las/ 'khor la bka' bsgo dge sbyong bskul/ /zhes khyad par du gsungs pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis sgrub mchod rnams skabs skabs su blang dor gyi bslab bya dang dam tshig bshad nas/ bskyed bzlas kyi dmigs pa go sla don 'dus bshad grub na gal che'o/ gnyis pa dngos grub la bar du gcod pa bsal cing byin rlabs gzi byin dbab pa ni/ slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs mdun du hoṃ khung du/ nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/ las phur thun rdzas rnams dgod la/ rten bskyed pa ni: e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ: brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i log par lta ba'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rid kyang nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur par bsams la: na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang : ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par 'chi med mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa'i lha tshogs dbang chen he ru ka bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang :

bden pa chen po'i mthu la rten nas dngos grub la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyi 'gugs gzhug byas la/ phur thun tshom bur bskor ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad khro gtum skur bstan pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: drag po'i lha tshogs dus la bab: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyu 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pa thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces drag sngags phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab khyad par dpal gyi pho nya kun thabs rgyal mo'i bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'gyed: bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug: bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams: rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa sreg: bskal pa'i 'brug sgra snyan nas 'brug stong sgrogs: lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la me chen 'bar: ba spu gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chung char 'bebs shing : zhabs kyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir:

ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: shin tu mi bzod gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: srin mo'i snying 'byin changs par bcug nas gsol: shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan: bdud la bab na snying khrag dron mo gsol: srin la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod: dgra la bab na dug gi kha chus 'debs: bgegs la bab na rus pa rdul du rlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying sregs: dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlog: hūm̐ gru bu gru bu a pa tse: ru pa tse: na ra tse: tsa me thun thun: nā sha ya: na sha satwaṃ bha ya: yakṣa byi na: yakṣa byi na: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: tsitta rbad nan: om̐ sumbha ni? om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya prā ma rā dza trig nan: dha na rakṣa rbud ling : tri'u tri'u ma ma na ya sho na dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag sngags spos rol dang khyad par gyi dbang phyug pas brdeg cing thun gyis brab/ nyul le bskrad gzir rgyas pa 'di bzhin mi lcogs pa la'ang thun snga ma tsam gyis mjug tu stabs bde byed na/ dzap kyi stong tshig gi rjes su rdo rje mtshams pas gu gul dud pa dang thun brab ste dkyil 'khor bskor la drag sngags so lnga pa dang*/ om̐ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya badzra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bighnān kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sder mo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas tshar bcad la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ /de ma thag dngos grub ster ba'i lha 'byung bas byin rlabs dgos par gsungs pas chas sogs sngon bshad ltar byas la byin 'bebs brjod cing dzap dbyangs lan gsum du gyer ro/

/gsum pa tshang ma dus grangs rtags gsum las/ dus smin slob la zla ba drug /mos blos kyi dbang du mdzad na zla ba gcig gam/ zhag po bdun nam nyin zhag gsum gyi mthar brten par bsgrubs pas kyang*/ dus dang dbang po dang mthun par dngos grub ci rigs pa thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /grangs dang rtags ni gsang ba spyi dang so so'i gzhung las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gal te rtags tshad ngan pa byung na nyul le sprad/ rta bro brdung dam sel ltas byung na yig brgya bzla zhing bshags rgyud bklag /grib mi gtsang pa la rnam 'joms sme brtsegs saugs kyi bum khrus bya/ rtags tshad bzang ngan gang la yang re dogs dgag sgrub med par dbyings su bsre ba gnad yin/ dngos grub kyi ltas bzang nges pa can byung na de nyid du rgyun gyi dngos grub smin pa gnad du che bas/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba mdun du bzhag hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs: lha yi dge bsnyen dam ldan thams cad kyis: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe dang chos dang phrin las rnam bzhi dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes nus mthu dang : srid nor zas dang 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol: a la la hoḥ zhes brjod la bdud rtsi myang ngo*/ /gsum pa bsgrubs nas dngos grub blang ba sgrub pa chen po'i las rim ni/ dang po sbyor sgrol la bsten pa yin kyang mos slob kyi skabs su rdzas la bsten nas blang pa la gsum/ dngos grub kyi rdzas bshams pa/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro/ cho ga dngos so/ sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring dgong thun nas dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas bshams te/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gzhi dkar po'i steng du gro yi g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil du bris pa'i dbus su rin po che snod 'bru bzang gi phye ma mngar gsum dang*/

zho mar 'o mas sbrus pa'i nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs dang*/ phyogs bzhi las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas bza' bca' sna tshogs pas bskor ba/ g.yas su mngar gsum thud dang bsres pa'i ril bu dang*/ g.yon du bhandha bzang por 'bru bcud bdud rtsi a mṛ ta btab pa'ang bsham/ dgong thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bebs par gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags sham du/ kā ya wākka tsitta gu ṇa karma siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya tsam bzla/ phyir nang thor thun phrin las gzhung bsrangs te/ bzlas pa kha skong stong tshig bcas grub nas bsnyen rgyun snga ma grol/ dngos grub blang ba'i sngags btags pa rgyun bsnyen gtor bsngo tshogs mchod sogs rgyas par byed/ tshogs tha ma'i skabs nyul le'i liṅga mer bsreg la/ chos skyong gtor ma bstab/ yang phyag len phal mo cher dngos grub kyi rdzas de nang rang du bsham/ snga nub dmigs bzlas 'di mi byed pa'ang yod pas long skabs dang bstun chog /gnyis pa dngos grub la mi dbang ba'i lta ngan gyi bgegs tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ las byang ltar bgegs bskrad cing drag sngags phur thun sogs 'tsham rngam byas la srung 'khor bsgom/ spos rol g.yab cing byin dbab/ spyi bshags ye shes sku mchog lta bu brjod la 'khon bcugs sbyang*/ gsum pa dngos grub bskul ba ni/

lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrang : bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mthar ru phyin: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yis: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐: dngos grub bstsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang : bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje dang : tshogs lam sbyor lam gnas pa'i rig 'dzin dang : bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rnams kyis zhal bzhes ltar: sgrub mchog bdag la sngon gyi smon lam mthus: tshe dang chos dang las bzhi lhun grub dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : srid dang zas nor mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar rtse gcig thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyam sbyor ba'i: sbyor mtshams 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'gro drug sems can rgyud sbyang mkha' khyab kyi: bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dgyes par bskyed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: dngos grub tshur bsdus bdag dang sgrub rdzas la: thim pas 'chi med bdud rtsi dwangs ma che: dngos grub kun gyi snying po 'khyil bar gyur: zhes gsal btab la bsnyen sgrub lha sngags sham bur/ kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu ṇa siddhi trām̐: karma siddhi hrīḥ sarba lo ka dzñā na siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes btags pa stong phrag gam brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba bzlas la/ dngos grub thams cad 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pa bdag nyid gnas lngar thim par gyur/ skya rengs 'char kha dang bstun sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa sogs sgrub rdzas las rdor gyis btegs la dngos grub len pa ni/

hrīḥ ye shes lus can 'gran du med pa yi: gzi brjid sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshangs pa'i dbyangs la chos kyi char chen 'beb: nus pa sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gzungs dran ting 'dzin mkhyen brtse yongs kyi gzhi: 'od gsal snying po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bum pa bzang : 'dod 'byung gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gdul bya so so'i mos pa ji bzhin du: thogs med 'jug pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: srung dang zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs: thun mong las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mkha' spyod ril bu mig sman rkang mgyogs sogs: khyad par grub pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshe dang yo byad 'dod rgur bsgyur la sogs: phyi nang dbang bcu'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mthong thos dran rig gdul bya smin cing grol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung so so nas 'byung ba'i dngos grub bskul tshig bcas kyi mthar sngags brjod pas gnas gsum du bzhag /rdzas rnams bza' btung byas te longs spyod pas/ stan thog de nyid du dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag gi tshul du thob par bsams la/ dgongs pa'i gdeng bzung ngo*/ /gzhan don dbang bskur na rgyas bsdus gang yin pa skabs 'dir sbrel lo/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa mtha' rgyas rjes kyi rim pa la gsum/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rjes chog phyi mtshams bkrol ba slob dpon la sku drin gsol zhing smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos grub blang ba kho na'am dbang bskur grub pa'i rjes su/ rnying ma spyi yi phyag bzhes ltar bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang las thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i phyir zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg skabs 'dir bya srol yod pas grub na gal che'o/ mchan/ /lhag chog btang zhing sngar btson du bzung ba'i lhag ma dang lhan cig sgrub khang lho nub gom pa bdun cu'i sar bskyal/

de nas gnas nyul gtor ma'i nang du sngar lhag ma'i ras mo cung tsam dang*/ gser skyems thogs la/ hūm̐: ging chen bcu gnyis gnas nyul ma mo 'bum: rnal 'byor stangs 'byed ting 'dzin drod nyul ma: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bya ba mtha' ru phyin: lhag ma dang ni gser skyems mchod pa 'bul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: om̐ dzñā na ghṛ wa kro ti satwaṃ bha lingta khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul nas/ badzra muḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs su de dag gi gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur 'bul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/ mdun bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa rnams ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram rten bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo dmigs bsal byed na spyi tsam du/ hūm̐: ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di: bla med sku gsung thugs su rgyas btab nas: bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel te: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra hrīḥ.āḥ mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: stong pa'i go cha bla na med: chos sku skye med rdo rje yin: mtshan ma'i spyod yul kun bcom nas: chos kyi dbyings su rgyas btab pas: sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na: gnod byed bgegs kyis ga la mthong : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badzra rakṣa rakṣa: om̐ badzra kā ya wākka tsitta hūm̐: zhes rgyas gdab bo/ /gnyis pa mtshams bkrol zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal tho bzhi la zlum gtor bzhi/ sgo byang gnyis la dmar gtor re re dang*/ phyi mchod bcas bsham/ phyi rol shar gyi tho rtsar phyin te/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngar ltar ram bsdu na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis brlab/

om̐ dhriṣṭa rāṣṭā ya ma hā bha lingta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: hūm̐: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : dri za grul bum tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs phyi yi dung sgo phyes: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: zhi ba'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas lho yi tho rtsar phyin la mchod gtor rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlabs la/ om̐ bai rū dha kā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ arghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje me lha'i tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs phyi yi gser sgo phyes: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: rgyas pa'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ bi ru pākṣā ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ arghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : srin po klu yi tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs phyi yi zangs sgo phyes: dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: dbang gi las rnams mthar phyin shog: badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ arghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: rlung lha dbang ldan tshogs dang bcas:

gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs phyi yi lcags sgo phyes: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: drag po'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ 'ga' zhig tu tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan bzhugs kyi srol yang snang ngo*/ de nas sgo byang phyi nang bkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor mchod gtor bsham/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ arghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: bar gyi sgo mtshams phye ru gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badzra muḥ zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu'o/ /'byung ba rnams bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: nyi zla rlung sa 'byung ba bzhi: de ring dkyil 'khor mtha' ru phyin: rgya yi gdams pa dkrol du gsol: 'byung ba rang byung mkha' la thim: zhes rgya bkrol la gser skyems mchod/ de nas nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kunḍa li i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ arghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mchog: yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs brtan du gsol: om̐ badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzraḥ me tog dang gser skyems dang bcas sgo byang bsdu'o/ de nas nang du phyin la slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pa dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod la/

de yang khro bcu'i phur pa bsdu ba ni/ om̐ badzra kī la ya utkī la ya badzra dha rod a dzñā pa ya te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: zhes lag gnyis skam pa'i rgya dang bcas/ dang po gdan rim las steng phyogs su phud de/ om̐ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ne sarba artha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don yid la byas te dril bu dkrol zhing*/ ā kā ro? sogs sngags brjod bzhin 'jam rol bcas ras bris sam dkyil 'khor bsdu'o/ /rang lugs ltar na/ om̐ swa bhā wa laṃ san te hoḥ zhes rdul tshon bsdu'o/ /gsum pa thog mar nongs bshags bya ba ni/ mched lcam rnams phan tshun du phyag byas la res mos tshul gyis/ hoḥ thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam dral te: bde bar gshegs pa'i slob ma dam mnos nas: kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshig la: mnyam nyid ngang las legs nyes dbyer med kyang : lus ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshul tsam du: gzhung las nyams shing thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: rnam dag bsam pas mi gnas tshig 'dis bshags: 'dzin med ngang du bzod par bzhes mdzod la: rang bzhin dag pa'i tshangs pa bstsal du gsol: a a āḥ de nas rdo rje slob dpon la gtang rag 'bul zhing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thams cad kyi phyag bya lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i blos/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal mchog ldan: gsung rab rgya mtshos lha mi 'dren pa'i dpal: yang dag don ston 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyobs: 'jig rten 'di na pha ma'i tshul du gnas: bka' drin bzang yang gnyen bkur rngo ma thog: sdom gsum bsrung bya dam tshig gang nyams kyang : nyes ltung sgrib par mi 'gyur 'dag bya'i phyir: mthol bshags bzod par gsol gyis tshangs par stsol: zhes zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bla ma spyi gtsug tu 'bral med bzung ngo*/ /nongs bshags dang bka' drin gsol ba gnyis so/ /spro bsdus skabs ma byas kyang chog go

/de nas smon lam spyi ltar gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ kye hoḥ mi gnas ye shes chos kyi dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos lhun grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog: 'di lta bu yi dkyil 'khor rtag tu brtson: bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang : lu gu rgyud kyi 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams: 'bral med dag pa'i zhing du 'tshogs par smon: bla med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob bar: sa lam mthar phyin 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: sku gsum ye shes lnga la spyod par shog: ces rtse gcig pas yid kyis smon lam gdab/ khyad par mar me'i smon lam bya ba ni/ thams cad kyis lag g.yas su mar me dang g.yon du spos ring thogs la/ rgyal thebs pas stong thun sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len byas te/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyis dbu mdzad nas: dam tshig ldan pa'i mched dang lcam dral rnams: deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'khyams shog: gcong rong zab mo'i gnas su mi skye dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar gnas su mi ltung zhing : gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags shing : mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis mi phog shog: rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin che ba dang : mtshan ldan gzungs ma rdo rje mched lcam rnams: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos 'chi ba'i dus bzung tshe: ma rig dbang gis 'khor bar ltung srid na: snang gsal mar mes ma rig sdug bsngal sel: nyon mongs dbang gis rigs drug gnas 'khyams na: snang gsal mar mes 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel: rgyu mchog 'di yi sa bcu yongs sgrol te:

shes bya'i sgrib sbyangs phyir mi ldog par shog: snang gsal go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di: bde gshegs yongs la phul ba'i mthu byin gyis: sa bcu 'das te sa rnams yongs non shog: kun tu 'od dang ma chags padma'i spyan: 'khor lo tshogs chen stug po bkod pa'i sa: de wa ko sha kun bzang dbyer med sa: rdo rje sems ming lcang lo can gyi gnas: bla ma'i sa dang srid gsum gzhi rdzogs sa: rtsod bral lhun po'i sa la thig le yi: sa lam 'gro rnams ma lus lhun bgrod nas: gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don yongs rdzogs shog: ces dang rang lugs bka' brgyad kyi mar me smon lam gnyis gang bde bya'o/ /gzhan yang spro na theg pa chen po spyi dang khyad par rgya cher gdab pas/ dus gnyan pa'i phyir 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas zhal nas gsung ba'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs las so sor 'byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par spel la/ me tog gi char du bsnyil te/ rol mo snyan par 'khrol ba sogs kyi dge legs su bya'o/ kha skong dang las myur du 'grub pa'i sbyin sreg grub na mchog tu 'gyur zhing gnas srung dang dga' ston sogs mtha' rgyas gzhan du bshad pa ltar ci 'grub byas pas phyin chad legs tshogs rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/

/gsang ba chen po'i myur lam mthar thug pa'i/ /tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa tshul bzhin du/ /bzhugs pas rig 'dzin skyes bu'i sa steng khyon/ /rab mdzes bstan pa'i snying po rgyas byed shog /bsnyen pas ye shes rgyud bskul te/ /bsgrubs pas lha tshogs gnyis med 'grub/ /sgrub pa chen pos sku lnga yi/ /go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig /'phags bod paṇa grub yongs kyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /grol ba drug ldan pa dang dgongs pa'i gter/ /tshe gcig gdod ma'i grol bar 'ub chud pa'i/ /zab gsang rdo rje'i theg pa rmad du byung*/ /zhes grub dbang dam pa bla ma rig 'dzin gyi dngos slob sgrub bla karma mthar phyin gyis sku gsung thugs rten dang rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇḍal dang bcas te bskul ngor/ la gsum rgyal ba byang chub kyi rnam rol rig pa 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin padma phrin las sam ming gzhan grags pa rin chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sder 'bod pas/ rang lugs tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi sgrub khog bsdus pa/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa snang gsal sgron me gzhir bzhag 7 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i bsgrigs chog dang*/ rnying ma spyi yi khog dbub gcig shes kun grol nas kha 'geb bgyis pa/ ma tshang pa rnams sgrub bla shrī bha dra dang*/ dam ldan shes rab mkhyen brtse zung nas sgrub pa'i phyag dang go bstun zhing yig bris mthun sbyor sogs bgyis par bsten/ dpal mkha' spyod tsā ri ṭa'i gnas zhol sgrub pa'i gnas sa mtsho dkar ri khrod du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ nyes bsags mchis na rtsa gsum chos srung bshags/ /dge 'dis rab 'byams zhing bzhugs rgyal dang sras/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon du bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du gnas pa dang*/ khyad par snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon rnams/ /zhabs pad rtag brtan mdzad phrin mthar phyin nas/

/bshad sgrub chos kyi dbyar rngas 'dzams gling khengs/ /de yi byin mthus mkha' khyab sems can kun/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /bde skyid phun tshogs chos la spyod pa dang*/ /mthar thug bde chen zhing mchog bgrod par shog /tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i skal ldan rnams/ /bskal mang gang bsags sdig ltung kun byang nas/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad nyer len zhi/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi dgra las g.yul rgyal nas/ /lus rten de la tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /dga' bde phun tshogs nub phyogs bde ba can/ /rigs kyi tshom bur 'god pa'i smon lam shog sarba dā ka lyā naṃ bha wantu/ slar ma phyi zhu dag dang rgyal ba gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar dpyad bsdur gyis dag par gtan la phab par byed po sgo chen sprul ming gu hya'o// //
